Like other parallel robots, the forward kinematic solution of the parallel robot driven by cable is usually faced with complex nonlinear equations, and its solution is always a difficult problem. The traditional numerical iteration method is heavily dependent on the selection of initial values, which is easy to fall into local convergence, leading to the result of calculation is not necessarily the ideal spatial pose. The neural network has good nonlinear fitting ability and can give correct spatial pose, but the solution accuracy needs to be improved. The convergence and precision of the forward kinematic solution of the CDPRs is solved by the improved algorithm combining neural network and Levenberg- Marquardt algorithm.

articleTitle: Current Transformer Oil Leak Detection Algorithm Based on Change Detection and Grayscale Histogram Double Gaussian Fitting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Current transformers are important equipment in unattended substations. Its operating conditions must be monitored in real time, and corresponding alarms should be generated when abnormal conditions occur. A current transformer oil leak detection algorithm based on change detection and grayscale histogram double Gaussian fit analysis is proposed in this paper. The ViBe algorithm is used to determine the anomalous region, and the gray histogram of the anomalous region is subjected to double Gaussian fitting analysis. The analysis results can be used to determine whether there is oil leakage in the anomalous region. Experiments show that the method introduced in this paper can detect abnormal oil leakage of current transformer more accurately , and can well eliminate the impacts of external factors such as changes in light conditions, shadows, and rain. It also provides support for monitoring and early warning of current transformers.

articleTitle: Design of UWB Antenna with Double Band-notched in 5G
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, an UWB (ultra-wideband) antenna with notched bands in 5G is designed with the overall size of 42mm*32mm*0.508mm, which works in 2.91-10.69GHz and has good band-notched performance in the frequency bands of 3.38-3.65GHz and 4.74-4.92GHz. This antenna can be used in the UWB communication systems and can avoid the mutual interference between the UWB communication system and 5G communication system, realizing the electromagnetic compatibility between the two systems. This antenna has a good application prospect under the background of the large-scale promotion of 5G communication technology.

articleTitle: Semantic segmentation based on DeeplabV3+ with multiple fusions of low-level features
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the problem that DeeplabV3+ semantic segmentation model uses downsampling operation several times in the encoder process, a large amount of object boundary information is lost, resulting in inaccurate segmentation at the object boundary location, this paper proposes a new semantic segmentation model that fuses low-level features several times based on DeeplabV3+ algorithm. Firstly, we use the encoding module of DeeplabV3+ algorithm to extract the high-level semantic information of the object; then we use the method of this paper to extract the low-level features several times to obtain the detailed information of the object boundary; finally, we fuse the high-level semantic information and the detailed information of the object to obtain the optimized semantic segmentation result. The experimental results on the current open source dataset PASCAL VOC 2012 show that compared with the DeeplabV3+ algorithm, the algorithm model proposed in this paper has better semantic segmentation results by fusing the low-level features multiple times, especially at the boundary position of the object, with a pixel accuracy of 94.1% and a mean intersection over union of 77.5%. The overall performance of the algorithm model proposed in this paper has reached the current leading level.

articleTitle: A CNN Based Method to Solve Class Imbalance Problem in SAR Image Ship Target Recognition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) recognition algorithms have made great progress with the use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs). However, the imbalanced distribution of ship targets causes CNNs trained by conventional methods to fail to recognize rare ship types in the marine target recognition field. Traditional resampling methods have disadvantages of overfitting and low recognition accuracy, perform poorly in SAR images. To address this problem, this paper proposes a dynamic weighted sampling and soft threshold moving combined method which can be used in most current CNN based SAR recognition algorithms. Specifically, dynamic weighted sampling changes training data distribution according to the validation set performance, and soft threshold moving adjusts output decision thresholds of trained CNNs. The test results on the public dataset OpenSARShip show that our method can effectively identify rare ship types while obtaining a higher recognition accuracy than traditional resampling methods.

articleTitle: Sketch Based Thangka Image Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Thangka art is a cultural representative of Tibet of China and one of the Intangible Cultural Heritage recognized by the United Nations. It’s a unique art form of painting in Tibetan culture. Thangka images contain rich historical, cultural and religious information. There is little research about Thangka in the field of image retrieval and content recognition. In this paper, we propose a Thangka-sketch image data set, and study the matching rule between Thangka image and sketch by using deep learning technology based on machine vision. In the last of this paper, we show the result of our Thangka image retrieval.

articleTitle: Research on Five-phase Induction Motor System Control Under Non-sinusoidal Power Supply Based on Dual-plane Transformation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to enhance the power density of multi-phase induction motor system, the motor can adopt the structure with concentrated full-pitch windings and be driven by non-sinusoidal power supply with third harmonic injection. Through dual-plane rotation transformation, the mathematic model in two orthogonal space plane, d1-q1 and d3-q3, was established. To fully utilize the stator core and improve the torque and power output of the induction motor, the air gap magnetic field optimization control condition is analyzed. According to this, the direct and quadrature axis current components in third harmonic plane as non-linear functions of the fundamental are calculated from two different perspective analysis. On the basis above, two different air-gap magnetic field optimization control method with third harmonic current injected are proposed, and then simulation by Matlab/Simulink and experiment is implemented on a 5.5 kW, five-phase concentrated full-pitch windings induction motor. The results indicate that by the two control methods, the air-gap magnetic field gets improved, and the power density of five-phase induction motor is enhanced without any increase of power switch capacity and the size of the motor.

articleTitle: Diagnosis and Analysis of Abnormal Heating Fault for 35kV Dry Air Core Reactor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to accurately evaluate the operation state of dry-type reactor, improving the diagnosis level of equipment faults and ensure the safe and reliable running of power grid, the structure and abnormal fault are analyzed based on the infrared thermometric technology. The abnormal heating fault of reactor are researched and summarized such as the high voltage wiring board, neutral point connection board, grounding bar, pillar insulator base and DC filter reactor wiring board, etc. According to the relevant detection data and standard regulations, the reason of heating for the above different parts are carried out, and given the targeted treatment scheme. The research results show that the abnormal heating are generated by circulating current in the metal components, neutral point, grounding bar and down lead of pillar base due to the influence of leakage magnetic field of dry-type air-core reactor and equipment installation process. The corresponding faults are established, which it provide a basis for the types of abnormal heating faults in dry air core reactor.

articleTitle: Visible-Infrared Image Fusion Based on Double- Density Wavelet and Thermal Exchange Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion has been a hot issue in image fusion. However, the parameters and result image have many proposed. In this paper, a novel visible infrared image fusion algorithm based on double-density wavelet and thermal exchange optimization is proposed. The pre-processed infrared and visible images are decomposed into detail layers and background layers by double-density wavelet transform. Thermal exchange optimization is used to estimate the number of layers and weight thresholds of decomposition. Experimental shows that both visual effects and quantitative analysis of proposed algorithm can get the best results.

articleTitle: Research on cylindrical labels unfolding algorithm based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: It is a difficult problem for imaging the cylindrical label, and this paper presents an algorithm for unfolding the cylindrical label. First, the cylindrical label is positioned by the monocular camera, and the 3D point sets of the cylindrical label are established. Second, the observation range of each camera is determined based on the poses of the cylinders. Then, the cylindrical distortion is corrected in each camera. Finally, two adjacent images are stitched together to obtain a continuous and normalized unfolding image of the cylindrical label. Real-world and synthetic data experiments results show that the algorithm can correct the cylindrical distortion, and it takes only about 160 ms to obtain the cylindrical label unfolding image. The algorithm execution process does not require complicated steps and additional auxiliary, and the algorithm execution speed meets the industrial requirements.

articleTitle: Appearance-based gaze estimation using separable convolution neural networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Gaze estimation is one of the current important research contents of computer vision. For the current situation where the gaze estimation neural network has a large amount of parameters but the accuracy is not greatly improved and the head pose is difficult to handle, this paper proposes a simplified gaze estimation network model SLeNet based on the LeNet neural network. The deep separable convolution in the Xception network is used to reduce the amount of parameters in the convolution part and improve the computational performance of the network model. The method of splicing head posture features is retained, but another branch neural network is designed to learn head posture based on eye image and mouth corner information, and no additional module is required to obtain head posture separately. The improved network model is used to compare experiments with the original network and VGG-16 on the MPIIGaze dataset. The results show that the improved SLeNet network model performs better on the MPIIGaze dataset than LeNet and VGG-16 and has fewer parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis of Fault Characteristics Based on Clock Glitch Injection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Fault injection attack can create instantaneous electrical pulses or thermal noise in the actual operating cryptographic circuit, thereby destroying the original time constraints on the cryptographic circuit, triggering the inversion of the intermediate state of the cryptographic algorithm and reducing the security strength of the cryptographic algorithm. Currently, clock glitch presents one of the most commonly used fault injection methods, which pose serious threat to the security of password applications. Focusing on the implementation of block cipher FPGA applications and based on the built-in clock glitch fault injection test platform, we study the fault characteristics caused by clock glitch in this paper. The relevant conclusions can be extended to other fault injection mechanisms with fault caused by time constraint violation of the cipher circuit.

articleTitle: Research on Salt and Pepper Noise Removal Method Based on Adaptive Fuzzy Median Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the traditional median filtering algorithm can not well retain the image details while eliminating image noise, this paper proposes an adaptive fuzzy median filtering algorithm based on the mean of absolute average gradient difference. The whole filtering process is divided into three parts: coarse noise detection, fine noise detection and noise filtering. First, the extreme value method is used to perform rough noise detection on the image to be tested, which is divided into suspected noise points and signal points; then use this algorithm to construct the fuzzy membership function of the mean of absolute average gradient difference between the detected suspected noise points and the signal points in the window (including the filtered noise points), and use this function to perform secondary detection on the suspected noise points to determine Whether it is noise and fuzzy classification processing; finally, perform different filtering processing on the noise fuzzy classification results. Experimental results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has significant improvements in PSNR, MSE, and SSIM compared to the traditional median filtering algorithm. Therefore, the algorithm in this paper can effectively remove the salt and pepper noise of the image while protecting the image texture details.

articleTitle: Mango Surface Defect Detection Based on HALCON
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Mango is soft in texture. When it is picked or ripened, it may be eroded by pests or damaged when it falls on the ground. A mango surface defect detection device based on HALCON was designed to improve the detection accuracy and efficiency. A mango image acquisition system was built by using CCD array camera, LED light source and switching power supply to obtain high-definition image of mango. HALCON software is used to preprocess the original image, threshold segmentation, morphological denoising and so on. Finally, the target features are extracted and the defect area is calculated. The experimental results show that this method is fast and accurate for the extraction of mango surface defects, which provides a method for the extraction of mango surface defects.

articleTitle: APSO-based Optimization Algorithm of LSTM Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the multi hidden layer LSTM recurrent neural network, the updating of its weights and thresholds depends on the gradient descent algorithm, the convergence speed of the model is slow, and the weight calculation of the network nodes is prone to local extremum, which leads to the global optimization of the LSTM neural network model and the decline of the generalization ability of the network model, which limits the application of LSTM recurrent neural network. Therefore, this paper proposes an improved LSTM neural network model based on APSO algorithm. In this model, the root mean square error is designed as an appropriate value function, and the APSO algorithm is used to construct an optimization strategy to globally optimize the weights of each neuron node, so as to improve the generalization and prediction performance of the model. The experimental results of classic data market and UCI data sets show that the prediction accuracy of APSO-LSTM model is significantly improved compared with the traditional LSTM model, which verifies the effectiveness and practicability of APSO-LSTM model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Functional Safety Fieldbus Communication Protocol
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the requirements of safety communication in the safety instrumented system (SIS), a fieldbus functional safety communication protocol is proposed in this paper. According to the reasons of communication failure, several safety measures are used implicitly or explicitly to detect the error in the transmission. They include connection authentication, time stamp, sequence number and cyclic redundancy check (CRC). The communication architecture of full redundancy is structured to improve the reliability of communication system. Finally, the calculation results of the residual error rate show that the proposed functional safety fieldbus communication protocol meets the requirements of the safety integrity level (SIL) 3.

articleTitle: Research on Transformer Cooling Control Strategy Based on Hot Spot Temperature Calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of power grid scale, oil-immersed transformer as the key electrical equipment of power grid, its safe and economical operation is very important. When the transformer is operating under different working conditions, it is inevitable that the hot spot temperature is too high. Reasonable cooling control strategy is the guarantee of safe and stable operation of the transformer. The hot spot temperature of transformer is closely related to the load capacity and aging speed. The hot spot temperature is an important factor to formulate the cooling control strategy. In this paper, a 220kV/180MVA oil-immersed transformer is taken as an example to calculate its hot spot temperature under different operating conditions. Based on the hot spot temperature, the cooling control strategy of transformer is studied by integrating multiple information, which provides a strong guarantee for safe and economic operation of transformer.

articleTitle: A Photoacoustic Spectrum Detection System Based on Chaos Detection of Weak Signal
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A photoacoustic spectrum system for detecting dissolved gases in transformer oil was studied and designed. The system used the photoacoustic cell of "sample cell + signal cell". The photoacoustic signal obtained was amplified and filtered, then denoised by the cross-correlation method. The processed signal was detected by chaos, thus improving the signal-to-noise ratio of weak signal detection. Finally, the main fault gas in the transformer was tested experimentally. The results showed that compared with the traditional PLL amplifier circuit, the detection accuracy of the system had been greatly improved. The limit detection sensitivity of CH4 is 6.9ppm, and it can have a certain application value in the detection of dissolved gas in transformer oil.

articleTitle: A Novel IP-ICN Coexistence Deployable Frame-work Based SDN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Information-Centric Network (ICN) emerged as a new Internet paradigm to address the problems arising from the mismatch between the TCP/IP host-to-host transmission pattern and content-oriented access mode. However, the current network infrastructure does not support ICN. ICN needs to be deployed incrementally on existing networks, and its coexistence with IP is inevitable. Software-Defined Network (SDN) is an effective solution for achieving flexible and controlled deployment. In this paper, we design a compatible format for IP packets and NDN (Named Data Networking, Typical representatives of ICN) packets based on MPLS. On this basis, a network architecture for IP and NDN coexistence, called SDNDN (Software-Defined Named Data Network), is designed in combination with SDN. With data plane programmable capabilities, functionally extended switches enable parsing, processing, and forwarding of NDN packets; algorithms such as route optimization and cache management are implemented based on a global view. Experimental results indicate that SDNDN can realize the coexistence of ICN and IP networks and has performance advantages such as reduced content retrieval time. Besides, IP and NDN in the coexistence network are suited to different traffic models, which facilitates flexible network slicing.

articleTitle: Optimal transit signal priority method with conflicting requests under connected vehicle environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this research, an optimal transit priority signal timing decision method was proposed by minimizing the personal average delay, aiming at resolving multiple conflicting priority requests at an isolated intersection. Based on connected vehicle technologies, it is available to obtain detailed information including lane-level locations and speeds of connected vehicles, signal plans and light states of traffic lights, traffic flow rates and queueing lengths at the intersection. The proposed method reallocates green time of every two signal stages, where transits are weighted by their on-time performance, loading factors and passenger priority. The delay of transit is estimated in five scenarios according to bus arrival time and queueing behavior, while the delay of other traffic flows is calculated with respect to the adjustment of green time. The result shows that the transit signal priority control achieved 8%-40% reductions of average personal delay and balance of travel completion, depending on various volumes of transits and general traffic, compared against the cases without transit signal priority control or with fixed green extensions.

articleTitle: Robust Real-time Obstacle Avoidance of Wheeled Mobile Robot based on Multi-Sensor Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Wheeled mobile robot has the advantages of strong execution ability, stable operation and fast response speed. It is widely utilized in smart autonomous robots, automated operation platforms, urban rail transit and some other related fields. Currently, the most of researches on wheeled mobile robot autonomous motion are based on single-sensor data to detect surrounding objects, which are susceptible to the environmental interference. This paper adopts the centralized multi-sensor fusion algorithm to achieve obstacle avoidance based on Kalman filter. Through multi-objective optimization, all the sub-behaviors among movement process are weighted, which improves the real-time and robustness of the system. Finally, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified through prototype testing.

articleTitle: Graph-Based Lattices Cryptosystem As New Technique Of Post-Quantum Cryptography
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A new method for judging degree sequence is shown by means of perfect ice-flower systems made by operators - stars (particular complete bipartite graphs), and moreover this method can be used to build up degree sequences and perfect ice-flower systems. Graphic lattice, graph-graphic lattice, caterpillar-graphic lattice and topological coding lattice are defined. We establish some connections between traditional lattices and graphic lattices trying to provide new techniques for Lattice-based cryptosystem and post-quantum cryptography, and trying to enrich the theoretical knowledge of topological coding.

articleTitle: State of Charge Estimation for Lithium-Ion Battery based on Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: State of charge (SOC) estimation for lithium- ion battery is an important part of battery management system (BMS). Accurate SOC estimation can extend lifespan of the batteries and ensure safety of the batteries operated in electric vehicles. In this paper, a data-driven SOC estimation method is presented. Various artificial neural networks (ANNs) with different hidden layers are trained by a data set which consists of a series of the battery voltage, current and SOC variables obtained from a dynamic discharge test. The battery SOC is then estimated by the trained ANNs. Comparisons of the SOC estimated by the ANNs and model-based method combining with extended Kalman filter (EKF) are implemented. Root mean squared error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) of the SOC estimated by the data-driven method are very close to those estimated by the model-based method. The results prove that data-driven methods can accurately estimate the SOC of lithium-ion batteries.

articleTitle: Indoor Mobile robot positioning based on UWB And Low Cost IMU
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Positioning for indoor mobile robot cannot be solved by a single sensor. In this paper, a positioning system based on the fusion of various sensor data is designed. The system integrates the UWB positioning results with the low-cost MEMS inertial measurement unit positioning results in order to improve the positioning accuracy of the system. The system consists of two Kalman filters, the first of which is used to combine gyroscope angular velocity information with magnetometer angle to get an accurate heading angle. The second Kalman filter combines the positioning results calculated by IMU with the positioning results of UWB, and finally obtains accurate positioning results. The final experimental results show that the method is effective.

articleTitle: Visibility Prediction of Plateau Airport Based on LSTM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Weather visibility has an important impact on civil aviation to flight punctuality and safety. Sudden changes in weather visibility often cause flight go-around, holding, alternate, cancellation, and even unsafe incidents, so if visibility can be accurately predicted in advance, it will be significant to make accurate flight plans and pre-flight preparation. In autumn and winter, the visibility of plateau airports changes rapidly because of complex and changeable meteorological conditions, and traditional meteorological methods are also difficult to predict visibility changes accurately, so the flight risks and difficulty in flight planning increase. Considering that weather visibility is jointly determined by many meteorological factors, and there is a strong correlation between the time, based on long-term short-term memory network (LSTM), this paper uses the atmospheric state information of the airport ground station to construct a plateau airport visibility prediction model (PAVPM) to forecast the visibility of the plateau airport hourly in the next 1~6 hours. And finally we use hourly weather data from Urumqi Airport in winter of 2015-2019 to verify the validity of the model.

articleTitle: Design of Solder Quality Inspection System Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The electronic water pump for vehicles adjusts the working state of the water pump with the help of the electronic control unit, and then pressurizes the coolant, to circulate the coolant in the cooling system to ensure that the engine temperature does not exceed the limit threshold and can work normally. Therefore, it is a very important link to inspect internal circuit boards in the production of water pumps. Traditional manual inspection has limited working time, while automatic machine vision inspection can perform 24-hour uninterrupted inspection. Compared with manual inspection, it is more reliable and stable, which has advantages in speed, and has a wide range of industrial applications. According to this, this paper designs a solder joint inspection system based on machine vision, which can detect the status of solder joints and feed back the current soldering results to the workers. The method solves the problem of automatically detecting the welding quality of the circuit board in the manual welding process, greatly improves the production efficiency of the workshop production line, and shortens the product production cycle.

articleTitle: A Novel Deep Learning Model for Transmission Line Icing Thickness Prediction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Monitoring and prediction icing thickness of overhead transmission lines are important factor threatening for the safe operation of power grid. A novel transmission line icing thickness prediction method is proposed by employing deep learning model. For the proposed method, a novel deep learning model based on parallel coordinates has been used for converting the matrix consisting of multi-dimensional icing meteorological monitoring data to simplified parallel coordinates plot. The icing thickness values has been classified into several levels and convolutional neural networks model was constructed to analyze the relationship between converted simplified parallel coordinates plots and measured icing thickness. The experiment results in Hunan demonstrate the effectiveness of proposed method and the icing thickness prediction accuracy exceeded 92%. The icing thickness values can be accuracy predicted in all cases, which makes it essential in the decision-making of de-icing when the icing thickness is increasing rapidly or the transmission line is heavily iced and monitoring image is not available.

articleTitle: Skin Cancer Diagnosis based on Improved Multiattention Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The human skin is directly exposed to air and sunlight, because the skin is the body's first line of defense against harmful substances, so it may lead to skin cancer due to a variety of reasons. The malignant tumors on the skin are called skin cancers, which are defined by different types of tumor cells, including epidermis, soft skin tissue, melanocytes, skin lymphatic reticulation and hematopoietic tissue, etc. As for the current diagnosis, skin cancer can be diagnosed as a tumor of the skin. Therefore, it is extremely important to develop a diagnostic system for skin cancer. Convolutional neural network has excellent performance in medical image recognition, so this paper proposes an improved convolutional neural network for skin cancer diagnosis, which has the following advantages: (1) by introducing a hybrid multi_attentive mechanism will, the limited attention will be focused on the tumor cells, thus saving resources and obtaining effective eigenvalues quickly. (2) by using the improved vgg19 to extract the eigenvalues of tumors, the fully connected layer is replaced by extremely randomized trees for classification. The study shows that the diagnostic method in this paper has some improvements in roc, accuracy, and recall.

articleTitle: Cervical cell TCT image detection and segmentation based on multi-scale feature fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on Mask R-CNN, this paper proposes a cervical image target detection and segmentation model based on multi-scale feature fusion. Mask R-CNN's backbone network-Feature Pyramid (FPN) uses top-down cross-layer connection, which causes the network to pay too much attention to the optimization of low-level features, resulting in a problem of reduced segmentation performance. Aiming at this problem, this paper uses NAS-FPN to determine the search space under the guiding ideology of classification network architecture search, realizes automatic cross-layer connection, and obtains the best feature fusion strategy. And use Soft NMS instead of NMS to reduce the mistaken deletion of bounding boxes and improve the accuracy of target detection. To The author produced his own TCT cell image data set (New Perdell's liquid-based cytological detection technique) under the guidance of medical laboratory personnel. After expanding the TCT data set, experiments show that the improved model in this paper can effectively improve the accuracy, recall and segmentation accuracy of epithelial cells, white blood cells, and fungi.

articleTitle: Fine-grained image classification model based on improved SqueezeNet
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that some fine-grained algorithms have a large amount of calculation and low operating efficiency, This paper firstly proposes the use of SqueezeNet for fine-grained image recognition tasks, because SqueezeNet, as one of the representatives of lightweight CNN, has fewer parameters and faster running time. The experimental verification of SqueezeNet on three fine-grained datasets shows that SqueezeNet can also finely recognize images, but the classification accuracy rate is low, this paper further improves SqueezeNet: two different attention mechanism modules are embedded in the SqueezeNet in different ways, then use bilinear fusion to fuse the attention feature maps, and then the new attention feature map is bilinearly fused with the last layer of the network, a new tensor is obtained and sent to the linear layer for classification finally. Through experimental comparison and visual analysis, the improved SqueezeNet has a significant improvement in accuracy compared to the original network and other algorithms.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Quadrotor-Based Spherical Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Spherical robots have many advantages compared with traditional wheeled and orbital robots. In this paper, the design and implementation of a novel quadrotor-based spherical robot is presented. The robot, named FBall, consists of a spherical outer shell made of Polymethacrylimide (PMI) foam, four variable-pitch propellers, four motors, a controller and a battery. The robot is capable of rolling on water surfaces, rolling on ground surfaces and flying in the air by changing the pitch angle of each propeller and adopting corresponding control algorithms. In rolling mode, two propellers’ pitch angle are set to negative values, and the other two are set to positive values so as to provide a rolling moment. In the flying mode, the pitch angle of all the propellers are set to the same value just as traditional quadrotors, and 4 PID controllers are employed to regulate its roll, pitch, yaw angles, and altitude.The paper focuses primarily on designing a spherical robot based on a variable pitch quadrotor. Modeling, locomotion capabilities analyzing and future works are also presented.

articleTitle: A Novel Access Control for Internet of Things Based on Blockchain Smart Contract
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Since more and more devices join the Internet of Things(IoT) network, a large amount of user sensitive data is generated. The leakage of these data will cause very serious consequences. Traditional access control is prone to single point of failure. The existing researches on the combination of blockchain and access control have some disadvantages, such as the difficulty of managing access rights, inefficient access efficiency, and the difficulty of supporting lightweight IOT devices. This paper proposes an IoT access control model based on blockchain smart contract, called SCBAC. Firstly, by adopting the idea of IoT Attributes Based Access Control(ABAC), the model supports a dynamic, fine-grained access control. Secondly, by deploying the access control strategy on the blockchain in the form of smart contracts, the computing pressure of IoT devices is reduced, so that the model can be applied to lightweight IoT devices and has tamper resistance and traceability characteristics. The idea of tokens is adopted into the strategy, and subjects obtain access rights by applying for tokens in advance, which improves access efficiency. In addition, Trust recommendation algorithm is adopted in the model, which effectively solves the problem of identity fraud in access control. Finally, we build a prototype system to verify this proposed model, through case analysis and security analysis, it shows that this access control model is effective and versatile. Furthermore, the model can be used as a reference for other IoT applications with access control security requirements.

articleTitle: An Integrated Frequency Regualtion Control Strategy Considering the Full Wind Speed of Wind Turbine and Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increase of large-scale wind turbines integrated into the power grid, the frequency regulation ability of the wind turbines are more important for power system security and stability operation. Due to the fluctuation and the randomness of the wind energy, the control methods of the wind turbine under the full wind speed are analyzed in this paper. The main control methods of the wind turbine include electric control and pitch angle control. Then, the control methods of the wind turbine with different wind speeds are proposed, which considers the different combinations of the basic control method based on their regulation characteristics. Next, the control strategy of the energy storage system is proposed, considering the positive and the negative of frequency deviation and the rate of change of frequency. An integrated control strategy is put forward by combining the proposed control strategies of wind turbines and energy storage systems. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed integrated control strategy is verified by using the IEEE 30-bus system.

articleTitle: Electricity Theft Identification Algorithm Based on Auto-Encoder Neural Network and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Non-technical losses caused by users' electricity theft will affect the economic order for the electricity market and have a negative impact on line loss calculations and grid operations. In order to improve the power detection capability and identify the user's power stealing method, an electricity theft identification algorithm combining auto-encoder neural network and random forest is proposed. The auto-encoder neural network can effectively extract the abstract behavior characteristics of the electricity data, and establish an early warning model of the electricity stealing behavior by the error between the actual power data and the neural network full variable reconstruction value. The random forest algorithm further derives the specific implementation mode of the warning electricity theft behavior. Based on the real data set, the proposed algorithm is verified that the proposed algorithm has a high detection sensitivity and classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Object Detector based on Enhanced Multi-scale Feature Fusion Pyramid Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Constructing the pyramidal architecture for the feature is currently a very effective way to obtain feature information of objects at different scales. Although the feature pyramid can realize the recognition and detection of multi-scale objects in the object detection task well, it still has some limitations. Since the feature information of different levels is often not from the same layer of the network, it is difficult to obtain the feature of different objects information at a certain scale from a certain level feature map of the pyramid network. To solve this problem, we present a novel object detection architecture, named Enhanced Multi-scale Feature Fusion Pyramid Network (EMFFPNet). Our network consists of Enhanced Multi-scale Feature Fusion Module (EMFFM) and Predictor Optimization Module (POM). In EMFFM, Features at different levels can be fused into the Enhanced features as outputs, which are more representative and deterministic. In order to enable the enhanced features to play their respective roles in the pyramid network, we assign different weights to fusion features of different levels in POM. We perform the experiments on the COCO detection benchmark. The experimental results indicate that the performance of our model is much better than the state-of-the-art model.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Web-based Integrate Network Service Management System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper introduces a web-based integrate network service management system, which combines web technology and network management technology to create an organic structural model. It brings together browser/server setup structure, modularization model, PHP and ASP to realize the purpose of network services management for users integrating network disposal management, user services management, MIS business management.

articleTitle: Food Material Consumption Prediction Of Catering Enterprises Based On Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Food material management plays an important role in catering enterprises. Accurately predicting the consumption of each kind of food materials in the future can reduce the cost and improve the operation efficiency of catering enterprises. Based on ARMA and ARIMA models, we took the actual operation data of a big hot pot restaurant as the research object, and tried to forecast the food materials consumption of the restaurant in a relatively short future time. The experimental results show that although there is still room for improvement, the time series model can be used to help the material management of each catering enterprise.

articleTitle: Research on Bathtub Water Temperature Control Strategy and Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the problem of how to keep water temperature constant and minimize water usage, this passage mainly discuss four parts to research. Consider that there exists thermal dissipation, and four types of thermal dissipation are heat conduction, thermal radiation, evaporative cooling and heat convection. The first step: discuss about the problem on condition of natural environment. There are two types of thermal dissipation of water in bathtub, one is by water contacting with air while another one is heat conduction of bathtub. Accumulate four types of thermal dissipation and then we obtain the relation of thermal dissipation with contacting area, initial water temperature in bathtub with stability of water in bathtub. Based on thermodynamic principle, we build three-dimensional partial differential equation of heat conduction from bathtub's surface. Finally, we have the distribution graph of relation between temperature and time, space variation. The second type: Based on principle of Energy Conservation, we obtain the generalized partial differential equation of process of water dynamic variation with entering water's temperature and outside temperature, and solve for problem that considering factors such as temperature variation with disturbance and bubble. The third step: Obtain the best designed model based on constant temperature, consider the minimum water usage and design length, volume and shape of the best designed bathtub. The fourth step: Use fuzzy PID algorithm to test and then obtain the convergence result. Proving that the built model is easy to adjust temperature and doesn't possess big errors.

articleTitle: Kitchen Appliance Recommendation based on User Profile and Interest Evolution Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a category of many products, kitchen appliances have unique labels, such as kitchen, food processing, cooking, kitchen hygiene, etc. At the same time, when users browse and purchase products, kitchen appliances have their own evolutionary process. It is a very meaningful task for users to recommend kitchen products that they are interested in. This article uses user profile containing potential interests and the interest evolution network to simulate the process of user interest changes, and then infer the category of kitchen appliance that users may be interested in next time, and in this process, a module is designed to narrow the distance between the interest state and the real interest to make the extracted interest state closer to reality.

articleTitle: Research and design of blood cell detection device
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Leukemia can be diagnosed early by blood cell examination technology, and its basic process needs to observe the blood smear containing the sample blood under the microscope, so the preparation and staining of blood smear is very important for the examination of leukemia. At present, there are some problems, such as high price, incomplete function, low efficiency and complex process. Based on this situation, this paper systematically studies the theory and application of blood cytology examination device. According to the different application requirements of blood smear preparation equipment, a high blood cell examination device is designed. The relationship between the push film parameters and the blood smear preparation effect is mainly studied. According to the conclusion, this paper design the structure, hardware, software, and finally the progressive the test results show that the device is stable in operation, high in automation, greatly improving the quality and efficiency of push sheet dyeing, high reliability, low cost, simple and convenient operation, achieving the expected design objectives.

articleTitle: Optimal Inspection Path Planning of Loom Spindles Based on A* Algorithm and Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the inspection algorithm for abnormal spindles in the textile industry, in this paper, the search neighborhood of the traditional A* algorithm is expanded to increase the diversity of searches, and a bi-directional search scheme is proposed to boost the search speed of the A* algorithm. After obtaining the shortest path between abnormal spindles, an improved ant colony algorithm with the elite strategy and optimized heuristic function is adopted, in which the maximum and minimum pheromone system is added to improve convergence speed and preventing local convergence. The probability of ant movement is ameliorated based on the actual production conditions, to make the algorithm more in line with production requirements.

articleTitle: Power Uncertainty Evaluation of Microwave Digestion System based on Monte-Carlo Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The article implemented an uncertainty evaluation method for output power of microwave digestion system, based on the adaptive Monte Carlo method and the correlation of inputs. The result is compared with that obtained by GUM method. By using Kolmogorov-Smirnov and Normal probability method, the probability distribution of the output has deviated from normal distribution in a certain interval. The Result of GUM method is not validated, and MCM method is proved to be faster and more efficient in the case of complex models and correlative cases.

articleTitle: Design of Multipath Waveform Generator Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to design a programmable multipath waveform generator, VHDL is used to design every module. It is consisted with the waveform input, FPGA module, digital-to-analog conversion (D/A) module, display circuit. By pressing the keys, eight waves can be chosen and shown in the oscilloscope. With the characteristics of low cost, portable and expandable, it can be widely used in electronic circuit system.

articleTitle: Research on user Credit score Model based on Fusion Neural network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The research of this topic is based on financial risk control, and Sunshine Jinke's risk prevention and control is taken as a specific research case. The data set uses user consumption data used by Sunshine Jinke. The data source is a bank's customer consumer loan records in the past five years. The feature fields are extracted according to the degree of correlation between the data and the repayment rate, and combined with the convolutional neural network and the recurrent neural network, these feature fields are processed for the differentiation of credit data and fraud data, and finally matched with user information and scored, matching The process uses the singular matrix factorization idea. Through experimental papers, this idea has good stability and accuracy in the field of risk control forecasting.

articleTitle: 3-RSS/S Robot Control System Software and Hardware Co-design and Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To solve the problems of poor dynamic performance and low integration of 3-DOF parallel robots, a set of the parallel robot control system with good dynamic performance and high integration is designed in this paper. The use of integrated control-drive technology not only integrates robot control algorithm and drive algorithms at the software level, but also highly integrates robot control and drive modules at the hardware level. The control system also includes SOPC technology, which makes full use of the excellent parallel task processing capabilities of FPGA and realizes the cooperative work with the on-chip ARM processor. Experimental results show that the above methods can effectively improve the control accuracy and dynamic performance of the parallel robot.

articleTitle: Study on active Harmonic Suppression on DC side of twelve pulse thyristor rectifier System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to reduce the harmonic content in the power system injected by the multi-pulse thyristor rectifier system, an active circuit is proposed to suppress the harmonic in the DC side of the rectifier system. According to the relationship between the AC and DC side currents of the thyristor rectifier system, the required DC side injected current waveform when the injected grid current is sinusoidal wave is obtained, and the final realized injected current waveform is also solved. According to the required DC side injection current waveform, a half-bridge PWM (Pulse-Width Modulation)inverter circuit is designed. The simulation results show that the harmonic suppression effect is good when the inverter is running.

articleTitle: Mechanism for Traversing Unknown Middleware of Networks in Using Multipath for Transmitting Data in Mobile
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Running services may not function properly due to port blocking. In the mobile scenario, some ports of data transmission service may be intercepted by unknown network middleware in the transmission process, resulting in high packet loss rate and low network bandwidth. The traditional port detection methods lack the cooperation of the receiver device, it can not fully discover the available ports and is easy to be intercepted by the firewall of the detected device and it can not be flexibly adjusted according to the change of device address in the mobile environment. In this paper, aiming at solving the interception of port for data passing through unknown network middleware in data transmission, a port detection mechanism for mobile network is proposed. This mechanism can detect the port of which can pass unknown network middleware when the device address changes frequently, and a protocol is designed to cooperate with the detection between sender and receiver. It can detect the ports that are available but not enabled with data transmission service, and will not be affected by the firewall which blocks the specific protocol detection packet of the detected device.

articleTitle: Implementation of Direction and Velocity Measurement Algorithm for Moving Target Based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Currently, almost all the Doppler radars work with frequency modulated continuous wave (FMCW) and finish the direction and velocity measurements with complex algorithm.[1] This paper proposes an implementation of algorithm that direction and velocity measurement for single moving target based on FPGA. The method only needs the radars work with continue wave (CW); the continue wave echo change the frequency due to the Doppler effect and the Doppler frequency shift can be measured with the Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) directly; it calculates the direction of moving target based on the phase difference between the two received signals, the phase difference also can be measured by FFT. The methods mentioned in the paper can be implemented with the Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), FPGA can accelerate calculating speed and satisfy the needs of miniaturization. The effectiveness of method proposed in this paper is validated through comparing the measurement results with the actual data finally. The system can be applied to the indoor position and anti-collision radar, it can improve the safety of vehicle when the drivers ignored the blind area.

articleTitle: The precise thickness determination device of bamboo sliver based on single chip microcomputer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a cutting device for automatic thickness determination of bamboo processing, the system was suitable for deep processing of bamboo slices with different thickness after being broken. The system was mainly composed of three parts: SCM control module, stepper motor drive module and mechanical drive module, which could realize the accurate thickness determination of slice by slice. After typing slice thickness, orders will be sent to the master microcontroller, controlled by the master to analyze command processing, in accordance with the procedures set thickness parameters can be converted to stepper motor rotation Angle, single chip microcomputer sent the corresponding frequency pulse count to drive, to control the rotation Angle of the corresponding motor, at the same time drive gear, screw, such as series of mechanical structure, realize the accurate translation of the blade, achieve the goal of precision cutting of bamboo. When replacing a screw with a smaller pitch, the cutting accuracy of the blade can be higher, so the device can further adjust the accuracy range. The experiment showed that the cutting precision of the blade could reach 0.1mm.

articleTitle: A Fault-tolerant Method of SRAM FPGA Based on Processor Scrubbing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the reliability of FPGA in space applications, a method of single event upset detection and scrubbing based on internal processor is proposed for Xilinx Zynq device. We propose a method to reduce the sensitive configuration bits and consequently the global scrubbing time based on Xilinx Essential Bits technology. Then the impact on reducing sensitive frames by placing different layout constraints is analyzed. The physical address of one single configuration frame and its corresponding configuration data are obtained based on the configuration memory structure. Simultaneously, Frame_ECC primitive and global CRC circuit is added to the design. Finally, the feasibility of our system is verified by the fault injection, and the time performance is evaluated by Mean Time to Detect (MTTD). The results show that the system can effectively shorten the readback and scrubbing time, single-bit upset and multi-bit upsets can be detected and repaired. Thus, the work is of great significance for improving the reliability of aerospace electronic systems.

articleTitle: TOA Mine Personnel Location Method based on Improved Wavelet - Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the complex environment of mine roadways and the large number of equipment, which may cause the Time delay of electromagnetic wave NLOS(Non Line of Sight) and affect the positioning accuracy of mine TOA(Time of Arrival), a TOA mine personnel positioning method based on improved wavelet-kalman filtering was proposed. First of all, a symmetrical two-channel ranging method (SDS-TWR) is adopted to eliminate the influence of synchronization delay and timing error on TOA positioning accuracy. Secondly, Three-layer decomposition of data through db1, db5 wavelet, and the decomposed data is reconstructed after threshold quantization. Finally, the improved kalman filter is used to filter the pulse noise from the wavelet data. The simulation results show that the average error of the method proposed in this paper is 1.3m. Compared with the SDS-TWR method and the kalman filter algorithm based on the innovation threshold, the average positioning error is reduced by 2.4m and 1.1m respectively, which verifies the effectiveness of the positioning performance of this method.

articleTitle: Image Recognizing Based on the Architecture Integrated with CIM and CIS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: CMOS image sensor (CIS) technology has made significant development in integrated circuits (ICs), offering competitive advantages in on-chip functionality, power consumption, and cost. However, it also faces some challenges, such as circuit complexity and processing speed. In recent years, computation-in-memory (CIM) architecture shows great advantages because it reduces data movement between memory and processing unit significantly. In this work, we propose an architecture integrated with CIS and CIM. The CIS pixel consists of a diode and three transistors, which is modified based on the traditional CIS pixel circuit. In the CIM block, a 4-bit 6-T SRAM and four multiplication transistors are used to store weight and perform product of weight and input, respectively. Signals from the CIS pixels are sent to the CIM block for on-chip image processing. We design and simulate an 8×8-pixel array and a CIM array with standard 180nm CMOS technology. This design achieves 2000/ps processing speed, 82.5% recognizing accuracy, presenting a promising solution for Non-Von-Neumann architecture devices in many applications.

articleTitle: Human Pose Estimation Based on Multi-resolution Feature Fusion Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This article focuses on the study of multi-resolution feature fusion methods for human pose estimation. Most of the existing pose estimation methods are based on high-resolution gradually reducing the resolution to learn advanced semantic features, and then gradually recovering high-resolution features from the low-resolution semantic features to locate keypoints of the person instance. The process without fusion of rich features will inevitably lose more spatial and semantic information. The purpose of the multi-resolution feature fusion method proposed in this paper is to fuse spatial and semantic information on multiple scale feature maps, in addition, our network use the multi-receptive field fusion module on the same scale features to enhance feature extraction. Our methods can utilize more feature information to accurately locate keypoints.

articleTitle: Design of Mobile Robot Interaction System Based on Slam Particle Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the market demand for service-oriented robot, the automatic delivery system of robot is designed in this paper. The system is controlled by ArduinoMega2560 control board, ROS (Robot Operating System) as the robot operating system, combined with Slam particle filter algorithm to complete the robot positioning and navigation functions. At the same time, based on the Qt software interactive platform to control the robot walking, using the steering gear to open and close the storage box, 4G module SMS notification. In summary, this paper designs an interactive platform for indoor file transfer service robot based on ROS and Slam particle filter algorithm. Through this platform, we can control file access, notify the operation of pickup, and improve the comfort of human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: Method for measuring the coordinates of three projectiles simultaneously based on laser detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of measuring the coordinates of two or even three projectiles at the same time when testing high rate of fire barrel weapons, a laser detection array-based three projectiles simultaneous target recognition method was proposed. First, a mathematical model of system measurement is established, and then a principle experiment is designed and carried out to verify the feasibility of the proposed method. Experimental results show that this method can realize the identification of three projectiles with a target range ≥5.04mm simultaneously. The maximum measurement error of the landing coordinate of the system in the x direction is 3.9mm, and the measurement error of the landing coordinate in the y direction is 3.2mm. Therefore, the proposed method is scientific and feasible.

articleTitle: Improved Control Strategy of Wind Energy Conversion System Based on Complex Vector
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the inaccuracy of the grid-side inductance, the existing control strategies for grid-side converters of Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS) has poor control performance. By introducing the concept of complex vector, this paper converts the grid-side converter of WECS from the double-input and double-output coupling system to the single-input and single-output first-order system. Based on this, the performance of the grid-side converter system is deeply analyzed, and a control strategy for the grid-side converter with no inductance value is proposed, with the generator-side converter control strategy together, the WECS control system is established. The simulation results show that the grid-side current waveform is obviously improved after adopting this control system, which makes the WECS have excellent static and dynamic performance, and greatly improves the adaptive capacity of WECS.

articleTitle: Research on attitude measurement method based on MEMS sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The navigation precision of MEMS NAV is affected by the precision of MEMS inertial devices, and the quantification of sensor signals is also an important factor. In this paper, a new orientation method based on MEMS sensor is proposed. Under the condition of nearly uniform motion of the carrier ,MEMS inertial sensor is used to collect the signal and improve the orientation accuracy of the carrier by quantifying the sensor signal with high precision. The measurement precision is analyzed by experiments to meet the requirements of low cost and miniaturization.

articleTitle: A grid-less DOA estimation method for monostatic MMO radar
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A gridless sparse reconstruction technology is applied to monostatic MIMO radar DOA estimation. Since this technology is only applicable to a uniform linear array, the received signal of MIMO radar is first subjected to reduced-dimension transformation to make it equivalent to a uniform linear array signal model. In order to reduce the computational complexity, the received signal is further subjected to singular value decomposition (SVD). Then use the ANM method to reconstruct the Toeplitz matrix of the model, and finally perform Vandermonde decomposition on the reconstructed Toeplitz matrix to estimate the target orientation. Compared with traditional subspace methods such as MUSIC, ESPRIT, etc. This method has higher resolution and can resolve coherent sources. The simulation results verify the excellent performance of this method.

articleTitle: Design of an infusion set based on pulse control and gravitational potential energy speed regulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This project USES STM32F429IGT6 single-chip microcomputer to design infusion device. On the basis of determining the reasonable drop rate by pulse rate, the height of infusion container is adjusted according to the relationship between gravitational potential energy and drop rate, so as to achieve the purpose of adjusting and stabilizing the reasonable drop rate. Single-chip microcomputer real-time detection of liquid drop speed and the pulse number, TFT - LCD touch screen display, when the bottle residual liquid quality is less than the default value or the pulse number is beyond the normal range, the alarm sensor signal alarm, from INT0 apply to the STM32F429IGT6 interruption, and local alarm, at the same time send the nurse station alarm and show the beds, complete real-time display, real-time detection and adjustment, timely report to the police, and other functions.

articleTitle: Demand Quality Evaluation of Satellite Mobile Communication System based on Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The satellite mobile communication system is one of the important means of modern communication and has wide demand space. The accurate assessment of the quality of demand is an important prerequisite for improving the quality of the demand of satellite mobile communication systems. By constructing the system requirement quality evaluation index system of satellite mobile communication system, the connotation and meaning of each index system are analyzed, and the applicability of cloud model in the quality evaluation of demand is clear. Based on the evaluation method of cloud model, the quality evaluation process of demand quality is clarified, and the evaluation results are obtained, and the Suggestions for the improvement of the quality of the demand quality of the satellite mobile communication system are provided.

articleTitle: A New Lateral Cephalogram Image Stitching Technique Using Gaussian Mixture Model and Normalized Cross-Correlation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In dental X-ray lateral cephalogram imaging, linear scanning with a small plate detector is used to obtain sequence images in order to control the radiation dose of the imaging, which requires the image stitching algorithm to stitch it into a complete image. Therefore, this paper proposes a new algorithm based on Gaussian mixture model and normalized cross-correlation to solve the continuous stitching problem of small size X-ray sequence images. The gaussian mixture model is firstly used to segment the high-brightness background area according to the gray information distribution of X-ray image. Then, the target region is used to register the adjacent images, and the genetic algorithm is selected as the optimization algorithm to save the registration time. After the registration parameters between adjacent images are obtained, image fusion is used to make the overlapping area more natural. Finally, after image fusion, the feedback module of gap detection is added to ensure that the registration parameters of each part reach the optimal level and avoid the impact of registration errors. The experimental results show that the algorithm has no stitching errors and gaps, and can effectively solve the stitching problem of small-size X-ray sequence images, it can provide clinical basis for orthodontics treatment.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Calibration and Comparison System for Partial Discharge Live Detection Equipment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The accurate and comprehensive evaluation of parameters for the detection equipment are carried out in order to standardize the manufacturing process, the on-site application and the operation maintenance of partial discharge type detection equipment. The ultra-high frequency, high frequency, ultrasonic and transient ground voltage partial discharge detection method are researched and established the corresponding performance verification and comparison system and platform based on the partial discharge research for power grid equipment. The key characteristic parameters of four kinds partial discharge detection equipment are given out such as the average effective height, detection sensitivity, dynamic range, transmission impedance, detection frequency, linearity error and stability, etc. At the same time, a comparative study on the performance tests of different types of PD detection equipment has been carried out. Compared with domestic equipment, the performance parameters of imported sensors are better than those of domestic equipment, which it can provide a reference basis for the network access test and acceptance criteria of partial discharge type live detection equipment in the next step.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High-voltage Charging Power Supply for Battery
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This article in view of the space craft high-voltage energy storage battery charge need high efficiency and high gain isolated DC-DC power supply requirements. It designs and implements a high voltage charging power supply with high efficiency. At the same time, completes magnetic isolation and phase shift control and introduces the double-closed loop control of voltage loop and current loop, realizes the constant flow of constant voltage charging ways. The input voltage of the rated state of the power supply is 100V, and the output voltage is 200V. Through experimental verification, the average working efficiency of the power supply charging is more than 93%.

articleTitle: Study on Partial Discharge Characteristics of Nano-SiO2 Modified Epoxy Resin for 10kV solid insulated switch-gear
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The epoxy resin of solid insulated switchgear will be subjected to electrical, thermal, mechanical and environmental stresses during operation, and then partial discharge (PD) will occur. PD will seriously reduce the electrical performance of the epoxy resin and shorten the service life of the switchgear. Therefore, to improve the electrical performance of the epoxy resin insulation, especially the PD-resistant ability, has be-come the focus of current research. In this paper, the epoxy resin specimen with nano-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> particles are prepared, and the PD patterns of different voltage levels are collected in the laboratory environment. The experiment results show that compared to the epoxy resin, the nano-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> modified epoxy resin has better insulation performance, and the initial discharge voltage increases significantly and the discharge amplitude decreases significantly. In addition, the discharge pattern of the nano-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> modified epoxy resin shows an obvious asymmetric feature of corona discharge at 10kV, while the epoxy resin insulation shows an asym-metric feature at 3kV. It can be seen that the nano-SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> modified epoxy resin has excellent resistance to partial discharge.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Ultra-High-Frequency Underwater Receiving Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on Maxwell equations, the propagation characteristics of ultra-high-frequency (UHF) electromagnetic waves in the three-layer medium of air-sea-foamed polyethylene (towed cable) are analyzed, and the basic design principles of UHF towed antenna in seawater are summarized. The conclusion is verified by FEKO electromagnetic simulation software. Based on the verified design principle, a kind of UHF transmitter-medium receiving antenna is designed, and its performance in the three-layer propagation medium is simulated and tested.

articleTitle: Research on Resource Scheduling Algorithms for Satellite Earth Stations
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Resource scheduling has always been a hot and difficult problem in systems engineering and management at home and abroad, and it is also very important in the research of satellite earth station system. Due to the limited resources in the satellite earth station system, the rationality of resource allocation directly affects the overall performance of the multi-satellite system. The resource scheduling problem of satellite earth station is a combinatorial optimization problem based on constraints.This paper summarizes the existing resource scheduling model and scheduling algorithm of satellite earth station system, and provides reference for the further research and development of this field.

articleTitle: Trajectory Tracking of The Wheeled Robot Based on Pulse Width Modulation Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To address the problem of expensive continuous actuators in the original trajectory tracking control method of the wheeled robot, a more cost-effective pulse width modulation controller is designed in this paper. The controller determines the duty cycle according to the state difference at the sampling instant, so as to change the power of the actuator to achieve the control purpose. Firstly, the mathematical model of the wheeled robot is established. Then, design the position control law based on error feedback. Through the analysis of the Lyapunov stability criterion, it is proved that the proposed control method can make the tracking error converge to zero asymptotically on the premise that the system reference trajectory is known, so as to realize the trajectory tracking. Finally, the effectiveness of the controller is verified by numerical simulation results.

articleTitle: A Disguising Method for Linear Vector Data Based on Least Square Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Linear vector spatial data has high economic and military value, and high-precision data in sensitive areas has important protection value. An information disguising method for linear vector data is introduced. Based on the characteristics of linear vector data, the basic principles and algorithm flow of linear vector data are analyzed. The data is compressed by D-P algorithm, and the information disguising of linear vector data is based on least square method. The experimental results show that this method has both security and bewilderment, meets the basic principle of information disguising of linear vector data, and can ensure the storage and transmission of important information.

articleTitle: ARMFS Algorithm: A Multi-Filter Selection Approach based on Akaike Information Criterion and Roulette Wheel
