Inspired by the probabilistic hesitant fuzzy set, this paper proposes the q-rung orthopair probabilistic hesitant fuzzy set, defines the operation of the q-rung orthopair probabilistic hesitant fuzzy set, and further proposes the q-rung orthopair probabilistic hesitant fuzzy arithmetic average operator and the geometric average operator and gives the details Calculation formula. Finally, a multi-attribute decision-making method based on the q-rung orthopair probabilistic hesitant fuzzy information integration operator is proposed.

Author Keywords: q-rung orthopair probabilistic hesitant fuzzy set

articleTitle: Radio Tomography Imaging based on Gaussian Mixture Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Radio tomographic imaging (RTI) system needs to have enough observed samples to ensure the performance of reconstruction. The method based on compressed sensing (CS) can effectively solve the problem of insufficient observed samples. However, this method cannot solve the problem that wireless signals in RTI network are affected by environmental noise, which results in the decrease of positioning accuracy. To solve this problem, we analyzed the characteristics of the received signal strength (RSS), used the Gaussian mixture model (GMM) to determine the acquired RSS observation samples to obtain the effective link in the wireless network, and then reconstructed it by the alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM).The experimental results show that when the voxel size is set as δ= 0.11m , the average positioning accuracy is improved by 36% and 9%, respectively, compared with the classical orthogonal matching pursuits (OMP) algorithm and Tikhonov algorithm. In the case of the same data, the reconstruction time based on GMM-ADMM algorithm is only 0.06 seconds, which is conducive to the real-time performance of the system.

articleTitle: An Attenuation Analysis Method for Lithium-ion Battery Based on Multi-core Rlevance Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries have broad application prospects, but the current methods for predicting the attenuation of lithium-ion batteries generally cannot meet the needs of actual use. This article uses multiple kernel function rlevance vector machines to predict the attenuation of lithium batteries, and is based on BAS The method selects the coefficients of multiple kernel functions of the relevance vector machine, selects the best combination of kernel functions, and then predicts by the method of multi-core vector machine. The results show that compared with the traditional RVM method, the method based on BAS-RVM has smaller prediction errors and can better meet the actual demand.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis and Research on the Influence of Buildings on a DVOR Station
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: DVOR is an important navigation device for civil aviation. Due to its own antenna characteristics and radiation pattern, DVOR station has higher requirements on the surrounding field. This paper studies the DVOR station with complex buildings around it, and restores the buildings and terrain around the station through three-dimensional simulation modeling, meanwhile analyzes the DVOR's AM modulation of 9960Hz and AM modulation of 30Hz and the alignment errors of different horizontal elevation angles. The simulation results show that moderately raising the DVOR’s counterpoise and increasing the radius of the DVOR’s counterpoise are an effective way to reduce the interference of surrounding buildings.

articleTitle: Several Data Analysis And Processing of Electronic Nose Data Preprocessing Subsystem
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Electronic nose is a kind of system that imitates biological olfactory organs. It uses different response sequences of gas sensor array to identify gas The electronic nose system consists of gas sensor array subsystem, electronic nose data analysis subsystem, electronic nose pattern recognition subsystem and electronic nose result discrimination subsystem. The development of electronic nose has two significant directions: miniaturization and systematization. This paper introduces the functions and components of the electronic nose system, focusing on several data analysis of process in the electronic nose system. There are mainly k-nearest neighbor, linear discriminant, principal component analysis and cluster analysis. The processing characteristics of these methods are analyzed and explained.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Terrain Slope on the Size of Localizer Critical and Sensitive Area
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The operational protection area of ILS localizer is a prescribed area near the localizer antenna, which included a critical zone and a sensitive zone. Such area prevents the possibility of unacceptable interference to the ILS signal during ILS operations, moving or stationary vehicles, aircraft and other objects during operation. ICAO Annex 10 has the following assumptions when defining a typical operational protection area: (1) The terrain is flat; (2) The glide path is 3°; (3) Allocations of 60 per cent of applicable tolerances for static multipath and 80 per cent for dynamic multipath; (4) An approaching aircraft at 105 knots. This paper uses software to analyze the impact of a single variable-the topographic slope of the airfield on the localizer operational protection area after excluding other influencing factors, and verifies the possibility of operational protection area reduction when the airfield slope is downhill, so that the efficiency of airport operations improvement can be achieved.

articleTitle: An Improved Embedding Model for Zero-Shot Classification based on Attention Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: It is well-known that the auxiliary information plays a key role in zero-shot classification. However, most of the existing popular methods do not make effective use of auxiliary information. To address this issue, we propose an improved embedding model for zero-shot classification based on attention mechanism, called EMAM. In the proposed EMAM, we first add an attention mechanism to effectively extract the key information of auxiliary information in zero-shot classification. Then optimizes the objective function to improve the recognition rate of this model. Finally the experimental comparison is implemented on the standard zero-shot learning datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that our proposed EMAM not only verifies its validity, but also achieves good results.

articleTitle: Dual-band Circularly Polarized Antenna Based on Loaded Shorting Pin
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of satellite navigation technology, multi-band circularly polarized navigation antennas have received widespread attention. Aiming at solving the problems of poor isolation caused by coupling feed in common multi-band antenna stacking designs, this paper proposes a dual-band circularly polarized microstrip antenna loaded with shorting pin, which covers the BDS-2B1 and BDS-2B3 of the BDS. The introduction of shorting pin greatly improves the isolation between antennas. In addition, "L"-shaped slots are cut on the patch and a dielectric substrate with high dielectric constant is used to achieve miniaturization, which reduces the size of the antenna by 32.22%. In order to further improve the antenna gain, a 2 × 2 array antenna constructed with the antenna unit is investigated, and simulation results are given, in which the gain can reach more than 8.50 dB.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Characteristic Analysis of Oil-paper Insulation System with Different Aging Degree
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to study the partial discharge characteristics of oil-paper insulation system with different degrees of aging, we used thermal aging method to prepare paperboards with different degrees of aging, and heated them for 1 day, 6 days, 16 days, 32 days and 48 days, respectively. In this experiment, the tip discharge model was adopted. The constant voltage method was adopted in the experiment to measure the initial discharge voltage and the tolerance time of the transformer insulating board tip discharge. The partial discharge patrol instrument was used to record the change of discharge characteristic quantity under different degrees of aging, and the broken line diagram was drawn according to the experimental data. The results show that in the early stage of discharge development, with the increase of pressure time, the more aging the insulating board, the more characteristic quantities such as total discharge, discharge times, maximum discharge and average discharge will be, and the more likely it will discharge.

articleTitle: Research on Integrated MPPT Control and Online Monitoring System of Microsatellite
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The power supply of the commercial aerospace microsatellite pursues a cost-effective system. To realize the intelligent autonomous control and management, a set of integrated MPPT control and online monitoring system based on DSP and LabVIEW is designed and developed, which consists of three parts: Superbuck charging module, MPPT control unit and monitoring unit. First, the Superbuck charging module contains the main power circuit and the data acquisition circuit, which realizes high-speed sampling and power conversion of the output parameters of the parallel PV array. Second, a fast and stable global maximum power point tracking algorithm based on voltage closed loop is proposed to solve the multi-peak problem of the PV array in the MPPT control unit. Third, the monitoring unit further analyzes the data based on CAN-bus protocol 2.0 to realize human-computer interaction. Experiments prove that this Integrated system can efficiently control and manage the output characteristics of the parallel PV array under different environments. Finally, the reliability of digital control under the circumstance of commercial aerospace is improved effectively.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Arbitrary Point FFT Based on RISC-V SoC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper designs and implements a dedicated microprocessor architecture based on the RISC-V (the fifth-generation Reduced Instruction Set Computing) with only 20 instructions for arbitrary-point FFT (Fast Fourier Transform) algorithm. Moreover, the corresponding SoC (System-on-Chip) is also built for the expansibility and reconfigurability. The methodology of software and hardware co-verification is applied to validate the correctness of the systematic functions by comparing the simulation results between MATLAB, Visual Studio 2019 and VIVADO 2019.1. Finally, the Xilinx Artix-7 (XC7A100TFGG484-2) FPGA (Field Programmable Gate Array) platform is used for implementation and prototyping of the proposed hardware system, which totally uses 1897 LUTs (Look-Up Tables), 361 FFs (Flip-Flops) and 25 BRAMs (Block Random Access Memory) and consumes 2.016W at 100MHz. The experimental results show that the presented system can realize the FFT algorithm at any point by reconfiguring the parameters of software and expanding the capacity of the memory, and it is suitable for the embedded applications due to the small area and low power consumption.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of reactive power optimization for distributed photovoltaic distribution network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, photovoltaic has been developing rapidly, which is of great significance to the research of reactive power optimization for distributed photovoltaic large scale connected distribution networks. The mathematical model of reactive power optimization in distributed photovoltaic distribution network is introduced in this paper, including the introduction of reactive power optimization algorithms and the object function and restrictions of reactive power optimization modeling.

Author Keywords: Reactive power opti mization of distribution network

articleTitle: AUCB: Accelerated Upper Confidence Bound Algorithm to Improve Caching Performance in Industrial Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of industrial network, the coexistence of best effort service and industrial service brings many challenges. An emerging problem is that industrial service will affect the load capacity of the network significantly. Hence, this paper proposes an intra-network caching algorithm based on reinforcement learning to reduce redundant traffic and enhance network scalability. First, we found the problem of insufficient bandwidth and scalability of industrial network. Above pressure can be relieved effectively through intra-network cache. Second, an accelerated upper confidence bound (AUCB) algorithm is designed to cope with the variable industrial request. Third, we evaluate the performance of AUCB through reasonable experiments. Corresponding results verified that AUCB can outperform other candidates for cache hit rate and average latency in both static and dynamic scenarios.

articleTitle: Research on the Strategy of Ballistic Missile Midcourse Recognition Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Midcourse recognition of ballistic missile is one of the core problems in anti-missile early warning operations. Considering the variety of penetration means of ballistic missile, aiming at the attitude characteristics of missile in midcourse flight, this paper focuses on the analysis of five technologies suitable for the midcourse recognition of the warhead, such as the RCS sequence, establishes a Bayesian network model for midcourse recognition of warhead, and standardizes the conditional probability representation of the results of the five techniques according to the actual usage. Finally, the effectiveness of the model is verified by simulation experiments. Through the Bayesian network comprehensive recognition method, the warhead target can be recognized quickly and accurately, and the model has a certain fault tolerance. This model can provide a reference for the warhead recognition in the midcourse of anti-missile early warning combat.

articleTitle: A Novel Reservoir Modeling Method based on Improved Hierarchical XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Reservoir classification and evaluation are critical during the oil and gas exploration and production, and traditional production forecasting often require complex methods such as reservoir modeling, which is time-consuming and will delay the E&P process. With the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, the production forecasting method based on machine learning has become a new hot spot for research. Since the characteristics of various reservoirs are different, it is difficult for conventional machine learning models to meet the required accuracy due to a large number of unknowns. In this paper, we proposed an improved hierarchical XGBoost (h-XGBoost) modeling method, which can effectively extract the features of different reservoirs and build a hierarchical data model. The study is conducted on tight conglomerates reservoir at the Mahu area in Xinjiang, and the results verify the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Evaluation of sEMG Pattern Recognition: A Preliminary Study for Prostheses
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Prostheses based on surface electromyography (sEMG) have been widely used to help amputees in daily life. To guide the manufacture of prostheses based on sEMG, in this paper we used pattern recognition composed of five features and SVM to classify 9 hand movements of 10 healthy subjects after sEMG data preprocessing. Through classification accuracy comparison, we determine the classification of finger movements is the difficulty of prostheses, and 4 or 5 sensor channels are suitable for different prostheses’ requirements. Finally, we propose that it is necessary to measure the sEMG signal of amputee for some time to determine the optimal sensor positions when customizing prosthesis.

articleTitle: PCA-based Wavelet Remote Sensing Image Synthesis Simulation Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The traditional image mosaic method directly replaces the remote sensing target image into the corresponding area of the background image, but "splicing traces" are prone to appear. This paper proposes a method of fusion of remote sensing background and target images under wavelet multi-frequency based on principal component analysis. First, the remote sensing background and target image are decomposed by wavelet, and then the fusion weight of the image wavelet low-frequency coefficient is calculated by the principal component analysis method, and the high-frequency coefficient is fused by the absolute maximum method, and finally the wavelet fusion coefficient is inversely transformed to realize the image synthesis simulation. The simulation results show that the fusion image can not only highlight the target features, but also has no stitching traces.

articleTitle: Research on Low Contrast Image Enhancement Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Finger-vein infrared images have shortcomings such as low signal-to-noise ratio, low ground contrast, and blurred edges. In finger-vein recognition technology, in order to improve the accuracy of finger-vein recognition, the image needs to be enhanced. This paper proposes an image enhancement algorithm based on Gabor filtering and adaptive histogram equalization. Firstly, the image is divided into sub-blocks, and the center frequency of the Gabor filter is set according to the gray gradient of each sub-block to filter the sub-images, and then the adaptive histogram equalization method is used to increase the contrast of finger-vein image. The experimental results show that proposed method can effectively improve the edge definition and contrast of the image while suppressing the noise signal of the finger vein image, and the effect of vein image enhancement is well improved.

articleTitle: Multi-classification of microblog’s comments based on feature combination
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Text classification algorithm develops rapidly in recent years, especially with the promotion of deep learning, the accuracy of various algorithms has reached a certain height. However, an obvious drawback of deep learning is that a large number of labeled samples is needed. In the case of unbalanced labeled samples, the result is not quite accurate of the category which has the minimum quantity. We consider that among a large number of comments, many of the top comments are positive but without involving valuable opinion. For the order depends on the user's level and the number of praises, while some really valuable comments may sink, it's hard for people to find them. The main work of this paper is to classify the comments into four types: valuable, negative, useless and normal. This paper has chosen ST-SVMs model, which realizes multi-classification through using SVM three times. At the same time, we proposed a concept of "Topic Proximity" which used LDA to extract the topic then used word2vec to calculate the similarity between the comments and topic. Then we give a combined feature, which consist of vector for comments text, sentiment intensity and topic proximity as the input features of the ST-SVMs model.

articleTitle: Research and Construction of Embedded Software Evaluation Technology System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the particularity of embedded software, the evaluation technology system of embedded software is constructed, aiming to provide reference for embedded software evaluation project and make contribution to ensure the quality of embedded software products. The system includes: test target, test standard library, traditional software test technology library, embedded software test technology library, software quality characteristic reference model, embedded software test environment, embedded software test process and test document library. The system is supported by the quality model and takes the standard library as the evaluation basis. The technology library is the means to improve the evaluation efficiency. The embedded software evaluation technology is deeply integrated with the industry standards to realize the comprehensive platform management and operation innovation.

articleTitle: Design of speed reducer testbed based on cloud platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to realize the remote monitoring of the reducer test-bed, a solution of the Internet of things based on the cloud PLC platform was proposed. The data of each reducer sensor and the control port of the test-bed were uploaded to the cloud PLC platform, and the communication protocol between them and the reducer test-bed was formulated. The test results show that the cloud PLC platform enables the operator to directly access the human-machine interaction interface via mobile APP or WEB to monitor the reducer test-bed or view the sensor data, which meets the enterprise's demand for real-time remote monitoring of the machine.

articleTitle: A Half-cut Miniaturized Ceramic Dielectric Filled Cavity Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper designs a miniaturized half-cut dielectric-filled cavity filter. It is different from the traditional cavity with a low dielectric constant support column supporting the upper dielectric cylinder structure with a high dielectric constant. In this paper, the dielectric resonator is composed of a solid cavity of ceramic dielectric with high dielectric constant and a layer of metal material coated on the outer surface of the dielectric. The bottom of the ceramic dielectric material is dug out a cylinder to form a resonant column with adjustable resonance frequency, and the outer surface is filled with metallic material silver. Acts as a shielding layer on the surface of the dielectric resonator. In order to further reduce the size of the filter on the basis of the miniaturization of the dielectric resonator, this design adopts a half-cut resonant column, which is miniaturized at the cost of slightly reducing the quality factor. Compared with the complete cylindrical resonant column, the volume can be reduced. Reduce by 30%. After electromagnetic software HFSS design and verification, a sixth-order band pass filter is obtained.

articleTitle: RGB-D Face Recognition via Spatial and Channel Attentions
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: After decades of extensive research, the field of 2D face recognition is fruitful. However, 2D face recognition is sensitive to changes in pose, facial expression and illumination. 3D face recognition has great potential due to the inherent invariance of pose and illumination changes, but these 3D face images are still difficult to acquire due to several issues such as cost and accessibility. In contrast, RGB-D images captured by low-cost depth sensors such as Kinect are relatively easy to acquire, and research on such low-quality inputs is still limited. In this thesis, an end-to-end multimodal fusion method based on spatial and channel attention is proposed to effectively fuse two image modalities, RGB and depth, to enhance RGB-D face recognition. Our work is specified as follows: firstly, three branches combined with the spatial and channel attention modules are established on the basis of ResNet18, so that the features of three modalities (RGB, depth map, and their fusion modalities, respectively) are obtained. The features under these three modalities are then fused, fed into a shared layer, and the fused features are further learned for deeper discriminative features and passed through a spatial attention vectorization module at the end. The method achieves good results on the Intellifusion RGBD dataset, while we perform ablation trials, which well reveal the contribution of each component of our method to the final performance.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis for Commercial Vehicle Drum Brakes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the popularization of automobiles and the improvement of people's requirements for travel, automobile safety has become more important. As a key component of the automobile safety system, the structure design scheme and performance of the brake directly determine the safety performance of the vehicle. Based on the finite element method, this paper takes a certain type of drum brake as the research object, uses the three-dimensional modeling software CATIA to establish the three-dimensional solid model of the part, and then uses ANSYS to establish the corresponding finite element model, and perform statics and modal analysis on the model. In terms of statics, stress concentration is likely to occur on the outer side of the brake drum near the restraint end; in terms of modal analysis, it is found that the low-order natural frequencies of the brake drum are mainly distributed between 500Hz-1000Hz, and the road excitation frequency also falls within this stage. Therefore, it is easy to cause braking noise and vibration, so the natural frequency in this range should be avoided in the subsequent structural design optimization process. The research in this paper provides new ideas for the design and optimization of brakes.

articleTitle: Research on Evaluation of Online Teaching Effect based on Deep Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of online teaching mode, this paper focuses on the relationship between facial expressions and teaching effects, and proposes an automatic facial expression recognition model. Use tensorflow software to verify and test the model in the Jaffe dataset. The experimental results show that after the facial expression recognition model performs 100 iterations, the model network reaches the level of convergence. In the training set, the model recognition rate reached 98.76%; in the test set, the model accuracy rate and F1 value reached 1.The model can correctly identify and distinguish Angry, Disgust, Fear, Happy, Sad, Surprise, Neutral 7 facial expressions. The model proposed can capture the changes in facial expressions of students in online classrooms, to help teachers grasp the learning status of students in real time, promote the improvement of online teaching quality, and have certain application value for online teaching quality evaluation.

articleTitle: Image scene classification based on discriminative clustering and weighted fusion representation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a new discriminative clustering method was proposed. For each traversing sliding block in the training samples, the deep features were extracted and their correlation distance matrices were obtained. The cluster was obtained by traversing the correlation distance matrix in turn from the minimum value, and the average value of each cluster was taken as the clustering center to construct the visual sub-codebook of each image category. The visual sub-codebooks of all the image categories were concatenated to construct the universal visual codebook. After the image segmentation, the local description of the image was obtained based on the universal visual codebook. The integrated image representation has richer semantics information than the single local or global description of an image. To obtain a more accurate image representation, in this paper, we weighted and fused the local information and the global information to form the final image representation. In the experiment, classifications were performed on two common scene datasets. The results showed that the image fusion representation of local and global information achieved better performance of classification.

articleTitle: Combining Sequence Learning and Dilated Convolution Network for Hippocampus Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the volume image of brain MRI, the volume of hippocampus is small, the boundary between hippocampus and surrounding tissue is fuzzy. In order to improve the accuracy of hippocampal segmentation, a new three-dimensional convolutional network is proposed which combines sequence learning and dilated convolution. The channel number of the convolution layer in the network is distributed in a downward increasing way, which effectively reduces the size of the parameters. Secondly, three-dimensional dilated convolution is used as the cascade convolution operation, which effectively combines the deep and shallow features of brain MRI, expands the receptive field of convolution layer and obtains multi-scale feature information, thus improving the segmentation performance of the network and greatly improving the segmentation accuracy. Experiments are carried out on the ADNI dataset, using dice similarity coefficient as evaluation indexes, and the accuracy reaches 89.23%. Experimental results show that the proposed network model makes full use of the three-dimensional spatial information of brain MRI images, and has better feature expression ability, thus greatly improving the segmentation accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on FM telemetry and demodulation performance of ship borne rocket based on MSD
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In ship borne TT&C system, PCM-FM system is widely used in rocket telemetry and demodulation. In practical application, due to the interference of rocket tail flame, the attitude changes frequently, the ship rocking is larger, the remote demodulation threshold is higher and so on, as a result, the ground equipment has a high probability of error code when the signal-to-noise ratio is lower than the demodulation threshold. In view of this situation, multi-symbol detection technology (MSD) can be used to reduce the demodulation threshold, overcome the adverse effects of the environment and threshold effect. This paper analyzes and verifies the performance of MSD technology used in rocket telemetry and demodulation, and provides a new parameter configuration mode, which is useful for practical engineering.

articleTitle: Scene Text Detection with Feature Aggregation and Receptive Field Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: We propose a scene text detection with feature aggregation and receptive field enhancement. It mainly improves the problem of wrong text segmentation. Specifically, a Feature Aggregation and Receptive Field Enhancement Module (FARE) adopts a ladder structure and constructs multi-scale feature aggregation with multiple branches to enhance the feature representation ability of texts of different scales. We add dilated convolution to expand the range of receptive field, which increases the detection of large-scale texts in low-level feature and obtains more accurate position information. Extensive experiments on the ICDAR 2015, ICDAR 2017 MLT, and CTW1500 show that the proposed method effectively improves the detection performance of the network. Notably, our proposed method has detected a precision of 87.4% on the curved text dataset CTW1500.

articleTitle: Research on Synchronous Control of Gantry-type Dual-driving Feed System based on Fuzzy Single Neuron PID Cross-coupled Controller
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The dual-driving feed system (DDFS) based on drive by center of gravity technology has been widely used because of its strong load capacity and better dynamic performance. For the influence of high feed speed and movement of moving parts on gantry-type DDFS, a new cross-coupled control algorithm was proposed. Based on the motion equation of DDFS, the differential equation of DDFS is obtained by considering the mechanical coupling of two axes and the change of friction on both sides of the beam caused by moving parts movement. The dynamic model of DDFS is obtained by Laplace transform. Use this dynamic model to design a single neuron PID cross-coupled controller (SNC) to optimize the synchronous performance and anti-interference ability between two axes. In addition, the fuzzy single neuron PID cross-coupled controller (FSNC) is designed to adjust the single neuron proportional coefficient K. The simulation and experiment show that the FSNC has the best synchronous performance and anti-interference ability when dealing with the movement of moving parts and the high-speed feed of beams.

articleTitle: Analysis of Parallel Misalignment of Gear Coupling in Rotor System Using EEMD-median Filter Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As a key part of the mechanical automation system, the gear coupling rotor system often occurs faults, and more than 60% of faults are caused by misalignment. In order to further explore the impact of misalignment on the dynamic performance of the rotor system and reduce the occurrence of faults. A signal processing method combining EEMD, median filter as well as FFT is introduced to denoise the original signal, and finite element model is built. A gear coupling-multi-span rotor system test platform is established and results of the finite element analysis is used to verify the experiment. Finally, the parallel misalignment of the gear coupling is simulated by adjusting the distribution of bearing seat gasket. The dynamic response results of the rotor system under different parallel misalignments and different speeds are studied and the impact of parallel misalignment on rotor system is obtained, which has guiding significance for reducing rotor faults.

articleTitle: An Method to Deal with the Abnormal Counter of BeiDou RDSS Receiver
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Through the deployment of monitoring receivers in different areas, continuous monitoring of BeiDou RDSS service quality is realized. Service quality parameters include success rate/service delay/location deviation/timing accuracy, etc. The monitoring receiver records the time of service application and the total number of service applications, the time of service reception and the total number of services received, and returns this information to the analysis center. However, due to the long-term operation of the receiver and the instability of the ground network, there will be problems such as data interruption/change in service counters. This paper proposes a method for detecting and processing anomalies in the return data of the monitoring receiver, and optimizes its implementation. This method has faster detection speed of abnormal data.

articleTitle: Locomotive number location based on Retinex image enhancement and improved SWT algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor robustness and low real-time performance of traditional algorithms for locomotive number location, a vehicle number location method based on Retinex image enhancement and improved stroke width transformation algorithm is proposed. Retinex algorithm is used to enhance the image edge information, and the edge detection and maximum stable extremum region algorithm are used to roughly locate the train number. Then, the improved stroke width transformation algorithm is used to calculate the stroke width and stroke gradient, and the threshold value is set to limit the search range of pixels to avoid global search and improve the timeliness of the algorithm. The experimental results show that compared with the existing algorithms, the positioning accuracy of the proposed algorithm is improved by 4.72%, the time complexity is reduced by 45.03% compared with the traditional stroke width transformation algorithm, and it also shows good positioning effect when applied to other scenes.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Anti-interference Communication Method Based on Game Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Wireless communication is vulnerable to malicious jamming due to its inherent broadcast characteristics. With the development of intelligent technology, the jammer can actively adjust the jamming strategy according to the feedback of the jamming effect, so as to achieve intelligent jamming with lower consumption and higher efficiency. The existence of intelligent jamming poses more serious challenges to the reliable transmission capacity of wireless communication system. In this paper, an intelligent anti-jamming communication method based on game learning is proposed. The communication confrontation between jammer and user is modeled as Stackelberg game, and intelligent anti-jamming decision-making in frequency domain is realized with the help of reinforcement learning algorithm, so as to improve the reliability of wireless transmission and realize intelligent anti-jamming communication in the jamming environment. The simulation results show that the proposed scheme can obtain stable policies, and the proposed anti-jamming communication method has higher anti-jamming performance than the conventional method.

articleTitle: Navigation Interference Signal Detection based on Array Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Today's electromagnetic countermeasures environment is complicated, and satellite navigation signals are relatively easy to be interfered by electromagnetic interference. At the same time, because the navigation signals are based on satellite communication, their signals are weak when they reach the receiver and are easily interrupted by interference. In order to achieve anti-interference and precise positioning in a complex electromagnetic environment, it is necessary to know the direction of the interference signal. Aiming at this problem, this paper has carried out the research on the direction of arrival estimation of the interference signal. By analyzing different antenna array models, this paper designs a six-element uniform circular array antenna, based on the MUSIC algorithm, and has made certain improvements. In this paper, the angle of the suppressive interference signal is detected, and the influence of different factors on the estimation is analyzed. Through experimental simulation, it is verified that the method proposed in this paper can accurately estimate the direction of the interference signal and achieve good results.

articleTitle: Local Path Planning Algorithm of Mobile Robot by Modified Optimized Parameters Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Path planning algorithm is an important part that affects the navigation effect of autonomous mobile robot. In order to improve the navigation effect, many scholars have studied SLAM and path planning algorithm. However, few people have studied the evaluation parameters of local path planning algorithm Dynamic Window Approach. Aiming at the problem of selecting and assigning evaluation parameters of the local path planning algorithm DWA, this paper presents a new set of solutions. The optimal parameter combination is solved through a combination of simulation and experiment. The results show that the obtained parameter combination can be more smoothly and efficiently in the process of mobile robot navigation path.

articleTitle: Estimation of Driving State of Formula Car Based on Data Fusion and AUKF
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Vehicle driving status information is essential to improve the safety and performance of formula racing, but obtaining high-precision driving parameters is often costly. Based on the adaptive unscented Kalman filter of filter fusion, this paper applied a low-cost and high-precision method to predict the lateral and longitudinal acceleration of a vehicle. This paper embeds part of the data of the Dugoff tire model into the filter structure, which greatly improves the data utilization rate and realizes the further optimization of the filter effect. By using the information fusion-based AUKF algorithm to estimate the driving state of a high-speed formula racing, accurate estimation results can be obtained. The results show that the filter effect of this algorithm significantly exceeds that of UKF.

articleTitle: Intra-frame fast coding algorithm for 3D-HEVC depth map based on two-dimensional entropy and variance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The 3D-High Efficiency Video Coding Standard (HEVC)[1] improves the coding quality by employing multi-viewpoint and depth map coding formats. However, the 3D-HEVC algorithm has high time complexity due to the determination process of the coding unit (CU) size and the recursive rate-distortion cost calculation. To address this problem, we present a fast algorithm, which aims to reduce the time of not only deep image segmentation decision but also the powerful RD optimization. Through fast decision-making on the 3D-HEVC depth map coding unit (CU), which is based on two-dimensional entropy of image and variance, the coding efficiency is improved rapidly. The benchmark experimental on the basic database show that the coding time of the proposed algorithm is reduced by 36.7%.

articleTitle: Finite Time Ship Consistency of Nonlinear Multiagent Systems Based on Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the problem of finite time consistency control of the nonlinear multi-agent system of ship course. Under the constraints of unmeasurable speed and input saturation, a finite-time control protocol with a second-order sliding mode observer is proposed. The Lyapunov stability theory and homogeneous theory are used to prove that the ship multi-agent system can provide The speed information of the ship agent can be effectively estimated under the agreement to achieve finite time consistency and effective estimation. Finally, the validity of the control protocol is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Control method based on nonlinear extended state observer to tracking the trajectory for mechanical arm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper we propose a novel control based on nonlinear extended state observer, which can effectively control the industrial manipulator system with interference and delay, and the interference delay in the system can be estimated and compensated online by this algorithm. The output of the system can track the trajectory stably. The response time is shorter and the steady-state error is smaller than the controller which is used to be.

articleTitle: A compliant origami mechanism driven by tendon-sheath
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Origami, as a new research direction, has an excellent performance on deployable structures. However, due to its compact configuration, the self-folding of origami is difficult to control by traditional driven mode. In this paper, a common origami pattern, waterbomb pattern, is studied and the deformation of the pattern is controlled by tendon-sheath. By constructing coordinate transformation matrix system, the relative position of vertexes in origami at any time when folding can be obtained. The origami mechanism is designed using flexible hinges as the crease and made by 3D printing rubber materials. Finally, an experiment is made to verify the accuracy of the design. The research of origami mechanism will be applied in the storage of solar arrays and modular construction of soft bionic robot, providing a more stable and automatic control scheme.

articleTitle: Multimodal Human-robot Interaction on Service Robot
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of multimodal fusion in human-robot interaction (HRI), an improved technique is proposed to synthesize visual and audio data. The robotic auditory system uses a microphone array to obtain auditory information and uses the MUSIC algorithm to determine the azimuth of the sound source, and uses end-to-end gating CNN recognizes speech results; For the visual system, a two-layer neural network system is used to detect and recognize dynamic gestures. An improved D-S evidence theory algorithm based on the rule intention voter is designed to fuse the output results of the two modules for determining intention of the current interactive object. Experimental results validate the efficiency and accuracy of multimodal fusion system.

articleTitle: The Method of Disentangled and Interpretable Representations for Speech Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: We study the problem of speech enhancement in monophonic and variety noisy conditions. Most speech enhancement models have successfully mapped noisy speech features to clean speech features through the deep network. However, analyzation of sequence data multi-scale information still has great challenges, which is important for the speech signal. In this paper, we present an end-to-end hierarchical model , combining factorized hierarchical autoencoder (FHVAE) and independently recurrent neural network (indRNN) structures, which learns disentangled and interpretable representations from speech data in unsupervision way. Compared to other end-to-end models, this encoder can be used to capture the features of speech linguistic and background noise, then encode them into latent variables at different levels. And speech enhancement is achieved by manipulating latent variables of noise conditions. The objective evaluation results demonstrate that the proposed model has better improvements than classic methods, and the training time is shorter than the others.

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance Prediction System of Hospital Distribution Robot Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the global outbreak of COVID-19, the normalization of epidemic is a serious fact that people have to deal with. In this paper, obstacle avoidance prediction system based on deep learning is designed to forecast and avoid obstacles. The system firstly is used the bidirectional cyclic neural network to predict pedestrian trajectory to generate dynamic obstacle information. With dynamic obstacle information into global information, the hospital distribution robot with the system can load static obstacle information and merge. The effectiveness of the system is verified through simulation experiments in two scenarios of complex areas and straight corridors in the hospital. Simulation experiments show that it realizes global path planning through dynamic window method. The obstacle avoidance prediction system of this paper can avoid direct contact between doctors and mild patients and reduce the workload of medical staff and the risk of infection effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Feature Extraction and Matching Algorithm in Visual SLAM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the application of visual SLAM, an improved ORB feature extraction and matching algorithm is proposed to overcome the shortcomings of the original ORB algorithm. In order to improve the stability of the scale, a multi-scale spatial pyramid is established to detect and extract the FAST feature points of each grid in different scales, so as to improve the stability of the scale; the quadtree method is used to divide the feature points to make the distribution more uniform; after the coarse matching, the PRASAC method is used to eliminate the wrong matching points, which improves the matching accuracy. Experimental results show that the algorithm can effectively improve the matching accuracy and efficiency, and meet the requirements of robustness and real-time in visual SLAM.

articleTitle: Research on Four-Rotor UAV Control System Based on Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, in view of the traditional four-rotor UAV PID controller after interference response rate is too slow, and there is a small range of control accuracy problem in fuzzy control, fuzzy control and PID control combined, designed an improved fuzzy PID control system. The optimized attitude information and position information are taken as the input part of the system, and then the fast and stable output of the quad-rotor UAV can be obtained through the defuzzing set. Finally, simulation and experiment show that the fuzzy control system can achieve the ideal control effect.

articleTitle: Combined attention mechanism and CenterNet pedestrian detection algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Traditional pedestrian detection methods can no longer be effective improvement of pedestrian detection, so this paper proposes a pedestrian detection method combined with the attention mechanism, SE-Net attention mechanism and ECA-Net attention mechanism for channel focusing on sex to suppress some not important information channel, which greatly improves the recognition accuracy. Algorithm in this paper, based on CenterNet experiment, by predicting the pedestrian center and return the size information, this kind of anchor-free algorithm greatly reduces the time complexity. By targeting some occlusion and small scale pedestrian attention, our results on the ETH dataset are a good improvement over the original network.

articleTitle: Logistic Regression Based on Bat-Inspired Algorithm with Gaussian Initialization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Logistic regression is a supervised statistical learning method in the field of statistics and machine learning nowadays. The core idea of traditional logistic regression algorithm is to use gradient descent method to find the optimal parameter of loss function with certain convexity. As far as this kind of nonlinear problem is concerned, gradient descent (GD) method or stochastic gradient descent (SGD) method in linear search is generally used, however, there are some shortcomings of GD and SGD in dealing with the optimal parameter finding issue for loss function with certain convexity. Therefore, it is of great significance to study such issue that traditional logistic regression cannot properly handle. As a matter of fact, in the process of solving the optimal parameter of convex loss function, bat heuristic algorithm can be used to replace the traditional penalty function method, moreover, bat heuristic algorithm is a gradient independent, swarm intelligence algorithm, which can avoid falling into local minimum trap by dynamically controlling parameters. In this paper, batbased logistic regression algorithm has been proposed so as to deal with the multi-data classification problem, the proposed method can not only handle data without gradient information, but handle data without differentiable node transfer function as well, and its effectiveness has been strictly verified via numerical analysis.

articleTitle: Finite element study of thermal flow gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel thermal flow gyroscope is proposed and its sensitive mechanism is revealed. By means of finite element method, COMSOL Multiphysics was used to calculate the temperature field variation of the sensitive element of the gyroscope with or without angular velocity. The results show that the thermal flow gyroscope has the gyroscope effect. Within the angular velocity range of ±20rad/s, the proportional coefficient k between the input angular velocity and the output voltage is 0.005 V/rad/s, the sensitivity is 5.29×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>V/rad/s, and the nonlinearity is 6.81%. This study lays a theoretical foundation for the subsequent structural improvement and performance optimization.

articleTitle: Emergency Rescue Training System for Earthquakes Based on Immersive Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to quickly and accurately implement emergency rescue after earthquake and save lives and property, this paper proposes an emergency rescue training system based on immersion technology. The system uses virtual reality, augmented reality and mixed reality technology to construct a real and virtual interwoven training environment. Compared with the traditional emergency rescue training, this method is not limited by time and site, and enables the trainees to immerse themselves in the earthquake environment for operation. The system consists of four main functional modules: cognition of fault movement, recognition of earthquake precursor, simulation of earthquake scene, and training of emergency rescue.

articleTitle: Overload Analysis of Distribution Transformers Based on Relevance Analyse and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the long-term heavy overload problem in distribution network operation. In order to avoid the impact of heavy overload on the power system and prepare response measures in advance,, this paper proposes an analysis method of heavy overload influence factors based on relevance analyse and machine learning. Firstly based on distribution transformer historical load information, weather, customer information, etc., to find out the factors affecting the overload of the distribution transformer with Apriori algorithm, on this basis, determine the input variables. Then, use the long short-term memory (LSTM) network to establish the overload prediction model, and the experiment was carried out on the collected multi element overload data. The results show that the model has high prediction accuracy and strong robustness in dealing with large scale multivariable time series data.

articleTitle: Measurement of Respiration Rate Using Thermal Imaging
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Respiration rate (RR) refers to the number of breaths per minute of a person. It is one of the primary health parameters. The current method of measuring RR is to attach a sensor to the patient, leading to discomfort and stress. The method discussed in this paper is contactless, by using thermal imaging of nostril air flow. The proposed method, for the sake of detection accuracy, consists of two major components: (1) robust detection of region of interest (ROI), the nasal canthus and the nasolabial groove area. (2) reliable tracking of ROI in image sequences using particle filter. Preliminary experimental results with 5 volunteers have shown its high detection accuracy: relative error rate less than 2%.

articleTitle: A Vehicle Detection Method Based on Improved YOLOv3
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of vehicle detection, this paper proposes a vehicle detection method based on improved YOLOv3. First, the loss function of the YOLOv3 algorithm is improved by introducing the GIoU and focal loss strategies, meanwhile, the detection accuracy of the network is improved. Secondly, by adopting the method of data augmentation for preprocessing, adding label smoothing strategy improves the generalization ability of the model and further improves the average accuracy of detection. During training, multi-scale training is used, and the cosine decay learning rate decay strategy is used to replace the step learning rate decay strategy, which reduces the negative impact of improper learning rate and decay steps, speeds up model training, and reduces the network training cycle. Experimental results show that the improved method can significantly improve the detection accuracy of the original model in fewer training cycles, has good robustness, and can effectively detect road vehicles.

articleTitle: Design of Synchronous Rectification DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a buck converter based on synchronous rectification is designed. In this design, the rectifier tube is replaced with a MOSFET to raise the efficiency. In addition, type III compensation network is used to constitute the voltage close loop for getting the better performance. Compensation network was designed by Mathcad. Finally, we find the gain transfer function for the close loop, which is up to the mustard. At last, through the simulation with MATLAB, we get the output voltage waveform and the output voltage ripple under different conditions. It shows that compared with the open loop circuit, the close loop circuit has a better performance. To be specific, the output voltage ripple is smaller, the response time is shorter and the anti-disturbance ability is stronger. In conclusion, the result is consistent with the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Computational Offloading Strategy Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning in Small cell networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of communication technology in recent years, computing-intensive services such as virtual reality and face recognition are rapidly popularized. These services not only bring challenges to resource-constrained networks, but also cause a large amount of energy consumption and high delay on mobile devices with limited computing power and battery capacity. Mobile edge computing technology and small cell networks are the research hotspots in 5G era. Combining these two technologies can enable the network to have stronger coverage to provide users with more powerful computing power. In this paper, we propose a computing offloading algorithm model based on deep reinforcement learning in small cell networks. Considering the battery power of mobile devices and dynamic network bandwidth, the proposed algorithm aims to complete computing offload with a smaller overall overhead. The simulation shows that the performance of the proposed computational offloading algorithm is better than the comparative algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of An Operation and Maintenance Platform for AETA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: AETA (Acoustic & Electromagnetic Testing All in one system) is a kind of system applied to seismic monitoring, but it has some problems, such as difficulty in equipment monitoring, long troubleshooting cycles and non-standard operation and maintenance. In order to ensure the long-term stable operation of the system, a safe, reasonable and efficient operation and maintenance platform is designed and implemented in this paper. The platform has such functions as real-time monitoring, log parsing, access control and information management, etc. Results show that this platform can locate faults within 10 minutes, which provides an important guarantee for the safety and integrity of AETA mass data.

articleTitle: A method Of Rsu Event Information Forwarding Strategy In V2X Scene
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the scenario of vehicle-road collaboration, it will make full use of the integration of vehicle-side and road-side sensing devices to eliminate perception blind spots. The road-side sensing equipment is responsible for most of the sensing tasks. The various data collected by it can be uploaded and sent through the RSU. When the business latency requirements are high, the local MEC (Mobile Edge Computing) complete the calculation, and then send it to vehicles or pedestrians through RSU. Therefore, it can be considered that RSU is responsible for the tasks of high-density monitoring and periodic distribution. Based on this, in view of the shortcomings of the prior art, the present invention aims to provide a method of RSU time information forwarding strategy in V2X scenarios, which can expand the coverage of notification information, flexibly rely on the communication between people, vehicles, roads and networks, and increase the safety level of traffic accidents. The accuracy of the setting has the advantage of adapting to the new technical background of V2X.

articleTitle: A Parameter Setting Method of Soft Sensor Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of soft sensor modeling based on statistical method is studied, and a general soft sensor model architecture and its parameter setting method are proposed. Taking the AMS concentration estimation of the actual Styrene Distillation Process as an example, the validity of the proposed model and its updating algorithm were verified, which laid a foundation for the following quality control.

articleTitle: Fine-grained image classification algorithm based on Attention Self-supervision
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the purpose of image classification is not only to identify the major categories of objects, but also to classify the images of the same category into more detailed subcategories. In order to effectively discriminate small differences between regions, a fine-grained classification algorithm was proposed based on Attention Self-supervision (ASS). Firstly, the ResNet-152 pre-trained model was applied to extract the global image features and to forecast the attention maps with Depthwise Separable convolution (DS conv). Subsequently, the Weakly Supervised Data Augmentation Network (WS-DAN) was applied to feed the augmented image back into the network and enhance the generalization ability of the network to prevent overfitting. Finally, linear fusion of attention features in ASS network was further performed to improve the accuracy of the classification. The experimental results show that the method achieves 89.6% accuracy rate on CUB-200-2011 dataset.

articleTitle: Human Upper-Body Inverse Kinematics for Consumer Grade Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In virtual reality (VR), being able to see your own virtual avatar instead of floating head and hands can enhance the immersion. However, most consumer VR devices only provide limited tracker data. In order to reconstruct human upper body movements from rare tracking data, we propose the HeadIK method based on human inverse dynamics optimization, and our research shows that this method can achieve the reconstruction of upper body movements using only the head-mounted display and the handle, which can enhance the immersion of VR experience.

articleTitle: Outdoor Air Quality Real-time Monitoring System for Sports Athletes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to monitor the air quality of sports athletes in outdoor training and competitions in real time and protect their health, a real-time online monitoring system for outdoor air quality has been designed. The air quality data acquisition system takes STM32F103ZET6 as the core, collects the temperature and humidity, carbon dioxide, PM2.5, PM10 and other parameters in the air through the idea of multi-sensor integration. The collected data is sent to the cloud through a fixed data protocol through the 4G communication module. Based on the SpringBoot microservice architecture, a cloud platform for real-time monitoring of outdoor air quality has been built. Choose Spring, SpringMVC, Mybatis Plus and Apache Tomcat back-end web application service framework to write microservices for environmental air quality data processing. Using Vue progressive front-end framework, development environment data visualization analysis Web platform.

articleTitle: A Time Delay Estimation Method of LFM Hybrid Signals Based on Hough Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In actual passive positioning systems, linear frequency modulation (LFM) hybrid signals at low signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) are often received by communication devices. Because of the pseudo correlation peaks and peak matching problems, the time delay cannot be accurately estimated by the traditional basic correlation method (BCM) and generalized correlation method (GCM). Thus, a peak detection method based on Hough transform is proposed in this paper. By cyclic correlation, peak detection, and line fitting, the time delays are determined as the intercepts on the cycle frequency coordinate axis. In addition, the signals with different frequency modulation (FM) slopes can be distinguished by the signal slopes, and the signal delays can be matched. Monte Carlo simulation results show that the accuracy ratio and minimum mean square error (MMSE) of the proposed method perform better than the traditional BCM and GCM at low SNRs.

articleTitle: Power grid fault detection method based on cloud platform and improved isolated forest
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to avoid equipment failures that may occur during power generation and transportation, real-time fault detection and diagnosis are required. Based on the cloud computing architecture, this paper proposes a fault detection method suitable for the power grid cloud platform. The method first improved the isolated forest model. After that, a power grid cloud platform was built, which was divided into three layers. The field layer collects the data generated by the various monitoring systems at the equipment layer and uploads it to the cloud center layer after data preprocessing; The cloud center layer uses the previously stored data to parallelize and iteratively train the improved isolated forest model, and the trained model can classify the faults that occur. Finally, the accuracy of the method is proved through experiments.

articleTitle: Hybrid Collaborative Filtering Recommendation Algorithm for ALS Model Based on a Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the advantages of parallel computing on a big data platform, an improved algorithm for the ALS model under a big data platform is proposed. According to the number of users' visits, the hybrid recommendation is carried out, and a similar user reconstruction matrix model is used for optimization. Experiments show that: the ALS model hybrid collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm based on big data platform can improve the recommendation accuracy compared with the traditional K-means clustering recommendation algorithm, the article based recommendation algorithm, and the tag-based recommendation algorithm, and the acceleration ratio increases significantly with the increase of nodes when the big data set are running.

articleTitle: Research on Sitting Method of Transmission Channel Environmental Monitoring Device under Rugged Terrain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, the application of transmission channel environment on-line monitoring device has played an important role in improving the level of power grid support capability. In order to further optimize the deployment of monitoring devices, it is necessary to establish a sitting method which adequately considers the environmental characteristics. Based on the analysis of the altitude data at transmission line tower location, a sitting method of monitoring device considering terrain characteristics is established. According to altitude data, five terrain categories, including "Uphill", "Downhill", "Top", "Valley" and "Flat", are proposed, and the terrain judgment method of line tower is formed. On this foundation, a sitting method of monitoring device is set up, and the influence of mountainous terrain is considered, typical monitoring blind areas correction is completed. The analysis of calculation results show that this method can focus on mountain coverage on the basis of whole section monitoring at transmission channel, and the density of monitoring device can well match with the terrain. An application of the research can provide guidance for the development of transmission channel monitoring.

articleTitle: PSO-BP Neural Network Based Speech Recognition Research
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Speech recognition technology has a very important application in the field of machine learning. Based on the use of BP neural network to recognize ten English words, this paper uses particle swarm algorithm to optimize the weights and thresholds of BP neural network to solve the problem of neural network weights easily falling into local extreme values. The simulation results show that the improved neural network has higher prediction accuracy and faster convergence speed, which improves the generalization ability of the neural network to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Welding Path Planning Algorithm for Medium-Thick Plate based on Process Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Most of medium-thick plates are connected by multi-layer and multi pass welding. This paper deals with multi - layer and multi - pass welding of single side V-groove of medium-thick plate. In this paper, the multi-layer and multi-pass welding of medium-thick plate is mainly studied. Firstly, a welding track planning algorithm based on welding parameters is proposed, then the relationship between welding parameters and welding forming coefficient is obtained through experiments on different welding parameters by automatic welding equipment. Finally, the algorithm is verified by automatic welding, after quality inspection, the test plate for welded steel members conforms to the practical engineering standard. The algorithm can guide the welding operation of the automatic welding equipment in the actual construction site.

articleTitle: Design of digital system development platform based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper introduced a multi-functional digital system development platform based on FPGA hardware circuit and VHDL hardware description language. The control circuit with Intel® Cyclone® IV E FPGA as the core and Intel® Quartus® Prime as the core was adopted to design software. Through the hardware description language, precise control vector output, digital tube display, lattice screen display, vector display and other experimental functions could be achieved.

articleTitle: Medical Image Fusion Based a Densely Connected Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Image fusion method based on deep learning has achieved great success. In order to obtain better performance, researchers keep deepening the network structure, but it also brings greater computational burden. Compared with the traditional convolutional structure, Dense Convolutional Network (DenseNet) achieves a good balance between performance and computational complexity. Therefore, in this paper, we present a novel medical image fusion method based on DenseNet, which achieves feature reuse by connecting features over channels, and enables the algorithm to achieve better performance than traditional networks with fewer parameters and calculation costs. The experimental results show that, on the premise that the convolution structure layers of the proposed method is far less than that of the state-of-the-art deep learning method, the fused image details are still well preserved, and the objective assessment indices are better than that of the traditional transformation domain methods and close to the state-of-the-art deep learning method.

articleTitle: Object Detection of Alternanthera Philoxeroides at Seedling Stage in Paddy Field Based on Faster R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Weed competing with the rice seedlings for resources, which also provided a better condition for pests and diseases. Targeted spraying herbicide of weed was the key to greatly reduce pesticides and reduce pollution. Weed category information and position detection were the basis of the field intelligence management. In order to realize the automatic recognition and position detection of weed from the complicated background and the natural light in the paddy field, this paper presented a new recognition method for weeds at seedling stage in paddy fields using Faster R-CNN (convolutional neural network). In this proposed method, transfer learning and target detection framework with Faster R-CNN were combined, and transfer the feature extractor of pre-training network model VGG16 and AlexNet. The result indicated that the recognition accuracy of Faster R-CNN with backbone network of VGG16 is better than the that of AlexNet, which could reach 82.47%.

articleTitle: Research on line loss prediction model based on clustering and multi prediction model fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the influence of many factors in power grid, the prediction accuracy of line loss rate is not high and it’s applicability is poor. To solve this problem, a line loss rate prediction model based on density clustering and ensemble method is proposed. 18 characteristics related to distribution network in 2019 are selected as independent variables, and comprehensive line loss rate in 2019 is taken as dependent variable. The DBSCAN clustering algorithm is used to cluster the data set, and the random forest and LR- Bagging are used to predict each type of data respectively, and a combined line loss rate prediction model is established. The experimental results show that the prediction accuracy and universality of line loss rate can be effectively improved after the processing of clustering algorithm and a variety of integrated prediction methods.

articleTitle: Super-Resolution Imaging Method Based on Fast Maximum likelihood
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This article proposes an fast Maximum likelihood(FML) algorithm for the problem of slow iteration speed of Maximum likelihood(ML) algorithm. The algorithm creates an adaptive iteration acceleration factor. Use the gradient descent method to determine the value of the acceleration factor, so as to achieve fast iteration. The simulation results show that the algorithm can achieve better performance in the same time under the simulation conditions. This algorithm effectively reduces the computational complexity of the ML algorithm, can increase the processing speed of the radar and improve the detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on CMOPSO Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm for Green Manufacturing Energy System in Ecological Park
