abstract: For the sake of accurately obtain the reaction rate constant and reaction order in the curing kinetic model of epoxy resin, aiming at the problem that it is difficult to determine the parameters of the curing kinetic model of epoxy resin, the fitting problem is transformed into a multi-objective optimization problem, the coefficients to be solved are put into a vector into the fitness function, and the ant lion algorithm is used to iteratively optimize the optimal solution vector. Through coarse search and detailed search, the size of solution space is reduced, and the optimal roulette roulette strategy is added to prevent the algorithm from falling into the local optimal solution. Finally, Nash efficiency coefficient was used to test the fitting results. The test results show that the ant lion algorithm has high accuracy and application value in determining the parameters of epoxy resin curing kinetics model.

articleTitle: A Star Pattern Recognition Algorithm Based on Coordinate Transformation of Polar Coordinate System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of large image files, high frame rate, and high single-frame pixels of the starry sky video files captured by the camera array system, when the recognition rate of the classic star pattern recognition algorithm is slow, and the traditional image processing algorithm cannot be used, a solution including a star map recognition method based on polar coordinate transformation is proposed. The star point feature descriptor established by the algorithm has the characteristics of small space occupancy and fast matching speed. In the process of capturing image files taken by the camera array system, the algorithm can be further improved to make the matching recognition time within 30 milliseconds while ensuring the recognition rate.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Genetic Algorithms in Corporal Portal Search Engines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper introduces the genetic algorithm followed by implementation steps of it. We began our work with researching and summarizing the application of genetic algorithm in Search Engine Optimization (SEO) of enterprise portal, which shows the effectiveness of genetic algorithm deployed in solving the query optimization problem. Later on, we gave the implementation steps and system framework of the query optimization method based on genetic algorithm. Related studies have proved that genetic algorithm applied in SEO have the potential to optimize the search engine of enterprise portal and achieve fair results.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Flow Test of Typical Fuel Cell Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A typical fuel cell vehicle SUV, based on the characteristics of hydrogen consumption and power consumption of fuel cell vehicle, the multi-channel data fusion data acquisition method is used for bench test. Taking NEDC and CLTC cycles as examples, the energy flow of vehicle under steady state and working mode is analyzed and studied. The distribution mechanism of hydrogen consumption and power consumption is comprehensively tested, which provides reference for the development of domestic fuel cell vehicles.

articleTitle: Laser Ultrasound in Transmission Mode for Defect Detection of Additive Manufactured Parts
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Laser ultrasonic non-destructive inspection may be difficult to detect small defects inside additive manufactured components due to weak longitudinal waves propagation. This paper proposes a defect detection method of using laser ultrasonic transverse waves in transmission mode. This method uses a scanning procedure of synchronously moving the laser ultrasound generator and the ultrasound detector on the opposite side of the sample. The cross-correlation algorithm is used to calculate the time delay of the transmitted transverse wave at each scanning point. Finally, the location of the internal defect can be estimated by considering the thickness of the sample and the distance between the two maximum signal delay points in the left scanning and the right scanning. The numerical simulation using finite elements method and the experimental results show that this method can successfully identify the internal defect of 1 mm diameter inside the additive manufactured 316L stainless steel components.

articleTitle: Polynomial Image Enlargement based on Edge Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes an image enlargement method that approximates the original image scene by constructing a polynomial surface and using edges information as a feature constraint to solve the problem that can not virtually guarantee edge sharpening during the image enlargement process. First, we use the detection operator to preprocess the image and save the high-frequency information of the edges. Second, we use the sampling formula and edge information of the image as constraints to construct the fitting surface patch. The new method uses edge high-frequency information as suggestions for interpolation polynomials. Experiments and the comparison between other methods show that the images generated by this method have extraordinary visual effects, which are beneficial to medical image processing and other engineering applications and practices.

articleTitle: Adaptive Cancellation Method of Ambient Noise in Corona Audible Signals based on Delayed Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Spectral subtraction and low-pass filtering, which are commonly used to eliminate the ambient noise mixed in corona audible signals, will damage the spectrum of corona audible signals. In order to reduce the damage to the corona audible signal spectrum caused by the noise canceling process, firstly, this paper defines three evaluation indexes of noise elimination effect according to the difference between the audible signal of corona and the environmental noise at 20 ~ 20KHz. Then, use the low-pass filter to pre-process the signal to eliminate the harmonic components in the ambient noise. Finally, the delay signal is selected as a reference signal to adaptively eliminate the ambient noise Simulation and experimental results show that this method can effectively eliminate the ambient noise in the corona audible signal.

articleTitle: Research on grid-connected in distributed photovoltaic power generation system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation, as a clean and renewable energy source, has broad development prospects. With the extensive development of distributed power generation technology, photovoltaic power generation has been widely used. Status of grid-connected distributed photovoltaic system is researched in this paper, and the impact of distributed photovoltaic power generation on the power distribution network is analyzed in terms of power flow, node voltage and network loss.

articleTitle: Performance of the HL-2A Bonner sphere spectrometer in monoenergetic neutron fields from 100 keV to 1 MeV
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The Bonner sphere spectrometer (BSS) designed for the neutron spectrum measurement at HL-2A Tokamak was calibrated by using monoenergetic neutrons on the electrostatic accelerator. The electronic system of the spectrometer was developed based on FPGA and PXI bus communication. The BSS response function generated with the Monte Carlo tool Geant4 was validated and corrected by the calibration experiment. The performance of the BSS in monoenergetic neutron fields from 100 keV to 1 MeV proved that the difference between the simulated and measured response function was under 15%, and the monoenergetic neutron spectrums were unfolded successfully by using the calibrated BSS system.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Judgment Technology of Monitoring Alarm Based on Power Grid Topology Division
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to effectively solve the problems of discrete and complex alarm information and single display means in power dispatching automation system, this paper proposes an intelligent research and judgment technology of power grid monitoring alarm based on power grid topology analysis. According to the topology search of adjacent devices and the topology search of power supply path, this method divides the devices with electrical relationship, integrates the alarm data regularly according to the electrical associated path of the equipment, and forms different alarm data sets; through the alarm data set, keyword extraction and knowledge evaluation network are established to study and judge the alarm information. This method can assist the dispatcher to locate the key equipment of operation monitoring in time. It can quickly and effectively screen and extract important information from the massive operation data, and improve the speed and reliability of power grid monitoring alarm.

articleTitle: Doppler-aided EWL Cycle Slip Detection and Repair Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Global Satellite Navigation System (GNSS) has become one of the most important infrastructural facilities for major countries in the world. GPS carrier phase observations are often used for high precision positioning, but are susceptible to the influence of cycle slips. The EWL (extra-wide-lane) combination, for longer combination wavelengths, is frequently used for detecting and repairing cycle slips. The EWL combination adopts carrier phase and pseudorange observations; but in some cases, pseudorange observations have proven to be imprecise or inapplicable. Based on the traditional EWL model, a Doppler-aided EWL cycle slip detection and repair model is proposed herein. The model is applicable to situations where the ionosphere is stable and the sampling rate is high. Analyzing the static experimental data with 1s sampling interval, it could be observed that combining the proposed new method with traditional EWL method before adding any cycle slip will lower the first-order difference of integer ambiguity down to less than 0.5 cycles. This implies that the new method is also applicable to cycle slips detectable and reparable by traditional EWL methods. However, the ionospheric delay term reintroduced by the new method still requires further research.

articleTitle: A Forwarding Prediction Model of Social Network based on Heterogeneous Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Weibo and other online social networks have be-come the basic platform for information dissemination and diffusion. Prediction of information forwarding in social networks has attracted a lot of research work, especially how to effectively consider the characteristics of users and information, as well as the interaction between them. In this paper, we construct a weighted heterogeneous network based on users and information, and propose an improved heterogeneous network graph representation algorithm Mpath-wMetapath2vec to generate low dimensional representation for forwarding prediction. The experimental results on Weibo dataset show that our model outperforms the algorithms without considering node features and other graph vector representation algorithms.

articleTitle: Development of Measuring Instrument for Inner and Outer Diameters of Bearing Seal Rings Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to accurately and efficiently measure the inner and outer diameters of bearing seal rings, a monocular measurement instrument was developed. The mathematical principles of camera calibration and distortion correction were studied. After the figures of rings were distortion corrected and preprocessed, we calculate the inner and outer diameters based on Otsu threshold segmentation and RANSAC algorithm. Operating the monocular measuring instrument to measure eight different types of sealing rings. According to the measurement results, it is found that the average time to measure the two diameters of a sealing ring is 0.79 seconds and the relative error of the measurement is 0.12%, which proves that the monocular measuring instrument can meet actual needs for sampling measurement of rings in the factory laboratory.

articleTitle: Research on Key Algorithms of Visual Simulation System for Surface Dust Concentration in Virtual Campus
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the visual simulation of surface dust concentration in virtual campus, the concentration data of each grid point should be obtained. Because the surface dust concentration data grid points are unknown, so through the discrete sample point grid points around the known surface dust concentration properties of the unknown point grid point value interpolation estimation. Therefore, it is very important to select an interpolation algorithm that can satisfy the requirement of the accuracy of the surface dust concentration and have high computational efficiency in the interpolation process of unknown points. According to the data characteristics of virtual campus surface dust concentration value, this paper proposes an inverse distance mixed interpolation algorithm for interpolation by combining the advantages of the inverse distance weighted interpolation method and the kriging interpolation algorithm, and compares the calculation results of inverse distance mixed interpolation with the traditional interpolation algorithm. The results show that inverse distance mixed interpolation algorithm not only has high accuracy, but also runs efficiently.

articleTitle: Research on balance problem of non-standard oil cylinder production line based on customer interaction
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The market for oil cylinders in China is extremely large around the world as the second largest consumer of hydraulic components. The complex environment conditions, load requirements customized specifications, order perturbation and other lean production requirements have brought big challenges to the line balance of hydraulic cylinder manufacturers. To solve this problem, this study analyses the state of art from the internal and external aspects. On this basis, the overall framework of production line balance optimization system based on customer interaction is proposed. Based on the enterprise database to evaluate the status of orders and production lines, the system is designed from two aspects of capacity shortage and capacity idle. Finally, to validate the overall framework, a case of specific practice in production scheduling for hydraulic cylinders in the production line is studied company.

articleTitle: Analysis of User-Oriented Network Operation and Maintenance Management
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the improvement of information and communication infrastructure construction, the competition in the telecommunications market from Blue Ocean to Red Sea is becoming increasingly fierce. In this new era, differentiated user experience has become the focus of competition among providers. The concept of user-oriented network operation and maintenance management is thus deeply rooted in people's hearts. In this paper, the development of network operation and maintenance management concept is first summarized. The main factors affecting user satisfaction are then analyzed. Furthermore, the process of providers from perceiving user service expectations to providing corresponding services is studied, and the gap of service quality in different stages of operation and maintenance management is discussed. In the end, methods are proposed to improve user satisfaction.

articleTitle: Analysis of the influence of land-sea impedance surface on antenna radiation performance
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The propagation properties of electromagnetic waves radiated by vertical electric dipole on different surfaces such as land or sea water are discussed. The problem is studied by the method of moments and the modified mirror image method, which can improve the calculation efficiency. The influence of impedance surface and other factors are analyzed. The simulation results show that the characteristic parameters of seawater media have some influence on the radiation performance of electromagnetic waves, and the effects of different factors on the radiation performance are proposed. It has certain significance to the design and engineering practice of VLF communication antenna.

articleTitle: An Overall Scheme Design of PCM / FM Telemetry Demodulation System Based on GPU
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The conventional PCM/FM system uses a dedicated FPGA-based processing platform, which has problems such as tightly coupled software and hardware, long development cycles, and difficult upgrades, making it difficult to adapt to the needs of the rapid development of telemetry tasks. The GPU-based general processing platform can better solve the difficulties encountered by the traditional PCM/FM system, so an overall scheme of the GPU-based PCM/FM telemetry system is designed. First, we analyze the working principle of PCM/FM demodulation; then, we explain the overall scheme from two aspects of system architecture design and workflow; finally, the key technologies necessary and the difficult problems for system realization are analyzed, which points out the direction for subsequent research.

articleTitle: Research on Clothing Image Classification Models Based on CNN and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Traditional clothing image classification method, which involves artificially extracting features of clothing images, are not effective owing to images having complex background and clothing distortion. With the purpose of improving the classification accuracy, eight models are designed based on convolutional neural network (CNN) and transfer learning. These CNN models are trained on the dataset named Street-FashionData having eight categories of clothing images, and their performances are evaluated and compared by conducting classification tests. The experimental results show that model ICM-C and model ECM-C have high classification accuracies of 97.2% and 97.8%, respectively. These two models have the same convolutional bases as pre-trained Inception-v3 and pre-trained EfficientNet-B0, respectively, moreover, their entire networks need to be trained. The experimental results have proved the efficiency of classification models described in this paper.

articleTitle: SGCMG Non-Singularity Trajectory Programming Algorithm based on Improved CVP Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As the preferred satellite maneuver actuator, single gimbal control moment gyroscope (SGCMG) has singular problems in the process of attitude maneuver. In this paper, a new algorithm for SGCMG singularity avoidance is designed based on the control variable parameterization (CVP) algorithm. Firstly, the sensitivity equation of the system is defined- and approximated by the piecewise constant. Then, the time unit to be refined is selected according to the sensitivity of the objective function to the control parameters, and the number of time nodes meeting the accuracy requirements is obtained. This method only needs simple velocity control for frame servo system. Finally, simulation results showed that, in the process of trajectory planning, a trajectory curve with stable attitude parameters and satellite angular velocity can be planned out by setting practical constraints in engineering, considering energy resources and target accuracy comprehensively, and there will be no singularity in SGCMG.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Performance of Quantum Cascade Laser Gas Detection Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The quantum cascade laser technology appearance brings a new method for industrial gas detection, but its performance needs further study and evaluation. Firstly, introduce the characteristics of quantum cascade laser gas detection technology, and design a performance evaluation test device with automatic gas concentration adjustment. Then, carry out a numerous experiment studies with different concentrations of CH4, C2H4 and SF6 as the detection objects. Finally, evaluate this detection technology systematically from the three aspects of detection repeatability, volume concentration error and response time, providing an important reference for its technology engineering application.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Based Proactive Monitor Channel Allocation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Reinforcement Learning algorithm has achieved lots of successful achievements in communication area and has been seen as a future technique for communication systems in 6G. We proposed a frequency allocation model to investigate the accuracy of this system based on reinforcement learning. We studied Deep Q Network and Dueling Deep Q Network to compare the efficiency of this two different algorithm. Applying Reinforcement Learning algorithm, we proposed A legitimate monitor to allocate serval channel and frequency to monitor several suspicious links to make sure the communication security in physical layer.

articleTitle: The Optimization of Privacy Data Management Model In Big Data Era
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The management of privacy data in big data era involves data collecting, data storage and data use. Current privacy data management studies focus on concrete techniques and seldom investigate various processes and subjects of privacy data management. In this paper, the basic structure and analytic models of privacy data management is analyzed based on the realization of big data analysis, and problems of imperfect management mechanism, increasing information disclosure risk and deficiencies of current models are analyzed. Based on the problems of privacy data management, the optimized schemes are proposed from perspectives of perfecing privacy data management mechanism, building secure data platform and optimizing data use structure.

articleTitle: Development of Positioning System Based on GIS Mechanical Resonance Source
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of power grids, GIS equipment has been widely used in power systems due to its good insulation performance and small footprint. However, the mechanical failure of GIS equipment affects the development of GIS equipment and the safe operation of the power grid. The mechanical failure of GIS equipment is often accompanied by the generation of noise, so it is very important to detect the noise of GIS equipment and locate the noise source. This paper introduces the methods and theories of GIS noise imaging, and builds a GIS resonance source positioning system based on LabVIEW software. The resonance source positioning system has the advantages of intelligence, convenient control, and real-time monitoring, which effectively guarantees the safe operation of the power grid.

articleTitle: Design of energy saving vehicle based on super capacitor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Research and design a super capacitor as the energy storage core, to achieve fast wireless charging, power management, self starting and path planning of energy-saving car model car. Through the design and optimization of capacitor, charging circuit and mechanical structure of energy-saving vehicle. Finally, an energy-saving vehicle with full load charging power of 30W, charging time of 8.2s and completion of 65m track distance has been made. The performance and indicators of the vehicle have been greatly improved. It can even be applied to the field of unmanned transportation, storage and handling, and household appliances. At present, new energy vehicles mainly use lithium battery pack as energy storage unit. The design ideas of energy-saving vehicles combined with the current exploration and research of new energy vehicles also have great significance.

articleTitle: Design of Wireless Temperature Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of production technology, temperature is particularly important in modern industrial control. Measuring temperature parameters and analyzing them can play a role in real-time monitoring of equipment operation status, production environment and other external environment, so as to ensure equipment safety and efficient production of the whole production line. As an indispensable element of automated production lines, sensor is developed while also facing challenges. For demand of industrial automation persecution, sensors continuously improve measurement capability. This paper presents an idea, that designing correction algorithm in software to improve the accuracy of the temperature sensor, which is reduce the updated hardware investment.

articleTitle: Low Resolution and Multi-pose Face Recognition based on Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The purpose of low resolution face recognition (LRFR) is to recognize faces from small or low-quality images with different poses, illumination and expressions. However, the recognition effect of LRFR is not ideal under uncontrolled conditions. In this paper, residual network of resnet18 is used to test the recognition rate of six groups of UMIST face datasets with the resolution from 112×92 to 3×3. The results of recognition rate under different resolution states are compared and analyzed, and the dynamic curve of recognition rate with the change of resolution is obtained. In order to solve the problem that the recognition performance declines sharply when the resolution is lower than the minimum resolution, The minimum resolution image is reconstructed by super-resolution, considering the influence of the small scale of UMIST face datasets on the recognition rate, the data enhancement is used for training. The experimental results show that the method can effectively improve the recognition rate of the test image.

articleTitle: An Acquisition and Calculation Platform for Predictive Maintenance in Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The fault diagnosis system for monitoring the traditional coal mine mechanical and electrical equipment are applied to collecting various types of data underground, and it transmitted the data up to the ground by ring network, processing data by Industrial Personal Computer (IPC) or cloud computing. There are some disadvantages in this traditional method: diagnostic or control delay, limited amount of raw data, higher cost, poor flexibility and so on. According to these problems, a platform based on STM32F4 with ARM Cortex-M4 core, integrated FPU floating-point arithmetic unit and DSP instruction set is designed to predicting maintenance, data acquisition and calculation. Meanwhile, the platform processes some sensor data acquisition units with an 8-channel parallel port 16bit A/D sampling module, which maximum sampling frequency is 200Ksps. The results indicated that the data collection platform can effectively acquire various types of monitoring data, and the peak-to-peak error of the collected vibration parameters is less than 4%. Moreover, the platform is not only competent for data frequency spectrum analysis, but also envelope spectrum analysis, the demand of edge computing, real-time analysis, as well as processes flexible layout.

articleTitle: A Probe into Channel Delay Measurement Program of GPS Monitoring Receiver Based on Online Delay Self-correcting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: One of the important factors affecting the monitoring receiver ranging accuracy of GPS monitoring receiver is the channel delay error, and the effect of the variation in especially high latitude environment temperature on channel delay must be taken into consideration. A statistical analysis is carried out on the data of receiver channel delay which varies with environment temperature by using the online delay self-correcting method in the Paper. From the results, it is clear that the receiver channel delay varies with temperature regularly, and the receiver's ranging accuracy can be effectively improved by modifying the channel delay of the receiver according to the environment temperature.

articleTitle: Fuzzy reliability analysis of subsea manifold structure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The subsea manifold is one of the key equipment of the subsea production system. The harsh working environment and tedious installation work challenge the safety of the subsea manifold. Once the subsea manifold structure fails, it will not only fail to protect the internal equipment, but also affect the subsea Christmas tree connected. Therefore, this paper carries out the reliability analysis of subsea manifold structure based on fuzzy fault tree model. First, the general configuration of the subsea manifold structure is analyzed, and the research object is determined; then, the fault tree is established according to the subsea manifold structure, and the reliability of the subsea manifold fault tree is obtained by combining the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method; finally, the importance analysis of the fault tree is carried out, and the results show that the failure of the lifting structure and protective structure of the subsea manifold has a high impact on the occurrence of the top event, which should be focus on.

articleTitle: Recognize the Silhouette Attributes of T-shirts based on Mask R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Clothing is currently one of the most commercially profitable industries in the world, and clothing fashion analysis mines business intelligence information on massive data for the fashion industry, which has received tremendous attentions. As the basic task of fashion analysis, clothing silhouette attribute recognition is of great significance, which determines the accuracy of subsequent analysis. However, the clothing engineering knowledge system is highly professional, and the silhouette attributes are different for different clothing types. What’s more, clothing distortion and occlusion often appear in the fashion images, which brings challenges to the recognition. In this paper, we summarize the key silhouette attributes of T-shirts, and recognize the attributes by instance segmentation based on Mask R-CNN. Through the experiments over the online clothing shopping dataset, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed solution.

articleTitle: A Visualization Method for Beam Position Arrangement of Phased Array Radar
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Wave position arrangement is an important content of search resource management for phased array radar. According to the characteristics of phased array radar and scanning beam broadening characteristics, beam position arrangement of phased array radar in sinusoidal space is carried out in this paper. MATLAB and STK are used to realize the 3D visualization of phased array radar search wave arrangement. This method can be used in the simulation of anti-missile early warning detection scene, and can display the interception effect of the search beam of phased array radar on the target in real time and obtain the simulation analysis data, which provides a high confidence and visual simulation scheme for the research of resource management of phased array radar.

articleTitle: Taxi scheduling based on data mining and sharing network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Considering the development of intelligent networked vehicle technology, in order to solve the problem of real-time scheduling under large-scale urban taxis, this paper considers the method of clustering first and dispatching later to construct a new taxi dispatch mode. Based on the GPS data of taxi in Chengdu, the model constructed in this paper is applied. The results show that the empty distance of the taxi is reduced by 11.4% after optimization. Then based on the comparative experiment, the results show that the optimization effect of the model is better with the expansion of the data scale; In the continuous real-time optimization experiment, the model optimization effect is relatively stable and has good applicability. The research results of this paper can solve the problem of real-time taxi dispatching under large-scale vehicles, and the operation efficiency is high, which can provide ideas and references for the dispatching management and operation of taxis in reality.

articleTitle: Characteristic Analysis and Application Study of Mach - Zehnder Cavity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the working principle of The Mach - Zehnder interferometer, the characteristics of The Mach - Zehnder cavity are analyzed, and the logic gate of the Mach - Zehnder cavity is designed by combining the Mach - Zehnder cavity with the photonic crystal waveguide. The photonic band gap of the logic gate in TE mode and TM mode is analyzed by using the plane wave expansion method, and the input electromagnetic wave wavelength λ = 1.332 um of the logic gate is calculated. Then the electromagnetic waves with different conditions are input into the logic gate and the results are analyzed by FDTD method. The results show that the logic gate can realize or, same or different or logic, and the output port has high transmittance, high extinction ratio and short response time when the phase difference of the input electromagnetic wave and the signal of the control end and the input end meet the specific requirements. In this study, the characteristics of Mach - Zehnder cavity and photonic crystal waveguide are studied, which has certain reference value and guiding role in the study and application of Mach - Zehnder cavity in photonic crystal.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Driver Recommendation Algorithm in Enterprise Transportation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Cargo transportation plays an important role in the manufacturing industry. It is a bridge between the producer and the customer, and the driver is an indispensable part of the goods transportation. Excellent drivers can deliver goods to customers quickly and safely, thus gaining a good reputation for the company and improving its efficiency. In actual production, companies often use manual allocation when arranging the distribution tasks of orders. There will be human subjective factors in it, resulting in unreasonable allocation results. For example, orders from high-quality customers may be allocated to poorer quality customers. The driver will lose customers and cause losses to the company. This paper proposes a driver recommendation algorithm based on machine learning, and proposes an implementation method. By collecting various data generated by the driver when delivering the order, the driver behavior characteristic model is constructed. When a new order is generated, the driver behavior model can be used to match the order with a suitable driver without manual intervention, which improves delivery efficiency and customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Design and Realization of Intelligent Device for Remote Mechanical Failure Detection and Early Warning
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This project takes STM32 as the core, and consists of cm-01b contact sensor module, LCD12864 display module, NB-IOT module and other devices. The mechanical vibration frequency is detected by periodic cycle detection method. During the measurement, the input signal will be sent to the MCU, and the processed result will be sent to LCD12864 to display the frequency value. When the frequency is abnormal and beyond the safe range, the alarm will be sent to the staff by SMS.

articleTitle: A routing strategy with adaptive weight between ‘hop’ and ‘bandwidth’
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: There are three types of traffic in the factory network: Time-Triggered (TT) traffic with strict time stability requirements, Audio-Video-Bridging (AVB) traffic with large bandwidth and bounded latency requirements, and Best-Effort (BE) traffic. Under the general trend of Information Technology (IT) and Operation Technology (OT) integration, these three types of traffic will run in our traditional IT network. For the integration of IT and OT, our lab has built a customized network architecture, which can provide customized services for the above three types of traffic. Faced with the routing requirements of these multiple types of traffic, a single routing strategy can hardly provide good service. This paper introduces the background of the network architecture built by our lab, and proposes a routing strategy based on adaptive weight evaluation of "hops through the switch on the path" and "link bandwidth" for traffic in the factory, which can meet the different needs of different traffic, so that each traffic can be matched to the optimal route.

articleTitle: Grey Forecasting Method of Equipment Spare Parts Demand Based on Swarm Intelligence Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the precision and efficiency of spare parts demand forecasting, a grey forecasting method of spare parts demand based on swarm intelligence optimization is proposed. On the basis of analyzing the deficiency of the traditional grey prediction method, the fractional grey prediction method is proposed to predict the requirement of spare parts of equipment, this paper presents a swarm intelligence optimization algorithm which combines particle swarm optimization (PSO) and gravity search. By comparison and analysis, this algorithm can quickly and efficiently realize the parameter optimization of fractional grey prediction model, the results show that the fractional grey forecasting model based on swarm intelligence optimization is superior to the traditional grey forecasting model in the precision of fractional grey forecasting.

articleTitle: The Control Integration and Trajectory Planning of Dual-driving Gantry Engraving and Milling Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The dual-driving gantry engraving and milling machine (DGEMM) is taken as the research object. Engraving and milling capabilities are combined on DGEMM with high speed, high precision and high efficiency processing performance. Using Park and Clark conversion methods to establish a mathematical model of the motor; Using Simulink software to perform system simulation, and combine the actual parameters of the motor to tune the three-loop PID parameters; Designing and developing DGEMM software with integrated control function and trajectory planning function through C# and TwinCAT software; Using Mastercam software to verify the accuracy of the servo system model and the functions of the software. The experimental results show the accuracy of the servo control model and the practicality of the software in terms of control functions and trajectory planning.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Monitoring System Based on Wireless Zigbee and QTouch Configuration Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the small-scale farms, poor intelligent breeding conditions, low yield, high risk and other adverse factors, the article proposes an intelligent aquaculture environment monitoring system based on sensor technology, Zigbee wireless transmission technology and QTouch configuration technology. The system is designed from hardware selection and design, human-computer interface configuration, communication programming and experiment debugging, etc. Completed the design of the zigbee lower computer data monitoring system, the QTouch human-computer interaction interface design, and carried out the system test. The experimental results show that the control scheme can solve the intelligent problem of small-scale farms, with low cost and high efficiency, and has the advantages of friendly man-machine interface, stable operation and accurate data acquisition, which has good application value in the process control industry.

articleTitle: Structure adjustment of early warning information system based on timeliness
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aimed at the high requirement of timeliness in the process of information assurance, this paper describes the average time delay of information transmission in the system, and designs a timeliness index that can quantitatively describe the ability of early warning information assurance. In response to the problem that system capability cannot meet operational requirements due to enemy attacks, this paper analyzes the structure of the early warning information system, Early warning information complex network model is established, based on the timeliness index, a genetic algorithm based on simulated annealing with special chromosome coding is proposed.the algorithm is used to adjust the network model structure, the ability of early warning information assurance has been improved. Finally, the simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Synchronous Control Strategy for Dual-drive Feed Mechanism Considering the Change of Workbench’s Gravity Center
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The double-drive feed system with high rigidity and fast response is widely used in high-precision NC machine tools and cartesian coordinate robots. However, the center of gravity of the workbench changes constantly in the process of movement. Therefore, this paper takes the independently-developed double-drive two-dimensional feeding test platform as the research object, analyzes the influence of the change of center of gravity on the double drive feed synchronization performance, takes into account the influence of the transmission chain stiffness of the feed system, and establishes the synchronization error mathematical model of the double-drive feed system. The synchronization performance of the system when different dual-drive synchronization control strategies were applied was analyzed by Simulink. Through experiments, the synchronization error of the dual-drive workbench at different positions and the error based on control strategy of fuzzy PID are obtained, which are compared with the simulation results to verify the accuracy of the simulation model and greatly improve the synchronization error.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation on Calculation for Unloaded Quality Factor of Single-Port Resonant Cavity
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The unloaded quality factor is used to describe the performance for frequency selection of microwave resonant cavity, and the precise measurement of it is the basis of resonator design. The current traditional measurement method usually has limitations on single-port microwave resonators. In this paper, the traditional method was improved. According to the derived group delay formula, the relationship between the coupling coefficient and the standing wave ratio was judged. The obtained coupling coefficient determined the calculation formula of the unloaded quality factor, thereby obtaining a series of unloaded quality corresponding to different bandwidths. The data within the credible interval were processed to obtain a stable unloaded quality factor with small errors. We applied the improved method to measure and calculate the simulation and experimental results of single-port resonator cavity, which confirms the accuracy and reliability of this method.

articleTitle: Bionic Morphology of Dental Articulator for Teaching Based on Topological Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to better meet the needs of stomatology teaching demonstration, the paper conducts a research on the modified bionic design of the traditional dental articulator. Topology is introduced into the morphological bionic design for quantitative analysis. Starting from shape, the common point of topology and bionic design, to analyze the topological structure of "human craniofacial bone" based on the existing structure of dental articulator. This paper simply divides the complex topological relationships into five topological relationships (separation, adjacency, intersection, containment, and equality) based on the 9IM model, and set topological weight for these five representative topological relationships. Topological weight can be used to quantify the relationship between spatial entities and extract important features. The stability of topological properties in morphological cognition and extraction is used to better rationally restrict the bionic design process, finally establish a preliminary bionic morphological model.

articleTitle: Application of BDS in Deformation Monitoring for Gas Insulated Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to obtain the complete and timely device status information of gas-insulated switchgear for traditional methods in deformation monitoring, leading to unable to accurately control the device, which will influence the substation's safe operation for sure, the paper proposed to use BDS independently developed by China to realize the intelligent detection of the gas-insulated switchgear, and designed a BDS deformation monitoring system for the gas-insulated switchgear of the EHV substation. The experimental result showed that the proposed system could efficiently monitor and pre-warn the deformation of the device.

Author Keywords: deformation system of BeiDou navigation satellite system

articleTitle: Research on a Typical Electro-hydraulic Servo System Simulation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A typical electro-hydraulic servo system equipped with valve-controlled symmetrical cylinder has been simulated by Matlab simHydraulics diagram, deduced the system mathematical model According to the simulation result, and compared this model with the principle model, to verify its correctness. Put out a new method of simulation in which the Matlab simHydraulics integrate with the Matlab simulink, it can improve the efficiency and the veracity in electro-hydraulic servo system design.

articleTitle: Convex Optimization Control Strategy of Urban Rail Train on Board Composite Energy System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a convex optimization energy control strategy is proposed to solve the problems of poor power matching and low energy utilization rate of urban rail train composite energy storage system. Through the establishment of active composite storage system, the convex optimization of the system model is carried out. Taking the battery SOC and cost as the objective function, the optimization analysis is carried out, and the simulation is carried out with MATLAB. The simulation results show that: the method obtains the global optimal energy consumption cost, makes the SOC of battery reach the optimal, improves the system energy utilization rate by 9.6%, reduces the energy consumption of the system, and improves the vehicle economy and stability.

articleTitle: Collision-free Trajectory Planning for Cable-driven Robot in Dynamic Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a collision-free trajectory planning algorithm for cable-driven robots (CDPRs) in dynamic environment. As the basis, the wrench feasible workspaces (WFW) of CDPRs are obtained. The tradition artificial potential field (APF) method can quickly plan a trajectory. However, APF is not time-efficient with dynamic obstacles. In order to solve this problem, a new scope of APF based on kinematic model is used to generate a trajectory in dynamic environment. Then, Bezier curve is employed to optimize the initial trajectory making motors run smoothly. To validate the proposed improved APF method, kinematic simulations are carried out. The results demonstrate the trajectory generated by improved APF can avoid obstacles in different motion states smoothly.

articleTitle: Sensor Fault Diagnosis Method based on One Dimensional Local Ternary Pattern
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of sensor fault diagnosis, a fault diagnosis method based on one dimensional local ternary patterns and extreme learning machine is proposed. This method applies local ternary pattern used in the field of image recognition to the processing of one dimensional signals. Firstly, the sensor signal is subjected to six sliding maximum filters to obtain signals of different scales.And then one dimensional local ternary pattern is used to process the original signal and signals of different scales to obtain the feature vector. Finally, dimension-reduced feature vector processed by principal component analysis is classified by extreme learning machine to identify different types of sensor faults. Four kinds of sensor fault data is generated using simulation fault data model, and comparative experiments verify the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Governance Structure Association Model Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is a multi-dimensional scientific and technological system. The current artificial intelligence governance structure research shows a fragmented image and lacks integrity. And it is not conducive to the healthy development of artificial intelligence. In view of this, we will analyze the artificial intelligence governance structure and its association from a holistic perspective. In addition, the structure association model of artificial intelligence governance is set up as well as the features of this model are investigated. Based on the governance structure association features, the governance structure association function is built in the light of BP neural network. And it is used to describe the governance structure association level amid substructures in artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: Electric vehicle charging equipment component abnormal prediction technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Traditional methods to determine whether the work of electric vehicle charging equipment is abnormal is limited to in-lab confirmation and on-site the abnormal over- limit attribute of single threshold, which have such problems as long time, low quality, easy development of defects, and easy to make mistakes. Breakthrough the limitation of laboratory and field conditions, in this paper, an effective abnormal prediction method for electric vehicle charging equipment is established by comparing various machine learning technologies and combining with the working mechanism of EV charging equipment components based on multi-scale massive data accumulated in time and space during the operation of EV charging equipment. The results show that the XGboost algorithm has a high accuracy in the abnormal prediction of EV charging equipment components and their characteristics, and the accuracy of anomaly prediction reaches 90.34%, which has an absolute advantage.

articleTitle: Satellite Attitude Tracking Decision Method based on Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient for Moving Target Observation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Space-based observation for moving targets has the advantages of global area, which can effectively compensate for the ground-based and air-based observation methods limited by land and airspace. However, the unknown and variability of target motion makes it difficult for satellites to make decisions and adjust their attitude in real-time to track the target. Aiming at this problem, an attitude tracking decision method based on deep deterministic policy gradient is proposed in this paper. Considering the control torque saturation and space pointing constraint, a satellite attitude tracking decision model is established and the optimization objective is designed. Then, the deep deterministic policy gradient method is used to solve this optimization problem, and the action value network and policy network is trained by transfer learning to accelerate the training process of whole model. Finally, simulation results show that the proposed method is capable of tracking the moving target autonomously and effectively.

articleTitle: A Novel Robotic Welding Method for Multilayer and Multi-pass Welding Process based on Vision Sensor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The existing multi-layer and multi-pass welding process normally adopts teaching-playback method in low-level automation. Also, it is difficult for this method to adapt to the diversity of workpiece by reason of its poor flexibility and universality. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a new robot system for multi-layer and multi-pass welding process based on vision sensor. Firstly, the mathematical model for the welding robot system is established to describe the spatial relationship between the coordinate systems of the tip of the robot, vison sensor and the tip of the welding torch. Then, the groove profile is reconstructed by the detected data of the vision sensor using the proposed data processing method. Based on the spatial model for the welding robot system and the groove profile obtained by the vision sensor, the mathematical model for the welding trajectory is established to realize the multi-layer and multi-pass welding process. Finally, the welding trajectory is verified in simulation and experiment, and the results demonstrate that the welding robot system proposed in this paper has a certain degree of reliability and feasibility.

articleTitle: A Traceable Anonymous Authentication Method For Mimic Defense
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Mimic-Defense enables active defense of systems by building DHR (dynamic heterogeneous redundancy) structure. The existing authentication between modules in DHR is based on specific identity information and lacks the protection of the identity information of the heterogeneous executor. In this paper, we integrated the direct anonymous authentication protocol DAA with Mimic-Defense, and proposed the traceable anonymous authentication method Track-DAA for Mimic-Defense, which combines the dispatcher and arbitrator in Mimic-Defense with Issuer and Verifier in the DAA protocol respectively. We added the new Track process which enables Issuer to trace the identity information of a specific platform. The safety of Track-DAA is verified, and its operational efficiency is analyzed. The results show that Track-DAA is an efficient traceable anonymous authentication for Mimic-Defense.

articleTitle: The model of balancing and scheduling for mix-model assembly line based on bi-level programming
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the model of balancing and scheduling for mix-model assembly line is proposed based on bi-level programming. The Upper level is aimed at the problem of automobile assembly line balance, and the lower level is dealing with assembly line sequencing. Then, starting from the idea of converting the bi-level optimization problems into a single-level optimization problem, the DOMINO framework with a grey-box optimization solver are integrated to address this problem. Finally, one numerical experiment is given, and the optimal solution of the problem is obtained.

articleTitle: The Grey Predictions of Maintenance Support Costs of Missile Weapon System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The predictions of maintenance support costs are an important part of Life Cycle Cost (LCC) management of missile weapon system. In view of poor information and lacking of samples of weapon system’s maintenance costs data, Grey theory is applied to predict the maintenance costs of weapon system. A certain type of missile is taken as an example. And an interval prediction of Grey forecasting model obtains for its maintenance cost. After examining, the method is practical and effective, which provides a theoretical basis to control and save the cost of missile weapon system.

articleTitle: Research on obstacle Recognition of unmanned Intelligent Vehicle based on image segmentation principle
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper studies the image recognition and location of stone obstacles faced by driverless intelligent vehicles. After edge enhancement by morphological method, the accuracy of gradient image is improved, and on this basis, a method of rock image segmentation based on the principle of minimum error segmentation is proposed.After image segmentation, morphological method is used for data denoising, which increases the accuracy and reliability of image positioning and recognition, and improves the chariot's ability to find obstacles and strain.

articleTitle: Study on Accident Prevention of Tailings Storage Facilities Based on Complex Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to prevent accidents of tailings storage facilities (TSFs) more efficiently, it is necessary to find out the key hazards in the risk evolution network and take key measures. In this paper, taking tailings dam break accident as an example, the risk evolution complex network is established, and the network centrality analysis and network interference are implemented. The study results show that the key hazards in the risk evolution process of TSFs are some nodes with high betweenness centrality. In addition, based on laws, standards and norms, the accident prevention system of TSF are established. The system consists of four modules: risk perception, complex network construction, scene network division, and analysis of preventive measures. Through the system, the risk evolution network of TSFs can be divided into several accident scenes for analysis. On the basis of analyzing the key hazard, the corresponding key preventive measures are found out. This paper provides an effective method to control the key hazards of TSFs accidents, which improves the safety management efficiency of TSFs.

articleTitle: An Efficiency Partially Compatible Test Decompression Technology Oriented RL-HC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For most intellectual property core in System-on-a-chip, larger test set is required to achieve higher fault coverage, which leads to excessive test data volume and high-test power consumption during VLSI testing. Hence, partially compatible test decompression technology oriented RL-HC is proposed to effectively alleviate this thorny problem. The unspecified bit in test data is filled according to the evaluation of Weighted Transition Metric, and then the filled test data are divided into blocks by the smallest entropy value. The determined test vectors are encoded using Run length-based Huffman Code scheme, the more frequent the blocks, the shorter the codewords, which aims at reducing the storage resource occupied by test data in system-on-a-chip. Furthermore, a partially compatible XOR decompression circuit structure is designed to avoid the compatible test vectors repeatedly loaded into scan chain, which leads to less test power consumption during scan testing. Numerous experiments are performed on the representative Benchmark circuits to verify the proposed RL-HC based test decompression scheme well, it outperforms the previous code-based scheme in the overall performance including high test compression ratio, test power consumption reduction.

articleTitle: Dynamic model of crowd flow in multi-angle cross passages based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As one of the indispensable function layout of pedestrian flow in the crowd gathering public places, cross passages are the common network nodes of crowd kinematics merging and psychology panic propagation. To build the dynamic model of a crowd flow in multi-angle cross, the current micro and macro crowd models are analyzed respectively. The fundamental principles of machine vision are introduced to count pedestrians in a crowd, with a higher precision than the random initialization in conventional numerical crowd models. The typical and often-used crowd merging layouts in multi-angles cross passages are proposed. To increase the adaptability of conventional macro-crowd model, a physical impact matrix is proposed to describe the complex crow merging mechanism in the multi-angle pedestrian passages. Thereby, a novel approach to build the dynamic model of crowd flow in multi-angle cross passages based on machine vision is proposed, which can satisfy the conservation laws of mass, momentum and energy of in crowd merging areas.

articleTitle: Whirling Vibration Modeling for Propulsion Shafting
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As the transmission device of the ship, the vibration of the propulsion shafting has a very important influence on the overall working performance of the ship. Based on the transfer matrix method, the lumped parameters-distributed parameter hybrid model of propulsion shafting's whirling vibration is established in this paper. The simulation result shows that the model can reflect the system dynamics well. On the basis of the whirling vibration model, the influence of the rear stern bearing's supporting position and the propeller's entrained water effect are analyzed. Moreover, the natural frequency of the propulsion shafting increases with the increase of the rear stern bearing's equivalent stiffness. The propulsion shafting's variation law of the natural frequency with the above characteristics is revealed.

articleTitle: A Hybird Learning-based Framework for Estimating Teaching Ability of Ideological and Political Courses in Modern Chinese University
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybrid learning-based two-stage framework consisting of an RNNs-based architecture for subjective textual sentiment analysis and a deep decision forest for teaching ability estimation. According to the annotated self-collected dataset and SnowNLP corpus, the connectivity of the subjective items’ answers is enhanced to be fed into fixed-sized RNNs with LSTM units for distribution of soft labels. The outputted labels are merged with the objective items’ answers to form the learnable vectors for the deep global decision forest framework. We use the top-5 features' variance to weigh the random forests in each level of the cascade forest structure for a fitness voting result. On the self-collected dataset, the F1 score of 0.974 and the CPM score of 0.925 have reached, which are prior to those of the compared methods.

articleTitle: Robot Position Control Based on Uncalibrated Visual Servo
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Mobile robot visual servo is based on visual feedback information to directly control the movement of the mobile robot. This paper designs an uncalibrated visual servo control method for mobile robots based on feature point recognition to achieve high-precision position control of mobile robots. The overall scheme of the system is determined firstly, and a robust feature point pattern and recognition algorithm is proposed. Aiming at the visual servo input requirements, the feature points of the mobile robot composed of positioning points and coding points are designed. The uncalibrated visual servo algorithm is studied to realize the stabilization and trajectory tracking control of the mobile robot, and the control accuracy is verified through experiments.

articleTitle: Adversarial Attack Algorithm based on Saliency Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the development process of today's artificial intelligence system, many text, voice and image recognition systems have been born. In the process of development and application, it has been found that the artificial intelligence system will suffer from classification errors and other problems after adding a small disturbance to the recognized objects. We call such objects with small perturbations adversarial examples, and the process of generating adversarial examples is called adversarial attacks. At present, there are FGSM, I-FGSM and MI-FGSM adversarial attacks algorithms for image. These algorithms are able to carry out global disturbance on image examples. Although they have good adversarial attack effect, in real life, the adversarial examples is often used to cause the failure of artificial intelligence system with smaller local disturbance. Therefore, we hope to study the influence of small-scale disturbance on artificial intelligence system. In this paper, an adversarial algorithm based on saliency detection, LC-MIFGSM, is proposed to maintain the adversarial attack effect and at the same time compress the adversarial attack range, improve the attack concealment, and make the generation of adversarial attack examples more oriented to real scenes.

articleTitle: Thermal Stress Analysis of DC Dry Type Wall Bushing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As the connection equipment between the valve hall of the converter station and the external transmission network, the DC dry type wall bushing has a big difference in ambient temperature on both sides of the wall, and the distribution of internal heat and thermal stress is complex. This paper adopts three-dimensional temperature-fluid-stress coupling calculation method. The geometric model was built according to the actual size of ±110kV DC dry type wall bushing. The temperature field and thermal stress distribution of the DC dry bushing under the environment temperature difference are calculated by simulating the fastening constraint condition of the bushing with full consideration of bushing loss and heat dissipation mode, and the validity and accuracy of the calculation results are analyzed. The research results in this paper can provide a theoretical basis for the design and optimization of the structure of the DC dry type wall bushing.

articleTitle: Design of automatic fluorescence in situ hybridization system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) is a combination of non radioactive molecular biology and cytogenetics. It has many advantages, such as safe use, short experimental cycle, high accuracy and convenient observation. It is widely used in the diagnosis of prenatal, tumor and blood diseases. The process of this technology is complex and tedious, the reagent consumables required are extremely expensive, the professional quality of operators is extremely dependent, and the cost of technical training is high, which greatly reduces the effectiveness of the technology and greatly limits the use and promotion of the technology. In view of the development status of fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) and its automation, a fully automatic fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) system with high automation, low reagent consumption and high processing efficiency was researched and developed in this paper. In this paper, based on the microfluidic chip technology and medical molecular diagnosis technology with less reagent consumption, fast detection speed, simple operation, multi-functional integration and small reaction volume, the full-automatic liquid-based cell fluorescence in situ hybridization system was studied, which integrated the separation, purification, fixation and hybridization of liquid-based cells It can not only reduce the volume of equipment, but also ensure the sample processing capacity. The processing efficiency is significantly improved. At the same time, the cost and complexity can be greatly reduced, and the amount of reagent that can be controlled is more accurate.

articleTitle: Analysis the Influence of Environmental Noise to Compressed Sensing Signal Reconstruction in Unmanned Offshore Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The data storage space and storage capacity of unmanned offshore platform are limited. Compressed Sensing (CS) technology can fundamentally solve this problem. However another important factor of unmanned platforms is the requirement for low emission power. From the effects of marine environment noise on the compressed sensing signal reconstruction, this thesis calculates the Signal to Noise Ratio (SNR)under different reconstruction error and different modulation method. It is concluded that, if the reconstruction error is not higher than ,the SNR is not less than 2dB when 8FSK modulation mode is used. This conclusion provides a basis for determining the transmission power of the signal source in practice.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Isolated Half-Bridge Constant Current/Constant Current Converter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Constant current power supply system is often used for power supply of underwater information network because of its better ability to resist short-circuit faults and simple conversion circuit. In the constant current power supply system, the current main technical problems mainly focus on its electric energy conversion technology. This paper designs an isolated half-bridge constant current/constant current (CC/CC) converter, analyzes it through the state-space averaging method, and simulates it with pspice simulation software. The result shows that the circuit is feasible. On this basis, the advantages and disadvantages of an isolated push-pull CC/CC converter are compared.

articleTitle: Parameter Test and System Calibration Compensation Method for Interferometric Fiber Optic Gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Reasonable and effective testing methods of FOG parameters and modeling and compensation methods of FOG system errors are effective means to improve the output accuracy of FOG. In order to test the parameters of fiber optic gyroscope more accurately and make an scientific evaluation, based on the national metrology technical specification GJB2426-2014 (test method of fiber optic gyroscope), this paper conducts all-weather and multi-time parameter test of fiber optic gyroscope. In this paper, an all-weather, multi-period test data average processing method is used to process the test results. In addition, in order to reduce the influence of FOG error on FOG output signal, this paper analyzes, models and compensates FOG system error by establishing system error model and calibration experiment. The experimental results show that the model established in this paper can be used to compensate the system error by combining the national metrology technical specification test method with the all-weather, multi-period test data average processing method, which can effectively test the parameters of FOG and maximize compensation of system error.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Control System for Rubber Strip Automatic Tightening Device
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In modern office space, screen board is an important component of screen desk. At present, the rubber strips on the side of the screen are tightened manually. In this paper, an improved control system is proposed based on an rubber strip automatic tightening device for rubber strips on the side of office screen. The control system mainly controls the working process of rubber strip releasing, feeding, and pressing into the office screen board. In this paper, the system structure design, simulation experiment, experimental prototype construction, and rubber strip tightening experiments are carried out to verify the rationality of the design and implementation of control system for rubber strip automatic tightening device.

articleTitle: A Formation Control Strategy of Quadrotor UAV Study Based on MIQP Cluster Track Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, obstacle avoidance and obstacle avoidance trajectories of four UAVs are calculated based on the four-rotor UAV cluster planning theory based on MIQP (mixed integral quadratic planning).Articles from QP (quadratic programming), MIQP theory is introduced to obtain, in turn, this paper introduces the single frame four rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) tracks, single frame four rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) obstacle avoidance, double unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) obstacle avoidance path, the obstacle avoidance path between pairs of unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) machine, as well as multiple unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) between machine and calculation theory of obstacle avoidance algorithm verification, verify the algorithm validity in four rotor unmanned aerial vehicle (uav) trajectory planning problems. Based on the default physical parameters of common quadrotor assembly configuration in PIXHAWK flight control system, this paper ensures the effectiveness of cluster trajectory and lays a foundation for the next real flight and larger cluster control..

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of three-dimensional guidance law based on Variable Structure Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Inspired by the parallel approach method, as long as the angle of sight between the interceptor and the target is kept constant, the interceptor can hit the target accurately. In this paper, through the relative motion equation of interceptor and target in three-dimensional space, the state equation of line of sight angle change between interceptor and target is derived, and the controller is designed with variable structure control method to keep the line of sight angle constant, so as to achieve the purpose of interceptor hitting the target accurately. Theoretical derivation and simulation show that the designed controller can ensure that the azimuth angle of line of sight and the elevation angle of line of sight between the interceptor and the target remain constant, the interceptor hits the target accurately, and has strong robustness to the measurement error of target parameters.
