articleTitle: Suppression of Three-phase Unbalanced Current of Power System Based on DSSC
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of modern power grid, the imbalance of three-phase power system is increasingly prominent, which seriously affects the reliability and stability of power system operation.To this end, this paper proposes a method to effectively compensate the three-phase imbalance of the system by using a Distributed Static Series Compensator (DSSC). Firstly, this paper analyzes the working principle of DSSC and obtains its power flow control characteristics and impedance characteristics. Secondly, the DSSC mathematical model is derived.In addition, in order to improve the control accuracy and robustness, a three-loop control strategy of DSSC with dual voltage outer loop and current inner loop is proposed.Finally, build a typical power system with DSSC devices based on PSCAD/EMTDC software, and carry out simulation tests.The simulation results show that DSSC can effectively compensate the three-phase imbalance of the power grid, and on this basis, it can also regulate the power flow of the line.

articleTitle: Track Estimation Method based on State Matrix Weighted Fusion Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the characteristics of target motion and composite guidance, this paper designs the global state feedback model and proposes a track estimation method of the moving targets on the sea by introducing the state matrix weighted fusion method. The method can obtains the optimal weight of the state fusion, and overcomes the problem of the large amount calculation caused by the high dimensional matrix of the centralized measurements filtering. Simulation results of active and passive radar composite guidance show that this method can effectively obtain the high precision estimation of track without increasing the dimension of the observation matrix.

articleTitle: Design of intelligent feeding car for cow feeding automation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of complex operation and low degree of automation existing in the feeding of dairy cows, an automatic intelligent feeding car was developed, which can automatically realize weighing and batching, crushing and mixing. Feeding at fixed points and returning by tracking. The design is based on STM32F103RBT6 micro-controller as the core, with electromagnetic tracking module, weighing module, dual drive DC motor module and other modules. The least square method is used to fit the accuracy of the pressure sensor through experiments, and the accuracy of the feeding rate in the electromagnetic tracking process is optimized by calibrate the pressure sensor, returning to the parameters to adjust the speed before feeding. After calibration and debugging, the intelligent feeding car runs stably according to the given parameters, and the feeding amount is more accurate. Ultimately, the feed quantity is more accurate, the labor cost is effectively reduced, the feeding efficiency is improved in this design, and a new idea is provided for feeding automation.

articleTitle: Development of a novel digital integration system for magnetic measurement on HL-2M tokamak
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A novel digital integration system is introduced. This system not only realizes high-precision data acquisition and digital integration, but also completes the high-speed transmission of integration results and real-time data sharing among multiple plasma diagnosis modules. Utilizing analog processing circuits and four high-performance octal-channel analog-to-digital converters, the detected signals can be sampled with 100 kHz and 24-bit accuracy, while a correction algorithm is applied to minimize the integration drift. With the parallel pipeline processing of the field-programmable gate array (FPGA), 32 channel real-time digital integration is achieved. Additionally, the applications of PCI express (PCIe) platform and Direct Memory Access (DMA) technology provide great convenience for high-speed transmission of integration results. Futhermore, a reflective memory (RFM) network is used to realize real-time data sharing among multiple plasma diagnostic modules. The system has been tested in plasma discharge experiments on HL-2A tokamak, and the experimental results have confirmed that the digital integration system is able to meet the requirement of magnetic measurement on the HL-2M tokamak device.

articleTitle: Research on Robot Object Localization and Grabbing Based on Concontour Matching
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In fact, the robot can replace the human to complete a lot of important work, so it has a very important application value. This is significant to study the robot's visual grasp of the target In order to enhance the flexibility of the robot. Base on the related technology of the combination of machine vision and robot, this paper describes the device structure and working principle of the robot in detail, and establishes the computer vision system of target model positioning under the gradient contour. By constructing the spatial position relationship between the robot, the conveyor belt and the industrial camera, the robot is controlled to grasp accurately. Experiments show that the system can identify and locate the workpiece well, and send the position information of the workpiece to the robot through the upper computer, and control the robot to grasp. articleTitle: IPv6 Address Assignment and Management Mechanism for Heterogeneous Industrial Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The new manufacturing production model puts forward the demand for the integration of industrial IT networks and OT networks. The proposal of TSN and DetNet standards makes it possible to converge IT and OT. In the future, TSN and DetNet will combine to become a new industrial network paradigm, making industrial heterogeneous networks a converged and interconnected IP-supporting network. Therefore, it is necessary to perform unified addressing on industrial heterogeneous networks to support indiscriminate addressing and communication between devices. Since DHCP is not suitable for industrial network scenarios, this paper proposes an IPv6 address assignment and management mechanism, which assigns specific IPv6 addresses to industrial network devices based on their characteristic information, and uses the NETCONF protocol to uniformly manage the configuration information during the address assignment process. The mechanism proposed in this paper assigns IPv6 addresses for industrial IP networks and non-IP networks uniformly, achieving IPv6-based undifferentiated addressing and laying a foundation for the seamless integration and fusion of industrial networks and the Internet.

articleTitle: A Learning-based Real Comment Classifier for Multimedia Teaching Quality Evaluation Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we proposes a learning-based real comment capturer for multimedia teaching quality evaluation systems. The main idea is fusing the multi-stream features to feed a DFs (Deep Forests)-based classifier. We consider three context information, including the semantic, grammar and structural context. They are organized as the unit feature, intra-structural feature and inter-structural feature from bottom to top. Then, these features are socketed into a fixed-sized zero vector to re-represent the input sentences with the trees of word vectors. We employ static analysis, TreeGAN to assign and generate the numeric labels for the relations among the sub-sentences and sentences, which are combined with the semantic context to decide by two groups of RFs and complete RFs. After an AVG-MAX operation, we classify the input comments into the positive/negative classes. Due to the higher-level representation, the scribbled comments with antiphrasis can be captured accurately. Experiments report a couple of better scores for positive/negative instances.

articleTitle: Solar Direct-drive Integrated Anode Power Supply Conversion Circuit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The anode power supply is the main power module of the Hall thruster, and as its power continues to increase, the use of direct PV drive can achieve decoupling of the anode power supply from the platform bus, so the integrated design of "S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>MPR+DC/DC" is used. The solar array as input and ionized gas as load, both with certain instability, can lead to more complex working conditions of the integrated anode power supply, thus putting special requirements on the adaptability of the integrated anode power supply. In this paper, the circuit structure and operating mode of Hall thruster integrated anode power supply are analyzed, and the main power circuit and integrated control strategy are designed. Based on the theoretical analysis, the circuit is simulated with MATLAB software, and the simulation results verify the correctness of the theory and design.

articleTitle: Investigation of Frequency Response in a Low Inertia Power System and its Improvement
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, renewable energy sources like wind and photovoltaic (PV) are rapidly installed in South Australia. Amongst different states of Australia, it has the highest level of combined wind and solar photovoltaic (PV) generation. A survey of literature reveals that wind turbines and rooftop solar PV are unlike synchronous machines, which can deliver inertia and governor response to control frequency variation after a disturbance. Therefore, the growth of renewable energy generation combined with the withdrawal of traditional synchronous machines may cause new frequency challenges in a low inertia power system. This paper presents the findings of frequency response in a low inertia power system and a possible solution is also provided to improve frequency performance, which is utilizing HVDC support. A comparative study is performed to investigate the frequency response of simplified 14-Generator South-East Australian equivalent network by using PSS/E.

articleTitle: Neural network predictive control of thermal environment at the end of air conditioning system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, BP neural network is used to design a thermal environment predictive control scheme. Using BP neural network as controller, Regarding comfort and energy saving optimization as optimal object of the neural network. nonlinear system predictive control scheme is achieved by means of solving the optimal control sequence, and combined with the rolling optimization and feedback correction, The network can carry on the calibration error of the past time and forecast error of the future time, fully adapting to the model precision loss and interference factors, which make the control scheme has high stability and robustness. Meanwhile, The simulation experiment based on TensorFlow platform is designed. The experimental results show that the predictive control algorithm designed in this paper not only meets the dual requirements of energy saving and comfort, but also can effectively suppress interference. it has the significant advantages of short response time, small overshoot and no oscillation.

articleTitle: Spectral Lick Line Indices Based on Regression Analysis Using AstroStat for Effective Temperature of A-type Stars
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The exploration of methods extracted stellar parameter information from low-resolution stellar spectra which can analysis decisive role in the study of the formation and evolution of the Milky Way. In particular, the spectral line index method is an effective method for extracting features from astronomical spectra. Instead of typical linear regression, we use multiple linear regression (implemented in AstroStat) to analyze the relationships between Lick line indices, which represent relatively wide spectral features for most the prominent absorption line and Teff. The proposed scheme consists of the following procedures. The statistical analysis of the LAMOST line index data is presented by means of the visualization tools of AstroStat. In this paper, the Teff of A-type stars ranges from 7000K to 8500K, and the signal-to-noise ratio is cut to greater than 50.

articleTitle: Research on MPPT Algorithm Based on Variable Step Size Conductance Increment + PI Method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the economic and social development of many countries in the world, more and more countries pay attention to the green and sustainable use of energy. Because of its unique advantages, solar energy has been widely favored by many countries in the world. However, the input parameters of photovoltaic (PV) cells change with the environmental factors, in order to make PV cells always output maximum power, it is necessary to carry out effective Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) control strategy. In order to solve the problem that the single algorithm cannot be both rapid and stable, the conductance increment method is improved in this paper, and the combination algorithm of variable step conductance increment + PI controller is adopted. In the grid-connected system, verify the tracking characteristic of the output power of the high-power PV array by the variable-step conductance increment + PI algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed control method can not only track the change of external environment fast, but also has better response speed and control precision, at the same time also can effectively restrain power oscillation phenomenon near the maximum power output point.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Docker-based Image Repository Management System of Dispatching and Control Cloud
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of dispatching and control cloud platform, the existing virtual resource management mechanism has been unable to meet the requirements of rapid construction, agile delivery and convenient management of applications. The emergence of Docker technology provides a good solution. Combined with the Docker technology and the requirements of image repository management. In this paper, we introduce an Image Repository Management System of dispatching and control cloud based on Docker technology, introduces the overall architecture of the platform, Including secure application image hosting capabilities, image distribution scheme, stable image building services and convenient image authorization functions to facilitate users to manage the entire life cycle of images.

articleTitle: Multiple Wind Speed Forecast Using Simple Recurrent Unit
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the traditional wind speed forecast of a general wind farm, this farm is often regarded as a whole for point forecasting, and only a single wind speed forecast result is given in a large spatial scale. However, wind turbines are distributed in diverse locations in the wind farm, and wind speeds are often different. Therefore, this paper comes up with a model to forecast the wind speeds of multiple wind turbines by learning the potential relationship between wind speed time series and wind direction time series. First, wind direction feature is preprocessed by trigonometric function. Subsequently Simple Recurrent Unit (SRU) is designed to learn the temporal correlation information. Wind speed and trigonometric wind direction form a three-dimensional feature matrix. Compared with other Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), SRU can greatly reduce the computational cost. Therefore, SRU is used to extract the dynamic information of characteristic data of multiple wind turbines in a wind farm over time. The simulation results with the real data prove that compared with the existing forecast methods using temporal correlation feature, the method not only significantly reduces the computational cost, but also improves the accuracy of forecast.

articleTitle: Research on business continuity rating model in cloud environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a data center business continuity risk grading model in a cloud environment, which determines the disaster recovery capability level of the target business system based on system attribute information, comprehensive basic level, system life cycle and return on investment, and determines the target business based on the disaster recovery capability level The business continuity protection mode of the system is to protect the target business system continuously according to the business continuity protection mode.

articleTitle: Star Chart Recognition Algorithm Based on Singular Value Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The problem of all-sky autonomous star chart recognition is a key technology in star-sensitive device technology, the traditional star chart recognition algorithm is mainly characterized by the angular distance or its derived form, such methods generally require a relatively large storage space, the real-time performance is not good and the recognition rate is generally not high. In this paper, a star chart recognition algorithm based on singular value decomposition is proposed. Firstly, the basic principle of the singular value decomposition algorithm is introduced, and its features are analyzed. Secondly, based on the singular value decomposition, the star chart recognition algorithm is designed, and the star number corresponding to each image point in the known star chart is given. The experimental results show that the singular value decomposition-based star chart recognition algorithm requires less storage space, and its resolution and real-time performance are better than the traditional triangular algorithm, and it can perform finer feature extraction of the star point information in the star chart, which has good guiding significance for astronomical navigation.

articleTitle: Floating Small Target Detection Algorithm based on Features Fusion of Full Polarization Information in Sea Clutter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The detection of floating small targets in strong sea clutter is a difficult problem for radar detection. Traditional algorithms have poor detection performance in a single domain (time domain, Doppler domain, and time-frequency domain). Feature-based detection algorithms are an effective method for detecting floating small targets on the sea surface. This paper proposes a feature fusion detection algorithm based on full polarization information. This paper selects six features in the time domain and Doppler domain, and extracts six features based on full polarization information. This paper analyzes the separability of these features, and finally uses the PCA-based anomaly detector to detect target. It is verified on the IPIX radar data set. Compared with the existing six-feature PCA-based anomaly detector algorithm, the experimental results prove that the proposed algorithm has excellent detection performance.

articleTitle: Research on video Surveillance System used for smart Community
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: According to the novel Coronavirus epidemic spread that broke out this year and the severe epidemic prevention and control problems faced by the resumption of work and production in the factory area in the post-epidemic period, in this paper, an intelligent early-warning management system for personnel status in the production area of the factory was established, which realized the environmental monitoring and personnel monitoring and management, in addition, the data processing and storage of face recognition, data transmission between edge terminal and cloud platform, and task sharing of distributed edge terminal are optimized, intelligent security is realized, at the same time can effectively ensure the health and safety of workers.

Author Keywords: epidemic prevention and control early warning system

articleTitle: Research And Design Of Electric Vehicle Charging Pile Charging System Based On Mobile Payment Platform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increasing scale of electric vehicles in China, the probability of using charging piles will be higher and higher. Under the background of the rapid development of mobile Internet technology, mobile payment platform can be used as a bridge to realize information exchange between users and charging piles, and provide charging related services for users. Based on the mobile Internet platform such as Alipay, WeChat and other mobile payment platforms, combined with embedded system and mobile remote control platform, this research designs an AC charging pile system based on mobile platform operation, which realizes real-time communication between charging pile and server, and realizes the acquisition, communication and charging of charging state of mobile phone end by mobile phone platform, based on the Alipay APP or WeChat APP or other mobile payment platform.

articleTitle: Image Enhancement Method Based on Bilinear Interpolating and Wavelet Transform
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to enhance the resolution of the image and improve the visual effect of the image, a method of image quality enhancement based on bilinear interpolation and wavelet transformation is proposed. The algorithm first enhances the image by histogram equalization and bilinear interpolation to preserve better detail quality, and then perform wavelet transform on the histogram equalized image and the original imageeach of the input images are devided into 4 subbands, estimates the singular value matrix of the low frequency subband image, and then enhances the image through Wavelet reconstruction, Finally, perform histogram matching on the result image and bilinear interpolation image to obtain an enhanced image. The experimental results show that the performance of the proposed method is better than that of the traditional method.

articleTitle: Adaptive and Low Latency DWBA Algorithm with SLA Support for NG-EPON
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive and efficient resource allocation mechanism called adaptive satisfaction with inclination dynamic bandwidth and wavelength allocation (ASWI-DWBA) algorithm is proposed. Through the introduction of the inclination coefficient, the utilization of the uplink bandwidth is improved, and the adaptive support for the service level agreement (SLA) is effectively realized. On this basis, this paper compares and analyzes three dynamic wavelength allocation (DWA) schemes by considering factors such as guard time and wavelength load balancing. Finally, a wavelength allocation scheme based on priority and load is used to achieve stable low-latency performance, by making full use of the new characteristic of channel bonding and flexible allocation. The simulation results prove that the ASWI-DWBA algorithm proposed in this paper combined with the priority-load based DWA scheme can achieve adaptive changes to network load and traffic load ratio; in addition to providing stable low latency and high utilization, it can also provide continuous differentiated services.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Liver and Its Tumor Based on U-Net
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents an automatic segmentation algorithm for liver and tumor segmentation network based on U-Net network. U-Net provides a three-dimensional image segmentation method, which uses an end-to-end training method. During training, an objective function based on Dice coefficient is used to optimize training, which can handle the number of foreground and background voxels well. There is a serious imbalance between.

articleTitle: Background Calibration of Capacitor Mismatch and Gain Error in Pipelined-SAR ADC Using Partially Split Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: A background calibration of bit weights (BW) for pipelined successive approximation register (SAR) analogue-digital-converter (ADC) is proposed. Capacitor mismatch and insufficient gain of inter-stage amplifier are lumped into BW deviation. The back-end SAR ADC is split to 2 identical ADCs. For some signal amplitude near the comparator thresholds, the back-end split ADCs calculate the BWs by subtracting the outputs of ADC. For other signal amplitude, it obtains the offset mismatch (OM) of the split ADC in the same way. The gain mismatch (GM) induced spur of the split ADCs, which is hard to calibrate, is broken down to the noise floor by randomly changing the operating order of the split ADCs. This background calibration improves spurious free dynamic range (SFDR) from 70 dB to 95 dB, and signal-to-noise and distortion ratio (SINAD) from 55 dB to 73 dB, respectively. Besides, the calibration scheme converges after only 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> cycles, thereby significantly saving convergence time.

articleTitle: Research on control strategy of virtual synchronous generator based on energy storage wind farm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As an important micro power source in microgrid, energy storage system plays an important role. When the microgrid operation mode is changed, the conventional control strategy must be switched to meet the control requirements, which cannot achieve seamless switching. In addition, the switching process is easy to cause system oscillation and even cause system disconnection in serious cases. Based on the factors above, this paper proposes a virtual synchronous machine control technology for energy storage system to realize the power balance of the regulation system, which can not only maintain the voltage stability of the power grid, but also realize the parallel expansion of multiple machines. In this paper, the wind farm is equivalent to a virtual synchronous generator (VSG) by configuring energy storage battery on the AC side of the wind farm. On the one hand, the power transmitted from the wind farm to the grid is smooth, on the other hand, the system frequency and voltage are stable, which improves the grid connection performance of large-scale wind farms effectively. Finally, the feasibility of the control strategy is verified by conducting simulation studies on a system composed of wind turbine, energy storage battery and steam turbine generator set.

articleTitle: Dynamic propagation model of crowd panic based on Shanoon's entropy theory under COVID-19 epidemic situation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Pedestrian merging flow in the crowd gathering public places are the common movement nodes of crowd kinematics merging and psychological panic transmission. There are stochastic turbulences, disturbances and density fluctuations in the crowd merging area, with high risk of pedestrian stampede events. Based on the dynamics model of crowd merging, this study considers the psychological characteristics of the escape panic in the normal disaster conditions of the crowd in the cross-passages and the epidemic panic psychological characteristics under the public health events. With the introduction of Shanoon's information entropy theory, panic entropy is applied to measure the degrees of transient panic in the fluid grid area of the crowd, the overall transient disorder of the crowd, and the dynamic relationship with time and space changes. This study comprehensively considers the characteristics of conventional escape panic and epidemic panic, defines protective relaxation factors, forms a dynamic model of escape panic propagation, and provides a scientific theoretical basis for crowd evacuation guidance under COVID-19 epidemic situation.

articleTitle: Design of Adaptive Redundant Coding Concurrent Multipath Transmission Scheme in High-speed Mobile Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: As we all know, network coding can significantly improve the throughput and reliability of wireless networks. However, in the high-speed mobile environment, the packet loss rate of different wireless links may vary greatly due to the time-varying network state, which makes the adjustment of network coding redundancy very important. Because the network coding redundancy is too large, it will lead to excessive overhead and reduce the effective throughput. If the network coding redundancy is too small, it will lead to insufficient decoding, which will also reduce the effective throughput. In the design of multi-path transmission scheduling scheme, we introduce adaptive redundancy network coding scheme. By using multiple links to aggregate network bandwidth, we choose appropriate different coding redundancy for different links to resist the performance loss caused by link packet loss. The simulation results show that when the link packet loss rate is greatly different, the mechanism can not only ensure the transmission reliability, but also greatly reduce the total network redundancy to improve the network throughput very effectively.

articleTitle: Research on Performance of Wearable Microstrip Antenna Based on Flexible Material
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This article uses the three-dimensional highfrequency simulation software HFSS to design a microstrip patch antenna that works at 2.45GHz and is based on a polyimide (PI) flexible material. The microstrip line side feed is used to feed it, and the excitation method It is a lumped port. Modeling and simulation methods are used to analyze the impact of the flexible antenna on its key parameters when it is laterally bent, and the bending radius is gradually increased to analyze the changes in antenna performance. The analysis data shows that when the flexible microstrip patch antenna is bent laterally, its resonance frequency shifts along the high frequency direction, the return loss value is reduced from -18.68dB to -20.44dB, and the overall resonance point and return loss value change Smaller, and as the antenna bending radius increases from 30mm to 40mm and 50mm, the microstrip patch antenna has a detuning effect, and its center frequency is shifted along the low frequency from 2.45GHz to 2.455GHz and 2.435GHz respectively . The normalized impedance of the antenna fluctuates, and the antenna gain changes from 5.95dB to 5.99dB and 5.78dB, respectively. The overall antenna matching performance is good. In this paper, the research on the performance changes of flexible microstrip antennas under bending is of great significance to the application of microstrip antennas in the wearable field in the future.

articleTitle: Path planning of mobile Robot based on improved ant colony algorithm based on Honeycomb grid
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Based on the problems of traditional ant colony algorithm in complex environment such as slow convergence speed and easily falling into local optimal value, this paper proposes an improved ant colony algorithm based on honeycomb grid. Firstly, a grid map based on honeycomb grid was established to solve the problem of non-uniformity of traditional grid step size. Secondly, according to the traditional ant colony algorithm blindly search for the path in the early stage, centering on the straight line from the starting point to the end point, the design of uneven distribution of initial pheromone concentration was carried out by integrating three factors, namely the length from the ideal line, the number of obstacle grids and the target deviation Angle, to avoid the blind search in the early planning, improve the search efficiency in the early stage, and alleviate the problem of ant death. Thirdly, an adaptive attenuation coefficient is introduced to improve the heuristic function to strengthen the guiding role of pheromones in the later period and accelerate the convergence speed. The safety factor is introduced into the transfer probability to reduce the ant "deadlock" problem. Then, the updating rules of pheromones are improved by combining ant colony sequencing model, and the critical range of pheromones is set to improve the global optimization ability. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can improve the global search capability, and the path length and turning point can be reduced by 17.12% and 55.56% respectively compared with the traditional algorithm. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease Classification using LightGBM and Euclidean Distance Map
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Alzheimer's Disease (AD) classification is very helpful for timely treatment and intervention in its early stage so as to reduce the incidence rate of AD and delay AD progression in elderly population. In this paper, a feature extraction method utilizing Euclidean distance map was proposed. Then the features for AD classification were selected in accordance with the feature importance score calculated by LightGBM (LGB). At last, the LGB classifier was applied to classifying AD patient utilizing selected features. The proposed AD classification method was evaluated on real dataset. The experimental results show that the proposed feature extraction and selection methods are effective, and the LGB classifier using selected features is superior to other conventional classifiers.

articleTitle: Research and Simulation Analysis on Research on Secondary Radar Signal Coverage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The primary radar uses the reflected echo signal to identify the target information, and the secondary radar uses the echo signal of the receiving transponder to obtain the target information. Compared with primary radar, secondary radar can transmit more information, so secondary radar is widely used in civil aviation field. Due to the rapid economic development, more and more ultra-high buildings have appeared around secondary radar stations. The ultra-high buildings will block the signal transmission, and in severe cases, the aircraft will not be able to receive signals normally, which will endanger civil aviation. safe operation. Therefore, this article first analyzes the signal transmission of the secondary radar, establishes a digital model of the signal transmission in space, analyzes the loss caused by the building to the radar through the Finier area, and finally verifies its feasibility through simulation software.

articleTitle: Simulation of Automobile Brake System Based on PID Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The automobile safety system has become an important part of automobile research and development. The driving anti-slip control system can make full use of the maximum adhesion of the ground and prevent the excessive slip of the driving wheel in the starting and accelerating driving process on low adhesion, separation and split roads, so as to improve the tractive trafficability, directional stability and steering maneuverability of the vehicle. In this paper, simulation model of ABS Vehicle based on single wheel is designed in which PID control algorithm is adopted. Simulation results show that the slip rate becomes stable by online adjusting Kp, Ki, Kd three parameters properly. The PID control can be well applied in anti-sideslip of automobile.

articleTitle: Dense Connected Residual Generative Adversarial Network for Single Image Deblurring
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Recently, deep convolutional learning has been applied to image deblurring, which greatly improves the performance of single-image blind deblurring algorithms. However, most deep image deblurring models based on convolutional neural networks do not make full use of the information of low-level spatial convolutions, so they achieve relatively poor performance. In this paper, we improved the generator of the Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) and proposed dense networks and residual networks to solve this problem in image deblurring. The network makes full use of the hierarchical features of all convolutional layers. Specifically, we extract the local features of the convolutional layer through the proposed densely connected convolutional layer. Moreover, the dense connections of the residual dense network can connect all layers from the previous state to the current state. Then using local jump connection and feature fusion, it can adaptively learn more effective features from the previous and current local features, making the trained network more extensive. After fully obtaining the dense local features, the global residual connection is used to learn the global feature information in an overall manner. Experimental comparison and verification have proved the effectiveness of our method and achieved excellent results both quantitatively and qualitatively.

articleTitle: Multimodal Image Fusion based on Improved Pulse-Coupled Neural Network and Convolutional Sparse Representation in NSST Domain
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Multi-mode medical image fusion combines image functions of different modes and plays a vital role in the diagnosis of various diseases, treatment planning and follow-up research. In view of this situation, an image fusion method based on non-subsampled shearlet transform (NSST) and an improved pulse coupled neural network model was proposed. In the proposed method, the non-subsampled shearlet transform (NSST) method was used to decompose the source image into low frequency sub-bands and several high frequency sub-bands. The improved sparse representation was used to fuse low-frequency sub-bands, which could eliminate detailed features through the sobel operator and the guided filter, thereby improving the ability to effectively conserve energy. At the same time, the high frequency sub-bands were fused by the parameter adaptive pulse coupled neural network (PAPCNN). With four other different types of medical image fusion methods to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Experimental results show that this method is better than the other four comparison methods in subjective visual performance and objective evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on optimal scheduling method of Airport Rapid Transit system
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Because of the relative lack of domestic experience in the construction and operation of the airport rapid transit system ((APM)). Firstly, based on the characteristics of airport passenger flow, a method is proposed to predict the daily passenger flow of the airport according to the flight plan. Then the distribution characteristics of the "spinning cone" section of passenger flow in multi-terminal airports are analyzed, and the operation scheme of large and small intersections is put forward. Taking the enterprise operating cost and passenger travel cost as the objective function, considering the departure interval, train continuity conditions, and train capacity constraints, the APM optimal scheduling model is constructed, and an improved genetic algorithm is designed. Finally, an example study is carried out based on the APM of Atlanta International Airport, and the optimized operation plan reduces the operating cost of the enterprise by 6.28% and the total waiting time of passengers by 10.72%. The results show that the model and algorithm have certain reference value for the construction and operation of APM in our country.

articleTitle: An AETA Electromagnetic Disturbance Anomaly Extraction Method based on Sample Entropy
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the multi-component seismic monitoring system AETA's electromagnetic disturbance (ED) data, an outlier extraction method is proposed based on sample entropy. Sample entropy can reflect the possibility of new information in the time series. Sample entropy algorithm is utilized for processing the electromagnetic disturbance data to figure out the sample entropy sequence in days. Then sliding quartile method is used to obtain the outlier sequence by calculating the abnormal index of sample entropy sequence. The experiment result in Yibin Ms 6.0 earthquake and superposed epoch analysis demonstrate that the method can detect the outlier and have the ability to reflect earthquake.

articleTitle: A 10MS/s 16bit SAR ADC Achieving 100dB SFDR and 90dB SNDR in 0.18 um CMOS
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a 10MS/s 16bit ADC consisting of a 4 bit flash coarse ADC, a 14bit SAR fine ADC with 2 bit redundancy, that achieves nearly constant 90dB peak SNDR up to Nyquist and an SFDR of 100dB for Nyquist frequencies. The bottom-plate sampling with split-capacitor switching scheme eliminates CDAC’s sensitivity to parasitic capacitances on the top plates of the DAC as well as signal dependence of charge injection, while minimizing DAC switching energy without requiring a reference common mode (CM) voltage. In addition, a dynamic comparator with high gain and bandwitdth preamplifier achieves low noise and high speed operation. A foreground calibration method is implemented to correct capacitor DAC mismatch and reduce capacitor size, and the calibration is fully digital and doesn't require accurate references or input signals. At 10 MS/s, the ADC consumes 10 mW from a 1.8-V supply voltage in SMIC 0.18um CMOS process and achieves a Schreier figure of merit of 170.8dB.

articleTitle: Weld Seam Tracking Based on Laser Imaging Binary Image Preprocessing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the current welding seam tracking research, the laser tracking system of welding seam in the v-shaped welding process, the camera’s anti-interference ability is low in the process of image acquisition, image noise is too much, and so on. A welding seam tracking method of laser imaging binary image preprocessing is proposed. The denoising point method of open operation and OSTU algorithm were used to obtain image binarization threshold and generate binarization image. MATLAB programming was used to obtain the binary image of the laser structural light obtained by the camera, and the image was further de-noised by corrosion and expansion operations to obtain the accurate data of the weld. The laser imaging features in the V-shaped weld image were enhanced to further improve the identification accuracy of using the laser vision triangulation method, as well as the tracking accuracy of the weld during the process. The error could be controlled within 0.5mm.

articleTitle: A Quasi-Synchronous Sampling Energy Metering Chip with a Dedicated Dual-Core DSP
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To enable harmonic analysis in smart meters, we design an energy metering chip that supports the quasi-synchronous sampling. The quasi-synchronous sampling is realized by the Newton polynomial interpolation algorithm. To implement the overall metering algorithm, we design a dedicated dual-core digital signal processor (DSP) with a primary core and a secondary core sharing the same data memory and arithmetic logic unit (ALU). The DSP also has a special data memory architecture with a dynamic shifting and virtual address mechanism, which simplifies the control in the DSP program. The quasi-synchronous sampling technique can achieve an accuracy of 0.3% in harmonic metering, meeting the requirement of single-phase smart meters.

articleTitle: Research on data acquisition and management of digital workshop management system based on Safety PLC control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the industrial Internet of things cloud computing has become an important information infrastructure, more and more applications migrate to the cloud, and the reliability of cloud services is becoming increasingly important [1]. Especially the introduction of new edge computing mode, the reliability of data transmission and communication between the device and the host computer is put forward higher requirements. Therefore, this paper studies the data reliability of the safety PLC system environment of the digital foundry workshop, and proposes a security PLC control system based on Dual CPU architecture combined with edge computing scheme to solve the problems of data interaction delay and packet loss of communication terminal between equipment terminal and cloud server, and improve the real-time response speed [2]–[4]. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively ensure the reliability and real-time response of data interaction between the device terminal and cloud server.

articleTitle: Research on Power Frequency Over-voltage And Suppression Measures Of Ultra-high Voltage Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to ensure the reliable operation of power system, to adapt to the characteristics of uneven economic development and resource to generate electricity in China, to realize electric power over long distances, cross-regional, across the river. In ultra-high voltage transmission lines, the perceptual load decreases, the increase of reactive power in line, lead to uneven distribution of voltage, power frequency voltage rise. According to the operation experience at home and abroad, the reasons of the power frequency overvoltage are: one is the capacitance effect of no-load lines, two it is asymmetric fault lines, three is a sudden load rejection. The size of the power frequency overvoltage and system structure, capacity, parameters and operation mode, Shunt reactor in ultra-high voltage transmission lines can absorb reactive power, limit the power frequency overvoltage and operating over-voltage. In this paper, using the EMTP simulation software to let up of 500 kV transmission line effect and suppression measures are simulated, check true Suggestions proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Abnormal Human Behavior Recognition Based on Image Processing Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, digital image processing technology and computer vision technology have been continuously developed and made considerable progress. Based on the image information, through the detection, extraction and recognition operations, the human posture is understood, and abnormal behavior can be recognized in time. In this paper, related work in the abnormal human behavior analysis is first introduced, including many advanced practical projects. Then three methods of human target detection are listed, with the advantages and disadvantages being compared. The detection process is designed according to the inter-frame difference method. Finally, specific realization is proposed from three aspects: area identification, feature extraction, abnormality determination, and the algorithm steps are clearly summarized. Therefore, this study can provide technical support and decision-making guidance for safety management, with a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Design and hardware realization of active noise control system based on momentum LMS algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the convergence speed of the active noise control (ANC) system in practice. This paper proposes a new module for the realization of ANC system for online secondary path modeling. The momentum LMS algorithm (MLMS) is used to adjust the modeling filter and control the filter. The design includes three convolution modules and two weight update modules to reduce noise. When it is necessary to better reduce the noise of the ANC system, this innovative modular implementation of the ANC system can achieve rapid design and rapid convergence, and has the ability to expand four adaptive filters and data buses. The system demonstrates convincing results with accuracy, convergence speed, and the functions of the designed and implemented system. At the same time, using FPGA's features of low power consumption and high-speed parallel processing to design the system, the final modeling error and noise reduction performance are -25dB and 15dB, respectively.

articleTitle: A Real-time Full-body Motion Capture and Reconstruction System for VR Basic Set
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Having a virtual avatar in virtual reality(VR) applications can increase immersion. However, most of the existing VR basic sets only contain limited tracking sensors to provide effective information for full-body motion capture and reconstruction. Therefore, we present a lightweight real-time full-body motion capture and reconstruction prototype system only using head-mounted display and motion controllers. The system constructs HeadIK and HandIK which are optimized based on the human inverse kinematics (IK) algorithm to reconstruct the upper body motion accurately. And we address the animation blending space and FootIK to achieve natural smooth lower body motion that is not neglected by blindfolded users. Meanwhile, the animation retargeting algorithm ensures that our system can adapt to various body shapes. Experiments show that our method can reconstruct the natural movement of the whole body using only consumer-grade VR basic sets. We demonstrate that our system can enhance immersion in the VR experience and can be used in most VR applications.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Incremental Data Capturing in Wireless Network Planning based on Log Mining
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Incremental data capturing(IDC) is an important measure to improve the efficiency of parameter distribution and configuration in wireless networks to transmit the incremental part of the network planning configuration parameters. In order to solve the problems of large volume of network full-parameter files and inconvenience of wireless transmission, this paper compares and analyzes Oracle's existing incremental data capturing technology, proposes a log analysis-based incremental data capturing method and a redundancy elimination method which is suitable for wireless heterogeneous network planning. The proposed methods simplify the volume of network configuration parameter files, reduces the amount of network configuration parameters, also reduces the maintenance burden of network planners, which are suitable for realizing the distribution and update of wireless communication network planning configuration parameters, and also have certain reference value for incremental data synchronization in other wireless system's distributed databases.

articleTitle: Research on Text Classification Algorithm Based on BiLSTM-WSAttention
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: BiLSTM has been widely used in the field of text classification, but the model still cannot accurately measure the importance of each word and cannot extract text features more effectively. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a BiLSTM-WSAttention model. The neural network model of BiLSTM-WSAttention is used to classify text. The BiLSTM-WSAttention neural network model combines the context of words and sentences, and extracts contextual semantic information from two perspectives: front to back and back to front. At the same time, this article introduces an attention mechanism. Since text is composed of sentences, sentences are composed of words, and the importance of words and sentences depends on context information, so this article includes word-level attention mechanisms and sentence-level. The attention mechanism assigns different weight values to different words and sentences. Finally, the method proposed in this article is compared with the classification methods of Naive-Bayes, CNN, RNN, and BLSTM on the same data set. The experimental results show that: Compared with other classification methods, the neural network model BiLSTM-WSAttention proposed in this article is effective on this data set.

articleTitle: Design of a Simulation and Analysis System for Asynchronous Motor Operation based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Because of the advantages of simple structure, low cost and high efficiency, asynchronous motor has been widely used in production and life. However,There are also some defects in its application. On the one hand, due to the high power of some asynchronous motors and the bad working environment, the running state is not easy to be controlled by people. On the other hand, high-power asynchronous motor sometimes runs at high voltage, which is dangerous for learner in the first stage. Therefore, in order to improve the above situations, an asynchronous motor simulation system is designed in this paper.In this system, various simulation models of starting, regulating speed and braking of asynchronous motor are built by using Simulink tool module, and the change of operation parameters can be observed from oscilloscope. At the same time, the user login interface is established by using guide based MATLAB. After logging in the system, users can call various simulation models of asynchronous motor on the simulation interface, modify the relevant operation parameters of the motor model on the interface, and view the results of rotor current, stator current, rotor speed and electromagnetic torque of asynchronous motor. Through this system, users can more intuitively observe the influence of different parameters on the operation of asynchronous motor, which provides great convenience for the research and experiment of asynchronous motor. It can also show the characteristics of various starting, speed regulation and braking, which provides a reference for the research and analysis of asynchronous motor.

articleTitle: Gradient Color Leaf Image Segmentation Algorithm Based on Meanshift and Kmeans
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to segment the gradient color leaf image accurately in complex background, a method of image segmentation combining meanshift algorithm and kmeans algorithm is proposed. In this paper, meanshift algorithm is used in LUV space to smooth the color image, then kmeans algorithm is used to divide and correct similar areas, and finally OTSU algorithm is used for image binary segmentation. The method uses the smoothing ability of meanshift algorithm to process the image gradient area, and uses the clustering ability of kmeans algorithm to solve the problem of under-segmentation of the gradient color region. The method can effectively separate the gradient color leaf image from different backgrounds. The results of the proposed method are better than the color index method.

articleTitle: A Satellite Attitude Determination Method Based on Error Compensation
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper establishes linear state equation and measurement equation based on error quaternion, designs the multiple-sensor attitude determination model, directly applies the Kalman filtering method to perform real-time online estimation and compensation for the error of gyro and infrared horizon instrument, quickly completes the measurement error estimation of gyro drift and infrared horizon instrument, and finally realizes the accurate attitude determination of the satellite. This method overcomes the shortcoming of truncation error introduced by linearization in the nonlinear attitude determination system of the satellite, and avoids a large amount of calculation work caused by solving Jacobian matrix. Simulation results show that the filter method converges rapidly and stably with higher satellite attitude estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: An Supervisable Anonymous Authentication Scheme Based on Master-slave Certificate
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The development of blockchain has put forward higher requirements for authentication technology. In order to solve the current blockchain authentication problem and enhance the supervision and anonymity, we propose an authentication scheme based on master-slave certificate and zero-knowledge proof. Users can hide their real identity information through the anonymity of the slave certificate. When necessary, regulators can track the malicious users through smart contracts. Through security analysis, it is verified that there is no linkability between the master and slave certificates of this scheme, which can efficiently achieve supervisable anonymous authentication. The simulation experiment results show that the scheme is stable and scalable. The results also show that, compared with the traditional authentication, this scheme reduces the computational overhead of certificate issuers and is suitable for adoption in blockchain systems.

articleTitle: Design of Equipment Condition Maintenance Knowledge Base in Power IoT Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The power IoT (Internet of things) realizes the holographic perception of power grid state, and drives the data sharing and application through the Internet of things platform, data center and business center, providing a more comprehensive data base for the construction of equipment state maintenance. Edge computing provides a real-time processing method with low delay for equipment condition monitoring, it also provides a more comprehensive data basis for equipment condition maintenance. The paper proposed a framework design of equipment condition based maintenance knowledge base using machine learning. The combination of production rules and Petri net model are used to realize knowledge compilation and reasoning, and complete the intelligent decision of equipment fault repair.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization based UAV for Disaster management
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the present age of changing ecological balance due to rampant human intervention, the need for the technology which can assist humans during the natural disaster is increasing. The swarm optimization techniques have proved their significance in different fields to achieve desired results<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1] [2]</sup>. Here we are trying to capitalize on the same techniques with integration of other techniques like face detection along with the object tracking algorithms to achieve a desired UAV which can aid humans during natural disasters where humans can’t reach out as promptly as these technologies can. Moreover the added advantage with swarm technology is that even if some of the UAVs fails ,the other UAVs are not affected and are able to execute the rescue work. In sense the efficacy of the entire rescue operation is not hampered.

articleTitle: Investigation of electromagnetic field transmission characteristics of rectangular waveguides
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, a model of a rectangular waveguide is designed to derive the partial transmission characteristics of electromagnetic waves in a rectangular waveguide tube from a set of Maxwell's equations. Simulation experiments are conducted using HFSS and MATLAB for three modes, TE10, TE01 and TM11, to obtain the variation of phase velocity and group velocity with operating frequency, the electromagnetic field distribution in the three modes and the effect of rectangular waveguide size parameters on the cutoff frequency.

articleTitle: A Vehicle Driving State Estimation Algorithm based on Elman Neural Network and Unscented Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Vehicle driving states in a dynamic vehicle model are with strong uncertainty and nonlinearity. Simply applying traditional Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) or Neural Network cannot meet the requirements of future vehicle driving state estimation, which may lead to a severe failure in the vehicle's electronic controlling system. This paper proposes an optimized algorithm based on Elman Neural Network (ENN) and UKF. Combining the superiority of ENN dealing with nonlinearity and the ability of UKF dealing with uncertainty, the proposed ENN-UKF significantly reduces the filtering error. Based on the nonlinear seven-degree-of-freedom vehicle model and Dugoff tire model, ENN-UKF is tested on standard Double Lane Change road conditions. The results demonstrate that our approach performs much better than traditional UKF with an improvement of at least 40%. This study indicates the feasibility of applying ENN-UKF in the vehicle driving state estimation.

articleTitle: SAG-EC: Edge Computing Platform Based on Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: At present, with the rapid development of Internet of Things and wireless communication technology, terrestrial communication systems will evolve to space-air-ground networks to meet the needs of more network users and greater coverage. In the Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network, there are challenges of limited network bandwidth resources and huge amount of data. In response to this situation, this paper proposes an edge computing platform based on Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network. The platform displays and controls IoT data, and uses task distribution algorithms to cluster nodes, and each cluster performs further tasks Issued. On the one hand, this solution realizes low-cost device interconnection and data transmission, and solves the problem of difficult equipment and data management. On the other hand, it saves satellite communication resources and improves data transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Improved Adaptive Grid Interactive Multiple Model Algorithm based on Maneuverability Division
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The grid points of the Adaptive Grid Interactive Multiple Model (AGIMM) algorithm change slowly at the target high maneuvering and fluctuate when the target is moving at a constant speed. The paper proposes an improved AGIMM algorithm based on maneuverability of target. Firstly, divide the Maneuverability zones by Filter residuals. Secondly, according to different zones, the grid points are updated in different ways to speed up the convergence of the model when the target is high maneuvering, and reduce the fluctuation of the model when the target is low maneuvering. Realize the model update method according to the target maneuverability adaptive adjustment. The simulation shows that the improved algorithm significantly reduces the tracking error regardless of whether the target turns or not.

articleTitle: Research on Inner Knuckle Pattern Recognition Method Based on Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, the hand inner knuckle pattern is the research object, the hand image is preprocessed by binarization, morphological processing, contour extraction, corner positioning, finger separation and knuckle ROI extraction. Then normalize the region of interest and form a two-dimensional matrix into the convolutional neural network for feature extraction. Finally we used the fully connected layer and the Softmax for classification and recognition. And studied the learning rate, the convolution kernels number, the neurons number in the fully connected layer, the convolutional layers number in the network and the impact of different optimization algorithms on the recognition results, obtain the best network parameters. Accroding to the experimental test and analysis, the recognition rate of the inner knuckle pattern recognition method based on convolutional neural network reached 95.2%, which has good application value.

articleTitle: Spark-based Distance Weighted Recommendation System Research
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: For the traditional recommendation system for big data computing, the processing speed is slow, the recommendation accuracy is not high, and the proximity principle cannot be reflected when recommending tourist attractions. The advantages of Spark parallelized computing and memory iteration operation are used, at the same time, the user similarity is added to the nearest neighbor characteristics and the weighted coefficient of the user score multiplied by the geographical location of the scenic spot, and the weighted recommendation system model based on Spark geographic location is proposed. According to the data set provided by the Tianchi data of Alibaba cloud, the system is 2.45 times faster than the traditional recommendation system running under MapReduce, and the recommended accuracy is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on Text Classification and Data Analysis of Complaints by Shanghai Gas Company
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Since 2018, Shanghai Gas Company has entered customers' complaints by 12345 hotline into the company's platform system. This article uses customers' complaints from 2018 to 2020 for data analysis. Thee complaint text classification based on the improved naive Bayes algorithm to solve the three major points: in the process of manually classifying the complaint text, there are defects and errors caused by human negligence, this is accuracy problem. Due to the large amount of complaint data, manual classification of text data requires a lot of time and effort, this is efficiency problem. The text classification and analysis of the complaint text by human is not deep enough to accurately and quickly locate the hot issues in user complaints, this is depth problem. In view of the above three problems, an improved naive Bayesian algorithm is proposed, this algorithm combines n-gram algorithm and naive Bayes algorithm to realize the classification of complaint texts and solves the disadvantage of naive Bayes not considering word order.

articleTitle: Research on Energy Regulation and Optimal Operation Strategy of Multi-energy Ship Power Station Based on Improved Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This thesis aims at the power station energy regulation and optimal operation strategy of multi-energy ships. Firstly, the energy conversion and coupling model of diesel engine, energy storage, new energy and load is established, and the power distribution of multi-energy ship loads is optimized. The improved particle swarm algorithm is used to optimize the scheduling of multiple diesel generators in the multi-energy ship power station, and a strategy for smoothing the full-cycle power fluctuations of the multi-energy ship based on the virtual battery model is proposed. Finally, the second-order filtering method is used to control the hybrid energy storage system performs real-time power distribution and smooths power fluctuations in the grid. The research results show that the optimized active power loss of the ship’s power system is significantly reduced, which significantly improves the multi-energy ship’s multi-layer architecture and its operating efficiency, and effectively improves the economy, stability and safety of the ship’s power system. It can significantly improve the optimal operation technology and economic operation control mode of multi-energy ships.

articleTitle: Dynamic Calculation Model for Pressure Safety Monitoring of Municipal Water Supply Network with Interference Elimination Function between Neighboring Nodes
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to monitor the pressure safety status of municipal water supply network, the dynamic calculation model of pressure safety monitoring of municipal water supply network with the function of eliminating interference between neighboring nodes was studied by using the Internet of things and data processing technology. Based on the calculation of the attenuation coefficient of pressure wave in municipal pipe network, this paper discusses the establishment method of neighbor coordinates between monitoring points by the constraint of pressure wave attenuation distance, and then combines the data processing technologies such as pressure mean value, pressure difference, pressure variance, pressure variance growth rate, etc., to construct a dynamic monitoring calculation model of pressure safety state with the function of eliminating interference between neighboring nodes. The research shows that the model can complete the dynamic calculation and real-time warning of the pressure safety state monitoring of the municipal water supply network through the acquisition, processing and feedback of the pressure of the municipal water supply network, realize the pressure safety state monitoring of the municipal water supply network, and improve the dynamic information safety management level of the municipal water supply network.

articleTitle: Research on the Control System and Digital Model of new 5-Axis 3D Printer Based on Stewart Parallel Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In view of the existing problems of the original three-axis 3D printer, such as complex model support, high surface roughness of the model, low material utilization rate and long printing cycle, using the 3D modeling software Solidworks to carry out innovative design for it, the five-axis 3D printing was used to improve the printing quality. A new 5-axis 3D printer based on Stewart parallel mechanism is selected as the design scheme, which can realize unsupported printing and improve printing efficiency and material utilization. Stewart platform parallel mechanism has the characteristics of strong bearing capacity and non-accumulative position error, which is complementary to Delta parallel mechanism in application.

articleTitle: Study on Active Jamming Method for Ka-band Radar Seeker
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Modern electronic technology is developing rapidly, traditional passive jamming is not effective when facing the Ka-band radar seeker using pulse compression technology. This paper introduces two kinds of active coherent methods including intensive deception jamming (IDJ) and smart noise jamming (SNJ) against the Ka-band radar seeker. These methods can work in the radar frequency band, covering the original echo signal from the time domain and frequency domain to deceive the non-cooperative radar. In addition, the MATLAB R2018a simulations verify the effectiveness of the jamming to the 35.75Ghz linear frequency modulation (LFM) radar signal. Finally, the paper designs the digital radio frequency memory (DRFM) hardware platform. Results show the effectiveness of these two jamming methods by the upper computer.

articleTitle: An Approach on Attack Path Prediction Modeling Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Considering the lack of theoretical analysis for distributed network under APT (advanced persistent threat) attacks, a game model was proposed to solve the problem based on APT attack path. Firstly, this paper analyzed the attack paths of attackers and proposed the defensive framework of network security by analyzing the characteristics of the APT attack and the distributed network structure. Secondly, OAPG(an attack path prediction model oriented to APT) was established from the value both the attacker and the defender based on game theory, besides, this paper calculated the game equilibrium and generated the maximum revenue path of the attacker, and then put forward the best defensive strategy for defender. Finally, this paper validated the model by an instance of APT attack, the calculated results showed that the model can analyze the attacker and defender from the attack path, and can provide a reasonable defense scheme for organizations that use distributed networks.

articleTitle: Research on Watershed Algorithm Based on Image Marking Method Optimization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In image processing, due to the presence of noise or other unpredictable interference factors, the use of traditional watershed algorithms often results in excessive segmentation. In order to solve this problem, the watershed algorithm optimized based on the image tagging method can be used to guide the computer to complete the watershed algorithm segmentation by artificially setting the prior knowledge in order to obtain a better image segmentation effect. Finally, it is verified by experiments that the watershed algorithm based on the image labeling method is better than the traditional watershed algorithm in segmenting some complex images.

articleTitle: An improved and heuristic-based iterative DBSCAN clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In recent years, the clustering of multi-density data has been a research hotspot. As a widely applied clustering algorithm, density-based spatial clustering of application with noise (DBSCAN) algorithm can avoid the interference of noise data, and has the ability to find clusters of any shape. However, the DBSCAN algorithm used hyperparameter (e.g., eps, MinPts), which makes the clusters of different densities cannot be identified. Furthermore, when the algorithm is applied to different datasets, the clustering quality would decrease severely. To cope with the above problems, we propose an improved and heuristic-based iterative DBSCAN clustering algorithm. The new algorithm realizes flexible clustering of the data with different densities by MinPts. In particular, we first estimate the values of MinPts according to the user area densities, then the new clustering is carried out based on the MinPts. This method avoids too dense clusters. In the experiments, Silhouette Coefficient and purity are adopted to evaluate the clustering effect of the improved DBSCAN algorithm. It is demonstrated that the proposed algorithm can effectively cluster multi-density data, and has greater adaptability and clustering performance to all kinds of data.

articleTitle: Prediction of MOOCs Dropout based on WCLSRT Model
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The enrollment rate of large online open courses (MOOCs) is increasing, but due to the lack of external control, the problem of high dropout rate has been difficult to solve. However, most of the existing methods for coding and feature extraction of dropout rate prediction models rely on manual work, and the performance of the models is not very good.
