This paper proposes a WCLSRT model algorithm which uses word2 vector to encode, then uses Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to extract features, then uses Long Short-Term Memory network (LSTM) to combine the temporal characteristics of each input vector, and finally uses Random Forest (RT) to predict. It can automatically extract time series, and make full use of the advantages of the above algorithms to improve the performance of the model. Experiments on common datasets show that the AUC of the model is significantly improved compared with the existing algorithms.

articleTitle: A Gearbox Fault Feature Extraction Method based on Composite Time-frequency Atomic Dictionary and Fast Kurtogram
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The vibration signal of gearbox is characterized by complex components and multiple modes of aliasing. In order to extract the fault feature of gearbox, a new method based on composite time-frequency atomic dictionary and fast kurtogram is proposed. Firstly, according to the characteristics of the gearbox fault vibration signal, a composite time-frequency atomic dictionary composed of steady-state modulation dictionary and impact modulation dictionary is constructed. Then, the vibration signal is denoised by OMP. Moreover, the optimal filter parameters are determined by fast kurtogram to filter the noise reduction signal, and the frequency spectrum analysis of the filtered signal is carried out to obtain the gearbox fault feature. At the same time, the performance of the composite time-frequency atomic dictionary and classical DCT, Fourier and LFMF dictionaries and their robustness under different noises are studied. The result shows that the composite time-frequency atomic dictionary is superior to other dictionaries in reconstruction accuracy and computational efficiency. Finally, the above method is applied to the experimental signal, which can accurately extract the gearbox fault feature.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation of Interface Test Data based on Protocol Modeling and Constraint Coverage
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The software involves multiple interfaces for information exchange, and interface testing needs a quantity of test data. In the process of automatic generation of interface test data, due to the numerous interface types, various formats, complex processing, and the lack of universal test data automatic generation method, the efficiency of interface test data generation is low and the coverage is insufficient. Therefore, this paper proposes an automatic generation method of interface test data based on protocol modeling and constraint coverage. Firstly, the features of the interface protocol are abstracted, the five-layer interface protocol description rules are formulated, and the interface protocol is modeled to form an interface protocol description file. Then the value range constraints of the protocol fields are analyzed and summarized, and the constraint coverage criteria for data generation are formulated. Finally, a data generation tool is developed, which can automatically generate test data set that meets the constraint coverage criteria. Applied in the interface testing of an embedded software system, the results show that the proposed method can improve the test data generation efficiency and coverage sufficiency of UDP, serial port and CAN bus interface, and has good universality.

articleTitle: A High Speed SM3 Algorithm Implementation for Security Chip
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: High throughput of crypto circuit is critical for many high performance security applications. The proposed SM3 circuit design breaks the inherent limitation of the conventional algorithm flow by removing the "blocking point" on the critical path, and reorganizes the algebraic structure by adding four parallel compensation operations. In addition, the round expansion architecture, CSA (Carry Save Adder) and pre-calculation are also used in this design. Due to the optimization at both the algorithm level and the circuit level, the synthesized circuit of this design can reach maximum 415MHz operating clock frequency and 6.4Gbps throughput with SMIC 40nm high performance technology. Compared with the conventional implementation method, the throughput performance of the proposed SM3 circuit increases by 97.5% and the chip area of SM3 algorithm area is only increased by 16.2%.

articleTitle: A Distributed Identifier Mapping Resolving System for Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of network security and mobility caused by the ambiguity of traditional network IP address, space-air-ground integrated network (SAGIN) can be networked based on the identifier mapping system, which realizes the separation of identifier and locator. Since a large number of users will access SAGIN in the future, the storage and maintenance of mapping information will face a great problem. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a mixed-level distributed identifier mapping resolving system, which divides the core network into two levels. The intra-domain identifier management server (IDMS) maintains the mapping relation between IP address and routing identifier (RID). The inter-domain IDMS maintains the mapping relation between IP address prefix and server identifier (SID) in the access AS. We will describe the working principle of this system in detail, and prove that it can well meet the scenario that a large number of users access SAGIN. Tested in a virtual environment, the results show that the mapping information resolving delay of this system meets the requirements of SAGIN.

articleTitle: Research on Leading Angle Flux-weakening Control Strategy of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on Over-modulation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To widen the speed range of PMSM, a new governing system combining leading angle flux-weakening control and SVPWM over-modulation is proposed in this paper. The inverter shifts to over-modulation state after the motor reaches the rated speed, thus the inverter fundamental output voltage amplitude is effectively increased. Then the inverter enters the flux-weakening control state, to maximize the speed range. Leading angle flux-weakening control uses three closed-loop control of speed, current and voltage, these three PI controllers work together to produce a current leading angle and current module, giving a quadrature-axis(q-axis) current and a direct-axis(d-axis) current. Simulation and experimental platform are established to verify the control system, both the simulation and experimental results proved the correctness and feasibility of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: A Two-step Tuning Method of Control Parameters for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Taking the tubular permanent magnet synchronous linear motor(TPMSLM) system as the research target, a kind of parameters tuning strategy for balancing dynamic tracking performance and system stability is proposed. First, based on the mathematical model of the servo system, the parameters of the control system are initially tuned according to the index of the frequency-domain optimal model from the inner loop to the outer loop. Second, the neural network is used to establish the correlation model between the control parameters and the error evaluation index. Subsequently, the optimal parameters were obtained by Pareto optimal front. The two-step tuning method makes up for the defects of model-based tuning or rule-based tuning, giving the optimal solution set without weakening the weight of different objectives. The experimental results show that the optimized control system has strong anti-interference ability and good dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Research on Geomagnetic Waveform Detection and Vehicle Identification Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The geomagnetic sensor system needs to meet the low power consumption and high real-time requirements of the single-chip microcomputer, which may cause the vehicle flow detection algorithm to be insensitive to high-frequency geomagnetic signals with small mean value changes. Slow vehicles, end-to-end vehicles and large-scale vehicles are also prone to false detections and other issues. This paper studies the vehicle flow detection method based on waveform, which is to perform real-time filtering on the collected geomagnetic signal waveform, dynamically adjust the threshold, calculate the magnetic field strength and its curve feature points and extract the waveform, and obtain the vehicle to be inspected through multi-intermediate state machine processing. Vehicle speed, inferred vehicle models. This study achieves higher robustness, adaptability, higher accuracy, reliability and redundancy.

articleTitle: Cognitive Radar Target Tracking Algorithm based on Waveform Selection
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the tracking problem of maneuvering target, a waveform library based on LFM signal is established from the perspective of waveform selection of cognitive radar. The maneuvering target was modeled by constant velocity model (CV) and constant acceleration model (CA), and the signal was filtered by interactive multi-model (IMM) based on Kalman filter. From the perspective of information theory, based on maximizing the mutual information between the target predicted state and the measured state, the optimal waveform library was established. The simulation results show that the waveform library can improve the tracking performance of radar, reduce the redundant waveform and reduce the computation.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of aircraft servo mechanism based on multi-model UKF
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the nonlinear time-varying system fault diagnosis, aiming at the shortcomings of the traditional multi model adaptive estimation method, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on UKF and multi model adaptive estimation for fault diagnosis of missile servo mechanism, and simulates typical faults for simulation verification. The simulation results show that when a single servo mechanism fails, the method can judge which one is faulty in time, and estimate the servo swing angle accurately. It can get rid of the application limitation of too many filters required by traditional methods, and solve the problem of inaccurate estimation of non-zero position jamming. It provides a certain reference value for quickly and accurately diagnosing missile servo mechanism failures and improving flight reliability.

articleTitle: Substation Main Connection Reliability Evaluation Considering Multi-state Model and Switching Process
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the traditional substation reliability evaluation, the two-state reliability evaluation model is mainly used, and the switching state of the components is not considered. In view of the shortcomings of traditional methods, firstly, a multi-state model of the components in the substation is established and the failure time after component failure is corrected through the switching process, and an optimization model suitable for substation main connection reliability evaluation is proposed. The expected energy not supplied calculated by the method proposed in this paper is more optimistic than that of traditional method. This paper provides a new idea for substation main connection reliability evaluation.

articleTitle: Research on text detection method based on improved yolov3
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Text detection in natural scenes is one of the hot issues in the field of computer vision. Aiming at the problems of complex text background, object occlusion and illumination changes in natural scenes, this paper proposes a method of text detection in natural scenes based on improved YOLOv3 (UDSP- YOLO), this method uses the CLAHE image enhancement preprocessing method to eliminate the impact of lighting changes in the natural scene on the target recognition effect, and uses random spatial sampling pooling (S3Pool) as the downsampling method of the feature extraction network to preserve the space of the feature map Information solves the problem of background interference in complex environments. The 8 times down-sampling feature map output by the feature extraction network is up-sampled by 2 times, and the 2 times up-sampling feature map is spliced with the feature map output by the second residual block to establish The output is a 4 times downsampling feature fusion target detection layer, and the improved network model is used to compare experiments with the original network on the ICDAR2015 data set. The results show that the improved network model effectively improves the detection accuracy.

articleTitle: A new method for forward-looking scanning radar imaging based on L1/2 regularization
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The performance of scanning radar forward looking imaging mainly depends on the improvement of azimuth resolution which can be realized by deconvolution. However, due to the ill conditioned nature of deconvolution, it will lead to noise amplification. The regularization method can effectively suppress the ill conditioned of deconvolution by adding regular constraints. Among many regularization methods, L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> constraint is usually used if the target is sparse, but it is not the most sparse solution. Theoretically, L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</inf> can produce more sparse solutions than L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>. With the development of L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</inf> constraint regularization mathematical theory and the improvement of computer computing ability, it can be solved quickly even if it is a nonconvex, nonsmooth and non-Lipschitz optimization problem. In addition, L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</inf> constraint regularization has been applied in the field of compressed sensing. In this article, we introduce L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</inf> constraint regularization into forward-looking imaging, and the simulation results show that it can achieve better recovery effect than L<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> constraint regularization in sparse scene.

articleTitle: Detection of Residual Yarn in Bobbin Based on Hough Transform and BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to promote the intellectualization of textile industry, in this paper, a step-by-step residual yarn detection algorithm based on Hough transform and BP neural network is proposed. According to the geometric characteristic’s transformation of bobbins with a large amount of residual yarn, the images are converted to the grayscale, then the edges of image are detected by Canny-Otsu algorithm and the outlines of bobbin are detected by Hough transform, the bobbins with a large amount of residual yarn are eliminated by outline detection results. The images which cannot eliminated by outline detection are converted to HSV color space and divide to several sub regions, the HSV values are extracted as the input layer of BP neural network, the residual yarn condition of bobbins as the output layer. The experimental results show that the detection accuracy of algorithm is up to 96%, which meets the requirements of practical application.

articleTitle: A Long-range Neural Stimulator for Pigeon-robots
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Although a large number of neural stimulators have been developed, there is still a lack of outdoor long-range neural stimulators. Based on distributed design, we have proposed a long-range neural stimulator for pigeon-robots. In the proposed stimulator, the receiving control terminal placed on the animal is divided into three parts, that is the signal generation module, the communication module and the positioning module, which are respectively installed on the animal's head and legs. ZigBee wireless communication is used among the three parts. The results of both the static test, the test in vitro and vivo have shown it is highly effective for remotely modulating a neural circuit and its corresponding behavior in an untethered, freely behaving animal.

articleTitle: Cloud-side interaction method of power Internet of things
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper designs a cloud-side business interaction method for the power Internet of Things, expounds the initialization of the edge proxy on the edge of the power Internet of Things and the related interface protocol information of the cloud Internet of Things platform, and gives the power Internet of Things model distribution, data reporting, and data The interactive method of request and business command, and finally verified the feasibility of the power Internet of Things cloud-side business interactive method through experiments.

articleTitle: A Recognition Method for Radar Emitter Signals Based on Deep Belief Network and Ambiguity Function Matrix Singular Value Vectors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the weak representation ability under low signal noise ratio (SNR) in radar emitter signals recognition based on ambiguity function main ridge or contour lines, etc. A recognition method based on Deep Belief Network (DBN) and ambiguity function matrix singular value vectors (SVV) is proposed. First, the appropriate window parameter of one-dimensional median filtering is selected to denoise the time domain signals and ambiguity function matrix singular value vectors datasets are created in different SNR. Then, a deep network based on DBN model is established to complete the training of labeled data. Finally, the network is used to achieve radar emitter signals recognition. The simulated experiments show that the average recognition accuracy rate of six kinds of complex modulated signals, i.e., BPSK, BFSK, FMCW, QPSK, MSEQ, and LFM-BC, by proposed method keeps above 99.17% in fixed SNR environment above -10dB with good generalization ability and strong robustness.

articleTitle: Face Image Inpainting Network based on Dense Multi-Scale Fusion of Local Binary Patterns
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of convolutional neural networks, Deep Learning (DL) has also made great breakthroughs in the field of image inpainting. Deep Learning-based models can repair large-area missing defaced images, but usually produce various unpleasant artifacts in borders and highly textured areas. To solve this problem, this paper proposed a new end-to-end two-stage repair network. In the first stage, a dense multi-scale fusion of LBP is used to generate rich structural information of the missing regions to guide the inpainting network in the second stage to repair. In the second stage, the Bi-directional Skip Connections mechanism is used to flexibly aggregate high-level semantic features and low-level visual features. Experiments on CelebA-HQ public face data and the results show that this paper’s model solves this problem.

articleTitle: Calculation of shortwave propagation in anisotropic ionosphere by transfer matrix method
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Aiming at the propagation of high frequency radio waves in the ionosphere, this paper studies the influence of geomagnetic field on it. Under the influence of geomagnetic field, the ionosphere will show anisotropic characteristics, which will affect the propagation of short wave in it. In this paper, the ionosphere is regarded as an anisotropic layered medium, and a transfer matrix method is proposed to calculate the propagation of high-frequency radio waves in complex anisotropic layered media, that is, the ionosphere propagation of short wave under the influence of geomagnetic field. The results show that under the influence of geomagnetic field, the propagation of high frequency radio waves in ionosphere is obviously different from that in isotropic case.

articleTitle: Comfort Control of Active Suspension Based on State Feedback
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: To address the problem of the existing vehicle active suspension control methods greatly influenced by external disturbance and model precision, an active suspension controller based on feedback control for half-vehicle model is proposed to improve the vehicle ride comfort. In this paper, the system of dynamic deflection is established for the decoupling control regarded as virtual control, then the feedback controller with simple structure and strong anti-interference ability is designed to achieve the best ride comfort. Finally, the road input simulation shows that under the action of the controller proposed in this paper, the root mean square value of the vertical acceleration of the center of car's mass is reduced by 33.195%, and the vibration displacement of the vehicle body is greatly reduced, the ride comfort of the vehicle is improved.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Path Planning Algorithm Based on Floyd and A* Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Automatic driving system mainly includes four modules: perception, decision-making, planning and control. Path planning system finds the best route between the starting point and the end point for autonomous vehicles, and its accuracy and real-time directly determine the efficiency and safety of unmanned driving. In this paper, a vehicle model and a high-precision map are built as the precondition of the algorithm. After analyzing and comparing the problems of Floyd algorithm and A* algorithm, a hybrid path planning algorithm is proposed, which can give consideration to both global optimality and real-time. Meanwhile, collision detection rules and trajectory generation strategies are designed. Through the simulation experiment of Matlab/Simulink software platform, it is confirmed that the algorithm can meet the practical application requirements and achieve the expected performance.

articleTitle: Research on Behavior Recognition of Wearable Devices Based on Inertial Sensors
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the increasing demand for intelligent interaction and health monitoring, human behavior recognition based on acceleration sensors has attracted extensive attention in the fields of medical care, motion detection, energy consumption assessment and so on. MPU9250 was used to extract acceleration signals and angular velocity signals in human behavior. The recognition results are obtained through the steps of signal preprocessing, feature selection, feature extraction and recognition algorithm. The behavior recognition method based on decision tree is used to identify the stillness, walking, running and jumping.

articleTitle: Huber Loss Function Based on Cockroach Swarm Algorithm with T-Distribution Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In many electronic and information engineering related disciplines, various complex machine learning and reinforcement learning optimization algorithms appear nowadays so as to handle huge amount of data related. Traditional optimization methods, which have to take the whole data space into consideration, cannot always perform well, and cannot always be completed in a short period of time as the data amount to be handled is huge. The object of the so-called optimization problem is to find the optimal solutions or quasi-optimal solutions in a complex and huge data searching space, and finding the efficient optimization algorithm which can handle data with characteristics of complexity, nonlinearity, and modeling difficulties for practical engineering, can be meaningful for electronic and information industries. Huber loss function is a typical traditional optimization method, with the error expressed via smooth mean absolute error (MAE) which has the advantages of MAE and mean square error (MSE) and uses MAE to enhance the robustness of MSE for those abnormal data points. However, Huber loss function employs gradient descent (GD) method to find the minimum value, which can easily be trapped into the local optimal solution. In this paper, a hybrid optimization algorithm, Huber loss function based on cockroach swarm algorithm with t-distribution has been proposed, it has better global convergence, and via numerical experiment, its efficiency in calculation has also been proved.

articleTitle: PCSAFace: Face Recognition with Parallel Channel and Spatial Attention
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Recently, face recognition task has achieved a tremendous strides. It's widely accepted that the key to discriminate different identities is to enlarging the distance between different identities and decreasing the distance between different faces of same identity. Most researches focus on decreasing the intra-class distance and achieve a nice result. There is a trend that attention module is introduced into computer vision task. In this paper, we propose the "angular regularization" that focuses on enlarging the inter-class distance and introduce an novelty parallel channel and spatial attention block to build a new face recognition dedicated backbone network. The method, we call it PCSAFace, enlarges distance between different identities by directly penalizing the angle between cluster center of one identity and cluster centers of other identities. PCSAFace has a well defined geometric interpretation and is easy to do more in-depth research in face tasks. The method has no less good performance than previous works.

articleTitle: A Multichannel SAR-GMTI Method Based on Multi-Polarization SAR Image Fusion
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Displaced phase center array (DPCA) is a classical multichannel synthetic aperture radar(SAR)-based ground moving target indication (SAR-GMTI) method. It has been widely used in the real SAR system because of its simple operation and low computational complexity. However, in the complex clutter environment, there are often many false alarms in the DPCA results, such as the urban area. In this paper, a new GMTI method based on the multi-polarization SAR image information is proposed. Since the amplitude of the urban area in the cross-polarization SAR image is weaker than that in the copolarization image, the urban area in the copolarization image can be replaced with the cross-polarization image, then the DPCA processing is performed for the fusional image. Compared with traditional DPCA technique, this method can reduce the false alarms in the complex environment, such as the urban area. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the real multichannel quadrature-polarization SAR data.

articleTitle: Research on the Robustness of LCL Filter Based on Fractional Order Control Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: This paper presents a scheme for the robust optimal design of LCL filters. Based on the background of the research on LCL parameter optimization design for grid-connected inverters and the current research status at home and abroad, a mathematical model is developed for the grid-connected inverter and the s domain of the grid-connected inverter is analyzed. Finally, a simple and robust simulation model for the LCL filter is developed in MATLAB environment by combining the fractional order PID control technology. The simulation results show that the fractional order PID control technology can effectively suppress the harmonics and improve the robustness of the system.

articleTitle: Discussion on Communication Simulation Method of Backbone Optical Transmission Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Under the background of the rapid development of smart grid, the provincial power communication network has formed a power communication private network architecture, which is mainly based on optical fiber communication technology, supplemented by microwave communication, power line carrier communication and satellite communication. With the continuous expansion of power communication network scale, the business types and information content carried by the communication system are growing rapidly, which leads to the problems of complex network structure and increasing operation and maintenance difficulty. Through the communication simulation of the three-level backbone optical transmission network, it is found that the backbone network has problems in nodes and links. It simplifies the network structure, reduces the pressure of operation and maintenance, and improves the reliability of power communication network.

articleTitle: Research on the location problem of unmanned border and coastal air defense anti-aircraft gun
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In the proposed work, an improved genetic algorithm(IGA) has been devised to solve the model of location problem of unmanned border and coastal air defense anti-aircraft gun. The crossover and mutation probabilities can be adjusted adaptively, by introducing fuzzy operators into the crossover and mutation links, according to the standard deviation of population fitness, so as to achieve the goal of fast convergence and the improvement of robustness of the algorithm. The experimental results show that IGA proposed in this work provides promising results in solving the location problem of unmanned border and coastal air defense anti-aircraft gun.

articleTitle: ASR Control of Distributed Drive Vehicles based on CAN Bus and FlexRay Bus
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In this paper, we will use the four-axis distributed drive vehicle as a platform to establish an ASR(Acceleration Slip Regulation) control system based on Matlab/Simulink. The control system includes vehicle dynamics model, motor model, driver model, etc. In addition, for the CAN bus and the FlexRay bus, we firstly study the influence of network delay of the two buses on the control system respectively, and then build the network communication model of the two buses. This article simulates under the condition of bisectional road, observes the dynamic response result of ASR control system, and obtains the influence of different buses on the performance of ASR control system. The final result shows that, compared with CAN bus, FlexRay communication behavior has better control performance and dynamic response results. Therefore, FlexRay is more suitable for application in control systems that require high real-time information transmission.

articleTitle: Forecast and Analysis of Substation Project Investment Based on Multi-factor Matching
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Power grid construction projects are the top priority of the energy Internet. Investing limited investment in construction projects that can best improve the economy and reliability of the power grid is the key to optimize investment decision-making and improve investment efficiency. Based on the dynamic investment analysis of the final accounts of 110 kV substations in various regions, a substation project investment forecast model based on multi-factor matching is constructed in this paper. The substation project investment forecast and cost control is realized, and the investment level of substations in different regions is analyzed. The calculation result shows that this method can realize the accurate analysis and calculation of substation investment to strengthen the lean management of substation projects and improve the company's investment decision-making mechanism.

articleTitle: Filtering Method based on Speed Prior Information by a Fixed Single Observer Using Bearing-only Measurements
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Considering the speed information as a prior constraint, constrained cubature kalman filter (CCKF) tracking filtering method based on model reduction (MR) method and perfect measurement (PM) method is studied and compared for the tracking problem of fixed single observer passive positioning using only angle pair constant speed targets. The simulation results show that the fixed single observer passive positioning system can track the moving target with constant speed by measuring angle only under the condition of speed prior information, and the perfect measurement method is more robust to the initial state of the filter than the model reduction method.

articleTitle: Design of Library User Profile System Based on Dynamic Density Clustering Algorithm and Stream Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The study of book recommendation system based on user profile is of great significance in accurately grasping the potential reading needs of readers, improving the quality of book recommendation and promoting the development of personalized service in libraries, and it is an indispensable part of the future construction of smart libraries. The existing book recommendation system based on user profile has a series of problems, such as incomplete summary of various information of users, inaccurate grasp of users' real reading needs, and time lag in user information analysis, etc. This paper describes the architecture principle, label system and algorithm flow of library user profile system, and uses dynamic density clustering method and stream computing based on time series analysis to give the label system a time dimension by combining the big data characteristics of users. Combined with the needs of the development of high-quality personalized information services in future smart libraries, this paper explores the application of this system in the effective study of library reading promotion activities, readers' sharing sessions, readers' personalized reading list design and so on.

articleTitle: Data Collection and Traceability Architecture of Internet of Things in Breeding and Slaughtering Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: according to the actual needs of meat product market supervision, in order to ensure food quality and safety, optimize the collection of breeding process data, improve the slaughtering process, track sales data, improve the quality of meat products and improve the overall efficiency of the enterprise as the main objectives, a data acquisition and traceability platform for breeding and slaughtering enterprises based on the Internet of things was designed and constructed. The architecture integrates RFID (Radio Frequency Identifacation), data synchronization, embedded database and other technologies. Through the intelligent terminal, the basic information of beef cattle and mutton, breeding information, slaughtering information and supply chain are collected in real time. The data synchronization between handheld devices and servers is realized by merging and copying technology. Finally, the key information traceability database of cattle and sheep in the whole production process from breeding, slaughtering, processing to logistics supply chain was constructed.

articleTitle: Seq2seq Automatic Question Answering System of Medical Guide Station Based on Background Information
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Automatic question answering technology brings great convenience to doctor-patient communication. Generally, a sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) framework is used to build a question and answer model, but the model cannot make full use of the text information in the relevant context, and some answers generated are relatively simple. To this end, this paper combines medical background information with the Seq2Seq question and answer model, selects the independent recurrent neural network (IndRNN) as the codec of the question and answer model, and establishes an automatic question and answer system for the medical guidance station. Experiments have proved that the response generated by the Q&A model of the medical guidance platform that introduces medical background information is more rich and flexible, with higher accuracy, and close to the real medical guidance response.

articleTitle: Using multi-task residual network to evaluate image aesthetic quality
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the popularity of cameras, smartphones and other devices, visual content data such as images and videos are increasing day by day, and visual content data processing technology has become a research direction in the research fields of computer vision, computational photography and artificial intelligence. Compared with the semantic features of object recognition, the mystery of human aesthetics has not yet been quantified and scientifically explained. It is difficult to determine the feature points of image aesthetics, which increases the difficulty of image aesthetics quality evaluation. In order to better obtain the feature points of image aesthetics, this paper uses a multi-task residual network model to extract features of the image, and evaluate the aesthetic level of the image according to the extracted features. Using a special aesthetic evaluation data set to test and verify the accuracy of the evaluation model proposed in this paper is 84.68%, which can more accurately evaluate the aesthetic level of images. Therefore, the evaluation model proposed in this paper promotes the development of image aesthetic value evaluation technology.

articleTitle: Research on Operation of HVDC Reliability Index System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: At present, there is no good service operation of the HVDC reliability index system. HVDC systems cannot quantify their reliability and service through user power outage hours and user satisfaction indicators like power supply convertors level. As the main body responsible for the operation of the power grid, the high-voltage direct current transmission system analyzed the relationship between the current status of the reliability of the DC. Based on the planned and forced outages in the research Contradictory relationship, Experiments and applications have shown that supplementing and improving the reliability management index system of HVDC transmission system, and guiding the operation and maintenance management mode of DC transmission system more effectively will help to reverse the current situation that the work objectives of the system dispatch department and the equipment maintenance department are not unified or even mutually opposed.

articleTitle: Research on job shop scheduling based on ACM-GA algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: An improved genetic algorithm with adaptive crossover and mutation probability (ACM-GA) was proposed for the job-shop scheduling problem with the optimization goal of minimizing the maximum completion time. The elite retention strategy is adopted to select individuals. The improved preemptive crossover operator PPX and the crossover probability with adaptive ability are referenced to carry out crossover operation. The mutation operator based on neighborhood search and the mutation probability with adaptive ability are used to carry out the mutation operation. Finally, using the same examples in the literature, the results of this paper are compared with those in the literature, and the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed algorithm are verified.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of Tubular Permanent magnet synchronous Linear Motor Considering the End Effect
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Due to the end effect of tubular permanent magnet synchronous linear motor, the inductance of the motor is complex, and it is difficult to realize sensorless control. To solve the problem, the analytical expression of the inductance was derived based on the axial magnetomotive force (MMF) and axial specific permeance. Then the inductance was studied by the analytical model and the finite element method. And the characteristics of the inductance were analyzed. The DC components of self-inductance and mutual-inductance are not zero and the amplitudes of their second harmonics are not equal. Based on the characteristics of the inductances, a high-frequency square-wave injection method in the stationary reference frame was proposed. This method compensates the DC component of the induced current by off-line measurement, and the position information is obtained by an orthogonal phase-locked loop. Experiments show that this method can estimate the mover position accurately.

articleTitle: A Security Quantification Method for Mimic Defense Architecture
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The model of security assessment of the mimic defense architecture has been developing continuously since it was proposed, but it is not perfect to analyze the complex architecture quantitatively only from a certain aspect. The security quantization model is constructed from multiple angles to analyze the different characteristics of the mimic defense architecture to obtain a relatively complete security quantization method. This method is more consistent with the characteristics of the mimic defense architecture, and more appropriate to describe the security of the mimic defense architecture.

articleTitle: Design of 5G-oriented Computing Framework for The Edge Agent Used in Power IoT
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: The goal of the edge computing framework is to solve the problem of management and control in the access of massive 5G terminals in the power Internet of things. Firstly, this paper analyzes the needs of IOT agent in 5G ubiquitous connection, equipment management and control, intelligent computing and other aspects. In order to meet with these needs, paper develops the functions and processes of the edge computing framework, including unified access of heterogeneous devices, protocol adaptation, edge computing, cloud edge collaboration, security control and so on. Finally, the performance of edge computing framework is verified by the pressure test of 5G wireless ubiquitous connection.

articleTitle: A Book Recommendation Algorithm Based on Data Cleaning and Association Rules
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Using data mining technology can extract valuable information from users' book borrowing data, obtain users' borrowing behavior, and provide personalized book recommendation service for users. The traditional association rule algorithms don't carry out data cleaning before use, resulting in a single user's single lending records becoming outliers in the overall data set, which makes the running time of the Apriori algorithm increase significantly. In this paper, according to the support threshold, confidence threshold and filtering threshold of the data set firstly, then the Apriori algorithm is used to analyze the association rules of the cleaned data set. The experimental results show that in the case of both large and small amount of data, the analysis time of Apriori algorithm with data cleaning is shorter, the strong association rules are stronger, and the effect is remarkable in the field of personalized book recommendation.

articleTitle: The Short-time Traffic Flow Prediction at Ramp Junction Based on Wavelet Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to accurately analyze the impact of ramp traffic flow on main road traffic flow, it is necessary to predict short-time traffic flow at ramp junction. Based on the comprehensive analysis of the characteristics of short-time distribution of traffic flow at typical ramp junction, 15 minutes was selected as the traffic flow sampling interval, the traffic flow time series data chain is formed. And the structure of wavelet neural network is optimized and trained by means of the gradient method used to modify the network weights and wavelet basis functions. The short-time traffic flow prediction algorithm with high fitting accuracy and no repeated correction is formed. The prediction training, fitting and error correction of the model are carried out by using the 300 traffic flow time series obtained from road monitoring. The real-time prediction analysis shows that the prediction algorithm can improve the matching accuracy of short-time traffic flow.

articleTitle: Non-destructive Microwave Testing Method on Porcelain Suspension Insulators
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Porcelain suspension insulators are required by utilities to perform regular evaluation on electrical and mechanical properties to ensure safety and reliability of overhead transmission lines in power grids. As an alternative to the conventional insulation resistance test, a novel microwave test method on offline insulator samples is proposed and studied by microwave network analysis, full-wave simulation and experiment. The test described is fast, effective and nondestructive. Hopefully, it can be used as a basis for an improved electrical testbench to ensure high insulation strength of porcelain suspension insulators.

articleTitle: Analysis of high dynamic range and wide color gamut of UHDTV
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: With the development of TV technology, ultra high definition (UHD) industry is booming. UHD programme has gained great popularity. Compared with high definition television (HDTV) system, UHDTV system gets a boost in dynamic range and color gamut. However, improvements in brightness and color are mostly assessed subjectively. In view of above situation, this paper proposes UHD video dynamic range partition method and non-referenced assessment model of high dynamic range (HDR). Based on color gamut conversion algorithm, this paper also proposes wide color gamut (WCG) index and non-referenced assessment model of WCG. These models can give objective and precise evaluation of dynamic range and color gamut when analyzing PQ BT.2100 signal and SDR BT.2020 signal.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Dynamic Routing Protocol for the Space-Ground Integrated Network Based on IDP Protocol
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: Space-ground integrated information network is the trend of future network technology development and plays an irreplaceable role in providing emergency communication and network security services. Dynamic routing protocol is the key to ensure the effective transmission of information in the space-ground integrated network. However, the satellite network has the characteristics of dynamic topology change, extended transmission time and limited resources, which makes the deployment of traditional IP routing technology face great challenges. In this paper, the network technology uses the identifier network with independent intellectual property rights, and proposes the dynamic routing protocol IDP-RIIP based on the self-designed IDP protocol to ensure the safety and reliability of information transmission. In addition, IDP-RIP can effectively reduce the processing delay of nodes and the routing complexity caused by topology switching, based on the characteristics of IDP protocol that the address space is 16-bit identifier, there is no subnet partition concept and hosts are routed between nodes. Experimental results show that the protocol has good performance in routing update delay and convergence time. Compared with the traditional IP network technology, the communication delay is reduced in the case of poor link state.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method of Teaching Effect Based on Visual Calculation in Classroom Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 5th Advanced Information Technology, Electronic and Automation Control Conference (IAEAC)
abstract: In order to improve the shortcomings of traditional classroom evaluation methods, a teaching effectiveness evaluation method based on computer vision technology is proposed. Attendance is obtained by face detection. The distance measurement function is obtained by using the fitting method to calculate the distance between students in the classroom and the camera. The seat selection distribution is obtained according to the distance and direction analysis and quantitatively evaluated by using the curve fitting method. By using the head posture estimation technology and facial expression recognition technology to identify students' up-or-down state and expressions respectively, the ratios of students' raising their heads and positive emotions are obtained. Finally, a geometric mean function based on attendance, seat selection distribution, head up rate and the proportion of positive emotions, is suggested to evaluate the teaching effect. The experimental results show that the evaluation results of this method are highly consistent with those of teachers and students.
